jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

To receive hand over Project from Sales/Tendering and manage it until delivery to customers and completion of warranty period. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Leads Project Managers Team and provide direction / support for escalated project issues.

• Provide Sales and Cash Colletion update to Top Management in regular basis.

• Work closely with Sales team to gather insights of upcoming projects and provide feedback if needed.

• Bridge communication with respective parties including Customer for any disputes and settle it.

• Review all project progress in regular basis and point out any risk observed and settle with respective PM.

• Review project life cycle by planning, budgeting, scheduling and tracking a project plan and execution to meet customer expectations and comply with commercial agreements.

• Challenge Sales forecasting for existing project backlog to get more revenues

• Define project goals, communicate with stakeholders, team members, vendors, and customers, and manage a project through to its closure.

• Order booking, managing project resources (including teams and workers) and documenting the progress of the project.

• Assessing and mitigating the risk, troubleshooting, and leading quality assurance to delight customers and deliver project margin as committed or even better.

• Responsible for billing/invoicing, revenue, and cash collection, updated regularly, and took necessary action to meet the target.

• Conduct people and performance review: people development, competency review, succession planning, cross-culture, code of conduct, and compliance.

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

• Team player

• Well organized and structured

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Pro-active and self-motivated mindset

• Sense of commercial (financial acumen)

• Multi-tasking

Education requirements:

• Bachelor degree in engineering or in related field

Job experience:

• > 5 years work related experience mainly in the engineered-to-order and services.

Knowledge requirements (professional, technical, language):

• Fluent English

• Project management

• Computer literate and Microsoft office

What we offer you

jobs.title: TS Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Responsible for pre-commissioning, commissioning, troubleshooting, start-up, and testing of rotating equipment and related mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation systems; supervising DIRA activities; monitoring field operations and reporting findings; acting as company representative in customer communications; ensuring compliance with ISO, HSE, and company regulations; promoting workplace safety through inspections and Stop Work Authority; and coordinating with Project, Sales, Engineering, and Workshop teams to ensure successful project execution.
Main tasks and responsibilities

• Pre-commissioning and commissioning of installed, repaired or overhauled rotating equipment.

• If required supervise and assist with the DIRA of rotating equipment and associated auxiliary equipment according to technical drawings and specifications.

• Systematic trouble shooting, root cause analysis and rectification on mechanical, electrical and instrumentation component and systems with consideration on quality, time and cost.

• Lead for start up and testing of new installations/erections or overhauled units of rotating equipment including mechanical part, electrical part, instruments and control system

• Monitor field sequence activities based on agreed scope and schedule and report regularly to office.

• Ensure that all findings and work is clearly reported in writing.

• Work assignment could be at shop or field service depends on customer projects request

• Communicate with customer or third party on site as RES representative

• Ensures that all works and activities are done in line with the ISO procedures, as well as the HSE and company regulations.

• Preventing accident, conduct walk thru and observation.

• Campaign using Stop Work Authority to their subordinate when any unsafe Act and condition then record by using observation card.

• Review HIRADC effectiveness. Ensure working area safe for everyone.

• Coordinate with Project OPC, Sales, Engineering and workshop

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

• Team player

• Well organized and structured

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Pro-active and self-motivated minset

• Multi-tasking

• Must have experience in installation, maintenance and troubleshooting of rotating equipment

• Willingness to travel and work on project sites.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering

• Preferably with minimum 5 years experience working on repairing rotating equipment

• Have experience in the OEM will be an advantage

• Have knowledge on repair or overhaul turbine generators

• Fluent in English

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Siemens V84 Specialist Superintendent EG
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The SGTS Superintendent oversees the daily operations of the SGTS GT Division with a focus on safety, quality, and efficiency. They cultivate a positive work environment, drive technical advancement, and ensure effective collaboration with customers and stakeholders. This role also involves optimizing processes, managing budgets, and leading Health and Safety initiatives to promote a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day operations, prioritizing safety, environmental compliance, and adherence to quality standards.

• Manage the Profit and Loss (P&L) of the division, ensuring financial targets are met or exceeded by effectively managing costs, maximizing revenue streams, and implementing strategies to enhance profitability.

• Cultivate a positive work environment by actively engaging with employees, setting clear expectations, and promoting teamwork.

• Drive technical advancement within the division by staying abreast of industry trends and continuously improving coating solutions.

• Optimize work processes to enhance efficiency and profitability, ensuring alignment with monthly budgets.

• Collaborate with customers, Sales Department, and vendors to meet project requirements and maintain strong relationships.

• Coordinate scheduling and project timelines, regularly updating task status and completion dates for effective project management.

• Conduct performance evaluations for Direct Reports and manage salary adjustments in line with company policies.
Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:

• 15-20 plus years of Siemens V84 gas turbine field technical execution experience in project management and/or technical direction

• BS in Mechanical Engineering a plus

• Ability to manage a team of Siemens Technical specialists to execute all levels of scheduled and non-scheduled outage activities

• Travel required to quote pending or executing projects

• Sulzer in person office interface required on a balanced basis

• Additional Siemens gas turbine experience a plus

• Strong communication and leadership skills imperative

• Fluent in business and project relative software’s

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

The SGTS Superintendent oversees the daily operations of the SGTS GT Division with a focus on safety, quality, and efficiency. They cultivate a positive work environment, drive technical advancement, and ensure effective collaboration with customers and stakeholders. This role also involves optimizing processes, managing budgets, and leading Health and Safety initiatives to promote a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day operations, prioritizing safety, environmental compliance, and adherence to quality standards.

• Manage the Profit and Loss (P&L) of the division, ensuring financial targets are met or exceeded by effectively managing costs, maximizing revenue streams, and implementing strategies to enhance profitability.

• Cultivate a positive work environment by actively engaging with employees, setting clear expectations, and promoting teamwork.

• Drive technical advancement within the division by staying abreast of industry trends and continuously improving coating solutions.

• Optimize work processes to enhance efficiency and profitability, ensuring alignment with monthly budgets.

• Collaborate with customers, Sales Department, and vendors to meet project requirements and maintain strong relationships.

• Coordinate scheduling and project timelines, regularly updating task status and completion dates for effective project management.

• Conduct performance evaluations for Direct Reports and manage salary adjustments in line with company policies.
Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:

• 15-20 plus years of Siemens V84 gas turbine field technical execution experience in project management and/or technical direction

• BS in Mechanical Engineering a plus

• Ability to manage a team of Siemens Technical specialists to execute all levels of scheduled and non-scheduled outage activities

• Travel required to quote pending or executing projects

• Sulzer in person office interface required on a balanced basis

• Additional Siemens gas turbine experience a plus

• Strong communication and leadership skills imperative

• Fluent in business and project relative software’s

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Production Worker / Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously.
SUMMARY:
Performs sandblast and paint application tasks in accordance with SPSI standard procedure processes as well as specific customer requirements.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: % OF TIME

 Operates sandblast equipment to provide required surface preparation 35%

 Performs mixing of various types of paint materials. 5%
 Operates conventional spray equipment, including brush to provide a high quality industrial finish to parts and components 35%
 Moves parts and components as needed with forklift or overhead pendant crane 5%
 Dispose of paint waste materials as required by company, state and federal regulations 5%

 Adheres to Safety and Take 5 culture 5%
 Supports and cooperates with Four Principles 5%
SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
 Other duties as assigned 5%

TOTAL PERCENT OF TIME: 100%
QUALIFICATIONS:
 High School graduate or equivalent
 Minimum of 1 year experience operating sandblast equipment
 Minimum of 2 years of experience operating conventional spray equipment
 Forklift and pendant crane experience is helpful
 Minimum 1 year of experience mixing and applying epoxies, polyurethane, inorganic zinc and alkyd enamel paints.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Supervisor Técnico
Supervisor Técnico
Technicien d'usinage
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Dans le cadre de son activité industrielle, notre entreprise recherche un Technicien d'Usinage (H/F) pour renforcer ses équipes de production.
Vous aurez pour mission principale de réaliser des opérations de tournage et/ou de fraisage sur machines conventionnelles, à commande semi-numérique et numérique, dans le respect des exigences qualité, sécurité et délais.
Vous intervenez sur la fabrication de pièces en lien avec les besoins de production et de développement.

Les activités significatives :

• Préparer la zone de travail ainsi que les équipements nécessaires à la réalisation des pièces

• Analyser les contraintes techniques liées aux pièces à fabriquer

• Lire et interpréter des plans ou schémas techniques mécaniques

• Identifier les différentes phases d’usinage

• Élaborer ou ajuster les programmes et régler les paramètres d’usinage

• Ajuster, monter et modifier les outils de coupe

• Choisir les montages adaptés et régler les machines-outils

• Usiner des pièces unitaires, prototypes ou petites séries en conformité avec les plans et spécifications

• Contrôler la qualité et la conformité des pièces usinées

• Réaliser la maintenance préventive et corrective de premier niveau des équipements

Le profil recherché :

• Formation en usinage / mécanique / productique (CAP, Bac Pro, BTS ou équivalent)

• Expérience sur machines conventionnelles et/ou à commande numérique

• Bonne capacité de lecture de plans mécaniques

• Connaissances en programmation et réglage machines

• Rigueur, précision et sens de la qualité

• Autonomie, esprit d’analyse et respect des consignes de sécurité

What we offer you

Ce que nous vous proposons

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)

• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT

• et bien d'autres...

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Machine Tool Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Sulzer Turbo Services is seeking a skilled Machine Tool Technician to support maintenance, repair, and operation of precision machining equipment used in the repair and servicing of turbomachinery components. This role is responsible for ensuring machine tools operate safely, efficiently, and within required tolerances to support high-quality manufacturing and repair operations. Key Responsibilities

• Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of machine tools including manual lathes, surface grinders, milling machines, CNC equipment, and horizontal and vertical machining centers.

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.

• Perform machine alignments, calibrations, and precision adjustments.

• Install, test, and commission new or rebuilt equipment.

• Maintain preventive maintenance schedules for shop equipment.

• Read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and technical manuals.

• Support production teams to minimize downtime.

• Ensure compliance with safety policies and OSHA standards.

• Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation.

• Assist with equipment upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures.

• Complete and properly document all tasks assigned by the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Report any mechanical issues identified during inspections to the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Work closely and maintain clear communication with other departments, mechanical personnel, Leadman, and Supervisors.

• Complete all company-required training programs.
Required Qualifications

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• Technical or vocational training in machining, industrial maintenance, or related field preferred.

• 7–10 years’ experience maintaining machine tools or industrial equipment.

• Strong knowledge of machining operations and precision measurement tools.

• Experience with CNC troubleshooting preferred.

• Ability to read schematics and technical drawings.

• Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently and within a team environment.
Preferred Skills

• Experience in turbomachinery, rotating equipment, or heavy industrial repair.

• Familiarity with vibration analysis or alignment practices.

• PLC troubleshooting experience is a plus.

• Forklift or overhead crane experience preferred.
Physical Requirements

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

• Standing, bending, and working in an industrial shop environment.

• Ability to work around rotating machinery and heavy equipment.
Work Environment

• Industrial repair and machine shop setting.

• Exposure to noise, moving equipment, oils, and machining materials.

• PPE required at all times.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Location: Pasadena, TX (1910 Jasmine Drive)
On‑site role with up to 40% field service

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer supports the inspection, repair, and documentation of rotating equipment by combining hands‑on shop and field work with engineering documentation and customer communication. This role works closely with the machine shop, quotation team, and customers to help define accurate repair scopes and ensure quality execution.

This position is intended for engineers with practical mechanical experience who can work independently with general guidance. Training will be provided as part of onboarding. This role is primarily based on‑site in Pasadena, TX, with occasional field service assignments (up to 40%). The engineer will split time between hands‑on mechanical work, inspections, measurements, and engineering documentation. The role requires close coordination with the repair shop, internal teams, and customers.

Key Responsibilities

• Support rotating equipment inspections and repair evaluations to help define accurate work scopes

• Act as a mechanical point of contact for customers during inspections and repairs

• Coordinate with the machine shop and quotation team on mechanical findings and requirements

• Create and update CAD drawings to document design or repair changes for customer review

• Perform or verify precision measurements using micrometers and calipers

• Participate in day‑to‑day shop and field operations, including repair support

• Assist with field service overhauls as required

• Document findings clearly and complete assigned tasks on schedule

Preferred (3+ years total across one or more of the following):

• Rotating equipment repair or overhaul

• Rotating equipment manufacturing

• Rotating equipment package design and assembly

• Field service for mechanical equipment

• Vibration analysis or diagnostics

Technical Skills & Knowledge

• Proficient with CAD software (SolidWorks or AutoDesk)

• Working knowledge of:

• Rolling element bearings

• Sleeve/babbitt bearings

• Mechanical seals and oil seals

• Shaft alignment

• Vibration spectrums and interpretation

• Comfortable using micrometers and calipers

• Familiarity with seal and bearing clearances to shafts is preferred

• If not already experienced, this skill will be taught on the job

Required Attributes

• Self‑motivated and willing to learn through on‑the‑job training

• Comfortable working in a hands‑on, industrial environment

• Able to take ownership of assigned work and complete tasks in a timely manner

• Strong attention to detail and communication skills

What we offer you

• Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance

• Health Savings Account (HSA)

• 401(k) with 6% company match

• Paid time off and paid holidays

• Paid parental leave

• Gym membership and wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Short- and long-term disability insurance

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: MRO Gas Turbine Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Sulzer GT Aero is seeking an experienced MRO Gas Turbine Engineer to provide technical expertise and support for the maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) of gas turbine components and systems. This role is crucial in ensuring the reliable and efficient operation of critical equipment for our clients. Job Responsibilities

• Setting technical specifications for the overhaul, inspection, and repair of aero-derivative gas turbines

• Overseeing disassembly, inspection and reassembly activities, ensuring compliance with engineering drawings, tolerances and standards

• Leading troubleshooting and diagnostic investigations, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions

• Driving continuous improvement initiatives, applying Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to enhance efficiency and reduce downtime

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams including design engineers, OEMs, supply chain, and operations to deliver seamless project execution

Job Qualifications

• Strong technical expertise in gas turbines and rotating equipment, with practical experience of MRO environments

• Proven track record in repair schemes, diagnostics, and troubleshooting

• Knowledge of RB211 and/or Avon products (desirable but not essential)

• Experience in root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions

• The ability to interpret data from sensors and diagnostic tools to identify and resolve faults

• A degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience (preferred)

• A collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills and attention to detail

What we offer you

• A competitive base salary

• Annual Bonus scheme based on personal and company performance

• 33 days’ annual leave

• Private Medical Insurance (Self)

• Access free on-site parking and employee discounts across shopping, lifestyle, and entertainment

• Use our Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support services and wellbeing resources

• Develop your skills through continuous learning and Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Be part of a supportive, innovative team with genuine opportunities for career progression

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Repair Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Acts as the liaison between the customer, sales, vendors, engineering, and production departments, determines and provides detailed cost summaries and quotations for repair jobs in the service center. Coordinates repair by providing Work Instructions that include all pertinent information needed to process the repair through the service center meeting ISO requirements. Key Responsibilities

• Reviews customer requirement for pump repair

• Analyzes inspection results, works with shop personnel and Area Superintendent to determine scope of work required for repairs

• Plans repairs (labor hours, purchase requirements, work instructions, and total cost)

• Generates repair quotes

• Completes disassembly, inspection, repair, and assembly work instruction packages, (work orders, prints, procedures, inspection forms).

• Make/ review sketches and drawings to ISO standard and in AutoCAD where required.

• Completes purchase requisitions. Consults with vendors to determine availability, quality, quantity, and best pricing of all materials relative to a given job.

• Evaluates supplier quotations and determines acceptable quality, quantity, and pricing requirements to meet commitments made to customers.

• When necessary, expedite parts and materials from suppliers to ensure delivery commitments are met.

• As applicable, prepare and facilitate all inbound/ outbound shipping related tasks required for the final transportation of repairs. This may include all shipping, import, and export documentation as required.

• Manage projects to meet tender and order cycle time objectives for the service center.

• To ensure compliance with customer commitments and overall master schedule communicates regularly with all departments to keep them abreast of coordination activities

• All work is performed by ISO and OSHAS requirements

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management system which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Support and cooperate in company-wide improvement initiatives.

• Perform root cause analysis on pump failures

• Perform basic material selections for repair projects

• Perform engineering calculations per industry and Sulzer standards

• Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications / Requirements

• Strong organizational, interpersonal and analytical skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills; including diplomacy and negotiation skills

• Solid knowledge of all manufacturing and shop processes related to repair of pumps and manufacturing of pump parts and or closely related equipment required

• Strong PC skills, with proficiency in Microsoft software

• Working experience and knowledge of ERP systems required. Previous SAP experience strongly desired but not critical.

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering is preferred

• Experience in closely related roles is preferred.

• Technical knowledge of pump design and repair, and fit form and functions of components is preferred.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro Agisce come il collegamento tra il cliente, le vendite, i fornitori, l'ingegneria e i reparti di produzione, determina e fornisce riassunti dettagliati dei costi e citazioni per lavori di riparazione nel centro di servizio. Coordina la riparazione fornendo istruzioni di lavoro che includono tutte le informazioni pertinenti necessarie per elaborare la riparazione attraverso il centro di servizio che soddisfa i requisiti ISO. Principali responsabilità
• Recensioni requisito del cliente per la riparazione della pompa
• Analizza i risultati dell'ispezione, lavora con il personale del negozio e il sovrintendente dell'area per determinare la portata del lavoro richiesto per le riparazioni
• Piani di riparazione (orario di lavoro, requisiti di acquisto, istruzioni di lavoro e costo totale)
• Genera le citazioni di riparazione
• Completa i pacchetti di istruzioni di lavoro di smontaggio, ispezione, riparazione e montaggio, (ordinari di lavoro, stampe, procedure, moduli di ispezione).
• Fare / rivedere schizzi e disegni a norma ISO e in AutoCAD dove richiesto.
• Completa le requisizioni di acquisto. Consulta i fornitori per determinare la disponibilità, la qualità, la quantità e il miglior prezzo di tutti i materiali relativi a un determinato lavoro.
• Valuta le quotazioni dei fornitori e determina i requisiti di qualità, quantità e prezzi accettabili per soddisfare gli impegni assunti ai clienti.
• In caso di necessità, le parti e i materiali espediti dai fornitori per garantire gli impegni di consegna sono soddisfatti.
• Come applicabile, preparare e facilitare tutte le attività di spedizione in entrata / in uscita necessarie per il trasporto finale di riparazioni. Ciò può includere tutta la documentazione di spedizione, importazione e di esportazione come richiesto.
• Gestire i progetti per soddisfare gli obiettivi del ciclo di gara e di ordine per il centro di servizio.
• Per garantire la conformità con gli impegni dei clienti e il programma generale di master comunica regolarmente con tutti i dipartimenti per tenerli al passo delle attività di coordinamento
• Tutto il lavoro è eseguito dai requisiti ISO e OSHAS
• Supporta, collabora e partecipa al sistema aziendale LEAN e EHS Management, che include tutte le politiche e procedure in materia di sicurezza, salute e ambiente. Sostegno e cooperazione in iniziative di miglioramento a livello aziendale.
• Eseguire l'analisi della causa radice sui guasti della pompa
• Eseguire selezioni di materiali di base per i progetti di riparazione
• Eseguire calcoli di ingegneria per l'industria e gli standard Sulzer
• Esegui altre funzioni assegnate Qualifiche / Requisiti
• Forte capacità organizzative, interpersonali e analitiche.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta;
• Conoscenza solida di tutti i processi produttivi e commerciali relativi alla riparazione di pompe e alla produzione di parti della pompa e o attrezzature strettamente correlate richieste
• Forte capacità PC, con competenza nel software Microsoft
• Esperienza di lavoro e conoscenza dei sistemi ERP richiesti. Precedente esperienza SAP fortemente desiderato ma non critico.
• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica è preferito
• L'esperienza in ruoli strettamente correlati è preferita.
• La conoscenza tecnica della progettazione e della riparazione della pompa, e la forma e le funzioni di componenti è preferita. Cosa ti offriamo
• 15 giorni di riposo e 12 giorni festivi

• Analysiert Inspektionsergebnisse, arbeitet mit Werkstattpersonal und Area Superintendent zusammen, um den Umfang der für Reparaturen erforderlichen Arbeiten zu bestimmen
• Pläne für Reparaturen (Arbeitszeiten, Einkaufsanforderungen, Arbeitsanweisungen und Gesamtkosten)
• Generiert Reparaturangebote
• Vervollständigt Demontage-, Inspektions-, Reparatur- und Montagearbeitsanweisungspakete (Arbeitsaufträge, Drucke, Verfahren, Inspektionsformulare).
• Erstellen / Überprüfen Sie Skizzen und Zeichnungen nach ISO-Standard und in AutoCAD, wo erforderlich.
• Schließt Kaufanforderungen ab. Beraten Sie sich mit Anbietern, um Verfügbarkeit, Qualität, Quantität und beste Preise für alle Materialien in Bezug auf einen bestimmten Auftrag zu ermitteln.
• Bewertet Lieferantenangebote und bestimmt akzeptable Qualitäts-, Quantitäts- und Preisanforderungen, um die gegenüber den Kunden eingegangenen Verpflichtungen zu erfüllen.
• Beschleunigen Sie bei Bedarf Teile und Materialien von Lieferanten, um sicherzustellen, dass die Lieferverpflichtungen eingehalten werden.
• Bereiten und erleichtern Sie gegebenenfalls alle eingehenden / ausgehenden Versandaufgaben, die für den endgültigen Transport von Reparaturen erforderlich sind. Dies kann alle erforderlichen Versand-, Import- und Exportdokumentationen umfassen.
• Verwalten Sie Projekte, um die Ausschreibungs- und Bestellzykluszeitziele für das Servicecenter zu erfüllen.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Kundenverpflichtungen und des allgemeinen Masterplans kommuniziert regelmäßig mit allen Abteilungen, um sie über die Koordinationsaktivitäten auf dem Laufenden zu halten
• Alle Arbeiten werden nach ISO- und OSHAS-Anforderungen ausgeführt
• Unterstützt, kooperiert und beteiligt sich am unternehmensweiten LEAN- und EHS-Managementsystem, das die Einhaltung aller Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltrichtlinien und -verfahren umfasst. Unterstützung und Zusammenarbeit bei unternehmensweiten Verbesserungsinitiativen.
• Führen Sie eine Ursachenanalyse bei Pumpenausfällen durch
• Führen Sie grundlegende Materialauswahl für Reparaturprojekte durch
• Führen Sie Engineering-Berechnungen nach Branchen- und Sulzer-Standards durch
• Führt andere Aufgaben wie zugewiesen aus Qualifikationen/Anforderungen
• Starke organisatorische, zwischenmenschliche und analytische Fähigkeiten.
• Hervorragende verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten; einschließlich Diplomatie und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten
• Solides Wissen über alle Herstellungs- und Werkstattprozesse im Zusammenhang mit der Reparatur von Pumpen und der Herstellung von Pumpenteilen und oder eng verwandten Geräten erforderlich
• Starke PC-Fähigkeiten, mit Kenntnissen in Microsoft-Software
• Arbeitserfahrung und Kenntnisse der ERP-Systeme erforderlich. Bisherige SAP-Erfahrungen waren sehr erwünscht, aber nicht kritisch.
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Maschinenbau wird bevorzugt
• Erfahrung in eng verwandten Rollen wird bevorzugt.
• Technische Kenntnisse des Pumpendesigns und der Reparatur sowie der Form und Funktionen der Komponenten werden bevorzugt. Was wir Ihnen bieten
• 15 Tage bezahlte Freizeit und 12 bezahlte Firmenferien
• 401k Plan mit einem 6% Match
• Umfassender Gesundheitsplan einschließlich medizinischer, zahnärztlicher, Sehkraft, Leben, kurzfristiger und langfristiger Behinderung
• Gesundheit Sparkonto Matching
• Motivierendes Wellnessprogramm
• Mitarbeiterunterstützungsprogramm
• Bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub
• Gym-Rückerstattung Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld. Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Agit comme la liaison entre le client, les ventes, les vendeurs, l'ingénierie, et les services de production, détermine et fournit des résumés de coûts détaillés et des devis pour les travaux de réparation dans le centre de service. Coordonner la réparation en fournissant des instructions de travail qui incluent toutes les informations pertinentes nécessaires pour traiter la réparation par le centre de service satisfaisant aux exigences de l'ISO. Principales responsabilités
• Examen des exigences du client pour la réparation de la pompe
• Analyse les résultats de l'inspection, travaille avec le personnel de l'atelier et le directeur régional pour déterminer la portée des travaux requis pour les réparations
• Planifier les réparations (heures de travail, besoins d'achat, instructions de travail et coût total)
• Génére des devis de réparation
• Compléte le démontage, l'inspection, la réparation et le montage des ensembles d'instructions de travail (commandes de travail, impressions, procédures, formulaires d'inspection).
• Faire/ examiner les croquis et les dessins selon la norme ISO et en AutoCAD au besoin.
• Remplit les demandes d'achat. Consulter les fournisseurs pour déterminer la disponibilité, la qualité, la quantité et le meilleur prix de tous les matériaux par rapport à un emploi donné.
• Évaluer les prix des fournisseurs et déterminer les exigences acceptables en matière de qualité, de quantité et de prix pour respecter les engagements pris envers les clients.
• Au besoin, accélérer les pièces et les matériaux des fournisseurs pour s'assurer que les engagements de livraison sont respectés.
• Le cas échéant, préparer et faciliter toutes les tâches liées à l'expédition à l'arrivée/à l'arrivée nécessaires au transport final des réparations. Cela peut inclure tous les documents d'expédition, d'importation et d'exportation au besoin.
• Gérer les projets pour atteindre les objectifs du cycle des appels d'offres et des commandes pour le centre de services.
• Veiller au respect des engagements des clients et communiquer régulièrement avec tous les départements pour les tenir au courant des activités de coordination
• Tous les travaux sont effectués selon les exigences ISO et OSHAS
• Soutient, coopère avec et participe à l'ensemble de l'entreprise LEAN et EHS Management système qui comprend suivre toutes les politiques et procédures en matière de sécurité, de santé et d'environnement. Soutenir et coopérer à des initiatives d'amélioration à l'échelle de l'entreprise.
• Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes des défaillances de la pompe
• Effectuer des sélections de matériaux de base pour les projets de réparation
• Effectuer des calculs techniques par industrie et par normes Sulzer
• Exécute d'autres fonctions selon les affectations Qualifications / Exigences
• Fortes aptitudes organisationnelles, interpersonnelles et analytiques.
• Excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite, y compris diplomatie et négociation
• Connaissance approfondie de tous les procédés de fabrication et d'atelier liés à la réparation des pompes et à la fabrication des pièces de pompe et ou des équipements étroitement liés requis
• Fortes compétences PC, avec compétence dans les logiciels Microsoft
• Expérience de travail et connaissance des systèmes PGI requis. Expérience SAP précédente fortement souhaitée mais pas critique.
• Baccalauréat en génie mécanique est préféré
• L'expérience des rôles étroitement liés est privilégiée.
• La connaissance technique de la conception et de la réparation de la pompe, ainsi que la forme d'ajustement et les fonctions des composants est préférée. Ce que nous vous offrons
• 15 jours de congé payé et 12 jours fériés payés par l'entreprise
• Plan 401k avec un match de 6%
• Plan de santé global comprenant des soins médicaux, dentaires, de la vision, de la vie, des incapacités de courte et de longue durée
• Compatibilité des comptes d'épargne santé
• Programme de bien-être motivant
• Programme d'aide aux employés
• Congé parental payé
• Remboursement de gymnastique Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

Field Machining Supervisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Field Machining Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily production or service center activities, ensuring that processes run smoothly, efficiently, and safely. This role supervises professional-level staff and ensures adherence to quality standards and production or service schedules.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Key Responsibilities

• Supervise production or service staff and assign daily tasks.

• Monitor workflow and ensure production targets are met.

• Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards.

• Maintain equipment and report maintenance needs.

• Train new employees and support skill development.

• Identify process improvements and implement changes.

• Communicate production status to management.

Skills & Qualifications

• Typically requires a technical degree and several years of relevant work experience to be able to manage and coordinate one or more professional-level teams.

• Experience in manufacturing or production supervision.

• Strong leadership and organizational skills.

• Knowledge of safety and quality standards.

• Ability to troubleshoot and resolve operational issues.

• Effective communication and team coordination skills.

What we offer you

• 11 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability insurance

• 401k with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Quality Engineer is responsible for managing quality engineering processes and supporting manufacturing operations to ensure product compliance. This includes defining quality standards, auditing outputs, and resolving defects.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area.
Principais Responsabilidades

• Gerenciar, acompanhar e executar projetos e atividades de alta complexidade relacionados à área de Qualidade;

• Desenvolver, implementar e controlar programas e sistemas de gestão, garantia e controle da qualidade;

• Conduzir análises, pesquisas e melhorias contínuas em métodos, processos, formulações e padrões de qualidade;

• Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a modificação de metodologias relacionadas à confiabilidade, ensaios e processos produtivos;

• Realizar acompanhamento técnico e suporte especializado às áreas envolvidas em auditorias, inspeções e projetos internos.

Habilidades Necessárias

• Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica/Produção e áreas afins;

• Conhecimento das normas de execução e critérios de aceitação de Ensaios Não Destrutivos (END);

• Conhecimento em Metrologia e interpretação de desenho mecânico;

• Conhecimento em Gestão da Qualidade;

• Inglês intermediário.

Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida.
Vale alimentação e refeição no local.
Vale transporte e/ou fretado.
Programa de bem-estar e Gympass.
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).
Previdência privada.
Ampla variedade de oportunidades de aprendizado.

jobs.title: Receptionist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Administrator is responsible for providing basic administrative support by following established procedures. This role works under close supervision and handles routine tasks to support office operations.

Will answer phones, greet and check in all visitors.

This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and work under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. SC: Phoenix, Arizona

PRIMARY FUNCTIONS:

• Upon arriving make sure necessary lights are on and the TV with the safety message is turned on

• Answer / screen / forward incoming phone calls using a multi-line telephone system

• Personably greet and welcome walk-in customers / visitors; ensure they are signed in accordingly then direct them to the appropriate staff member

• Direct visitors to the appropriate person and office

• Ensure reception desk is manned and the main telephone line has coverage at all times during business hours

• Perform brief safety orientation accordingly with customers / visitors entering the premises, where applicable

• Manage inventory and purchase office supplies

• Create and maintain inventory spreadsheet for admin and sales supplies

• Manage and update the conference room calendar as needed

• Organize, set-up, break down and maintain conference room for all operations and executive meetings

• Organize and order lunch on an as needed basis

• Oversee sorting and distribution of mail to both the administration and shop buildings

• Prepare outgoing mail / UPS / FedEx (envelopes, packages, etc.)

• Perform other clerical receptionist duties such a filing, photocopying, data entry, etc.

• Keep common area clean and organized

• Provide assistance to other departments as needed and per supervisor approval

EXPERIENCE/SKILLS:

• Knowledge and proficient use of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power Point

• Maintain a professional attitude and appearance

• Excellent communication and organizational skills

• Customer service quality

• Independently perform substantial clerical and office work

• The ability to proficiently use a multi-line telephone system, computer, copier and other office equipment

• Be a self-motivated individual with initiative and the ability to multi-task

• Team oriented and able to interact with multiple departments

• Bilingual is required (English & Spanish)

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

• Office environment

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• May occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds

What we offer you

Paid parental leave
Parental leave
Health insurance
401(k) matching
Paid time off
Vision insurance
Health savings account
Dental insurance
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
401(k) 6% Match
Paid holidays
Wellness program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Manager is responsible for managing a team of sales representatives, setting sales goals, and ensuring the team meets performance targets. This role supports the execution of sales strategies and provides coaching and development to team members.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ experienced to senior expert-level employees.
Key Responsibilities
Supervise and support the sales team in achieving targets.
Set sales goals and monitor performance metrics.
Train and mentor sales representatives.
Develop and implement sales plans and strategies.
Handle key customer accounts and resolve escalations.
Collaborate with marketing and operations teams.
Report sales performance to senior leadership.

Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and 9+ years of relevant work experienceare minimally required to be able to manage and coordinate one or more expert-level teams.
Experience in sales team management.
Strong leadership and coaching skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
Proficiency in CRM systems and reporting tools.
Ability to analyze data and drive performance.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

jobs.title: SAP Module Consultant (PP/MM)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The IT Specialist is responsible for supporting and maintaining IT systems and infrastructure, ensuring operational efficiency and user satisfaction. This role manages technical projects and provides advanced support across departments. Job Responsibilities

• Design and delivery of SAP solutions that meet business requirement, whilst also ensuring global process and system harmonization.

• Provide 2nd/3rd level support for production incident resolution.

• Provide SAP training to key user/project team.

• Responsible for executing assigned activities including :

• Configuring the SAP system and system documentation.

• Performing system testing.

• Writing functional specifications in the development of RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements & Forms) .

• Maintaining SAP user manuals.

• Developing and supporting SAP integration with other 3rd-party systems.

• Support system upgrades, patches.

• Adoption of best practices & compliance management by developing new SAP tools, features & enhancements.

• Coordinate activities with technical, security and Basis teams.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in technical or business studies.

• Minimum 5 years on working experience in SAP module PP (Production Planning. Knowledge of SAP MM (Material Management) would be a plus.

• Fluent English and Chinese required – other languages are an advantage.

• Good understanding on how to turn the business requirements into an ERP processes.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

• Shuttle Bus.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Field Service Supervisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Field) Service Machinist Supervisor is responsible for managing on-site machining operations in demanding industrial environments. This role is responsible for supervising field personnel, ensuring precision machining work meets strict tolerances, and delivering projects safely, on time, and within budget. The ideal candidate combines strong technical machining expertise with proven leadership and customer-facing skills. Key Responsibilities
Set up and operate portable machining equipment lathes, line boring, flange facing, milling, drilling, and tapping.
Interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and specifications.
Measure and inspect components using, calipers, dial indicators, etc.
Ensure proper alignment and tolerances are achieved.
Maintain field equipment and tooling.
Communicate with clients and supervisors regarding job progress and issues.

Skills & Qualifications
High school diploma or equivalent technical training.
Proven experience as a machinist, preferably in field or industrial environment.
Ability to read and interpret blueprints and schematics.
Mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Willingness to travel frequently and work in varying conditions outdoors, confined spaces, and heights.
Physical ability to lift heavy equipment and stand for long periods.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer - Electrical C&I
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Ensures the reliability, optimization, and compliance of control systems and instrumentation at Sulzer. This role supports the design of centrifugal pumps and components, preparing detailed engineering studies, calculations, BOMs and documentation to meet customer and regulatory standards. Through technical expertise and collaboration, the position enhances equipment performance, contributes to operational excellence, and supports Sulzer's mission to deliver innovative fluid engineering solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Prepare accurate engineering electrical drawings, Bills of Materials, and specifications using CAD (EPLAN & AutoCAD) to enable pump manufacturing.

• Perform and validate detailed design calculations to ensure designs meet customer requirements, safety, and quality standards.

• Design and develop customized pump components and assemblies based on customer specifications and company standards.

• Collaborate with internal teams like Sales and Tendering, Project Management, and Manufacturing to support project execution and address technical challenges.

• Supervise and review the work of design engineers and drafters to ensure quality and adherence to timelines.

• Adhere to strict schedule deadlines and ensure timely delivery of all engineering tasks and deliverables.

• Participate in order reviews, design meetings, and administrative functions to support effective project management.

• Contribute to process improvements and uphold EHS and company quality standards in all tasks.

• Participation in customer meetings and site visits to ensure customer satisfaction and provide technical alignment.

• Support and collaborate with other engineering facilities and divisions in the Global Sulzer Organization to ensure on-time delivery and customer satisfaction.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical ​engineering; CAD or Lean certification is an advantage.

• 5–8 years of relevant work experience in electrical and mechanical design environments.

• Proficiency in electrical CAD design using EPLAN (AutoCAD as a minimum), with solid experience in Teamcenter and SAP.

• Sound knowledge of electrical drafting, manufacturing processes, and detailed calculations for pump components and assemblies.

• Familiarity with LEAN principles, EHS standards, and order execution and handling processes.

• Strong problem-solving skills with proven ability to collaborate effectively across teams.

• Demonstrated leadership, mentoring capability, excellent time management, and the ability to handle multiple tasks efficiently.

What we offer you

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

titleByLocale.it: Senior Design Ingegnere - Mechanical Fire Water Pump
titleByLocale.en: Senior Design Engineer - Mechanical Fire Water Pump
titleByLocale.de: Senior Design Ingenieur - Mechanical Fire Water Pump
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Design Ingénieur - Mechanical Fire Water Pump

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Lead and manage mechanical design projects related to fire water pump systems, from sales order review to production handover. Ensure compliance with Aramco engineering standards, NFPA 20, and other applicable codes. Provide technical leadership in the design, documentation, and execution of fire protection pumping systems.

Key Responsibilities

• Review and interpret Aramco project specifications and NFPA 20 requirements to develop compliant fire water pump designs.

• Prepare and deliver customer‑facing documents including Pump Cross Section drawings, General Arrangement drawings, P&ID diagrams, and when required, relevant calculations.

• Approve and coordinate buyout component documentation for motors, couplings, seals, gearboxes, valves, and diesel engines.

• Collaborate with instrumentation team to ensure proper integration of fire system controls and monitoring.

• Generate and manage Bill of Materials (BOM) in SAP ERP.

• Liaise with customers, Aramco representatives, and sub-suppliers to ensure design alignment and approvals.

• Support cross-functional teams (Operations, Procurement, Quality, Testing) throughout the project lifecycle.

• Provide commissioning support and troubleshooting for fire pump systems at site or on test bed.

• Prepare and submit design calculations and technical reports for client and regulatory approval.

• Ensure designs meet safety, reliability, and performance standards required for fire protection systems.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering.

• 5–10 years of experience in centrifugal pump design, with a focus on fire water systems.

• Moderate understanding of both horizontal and vertical pump design and operation.

• Strong working knowledge of NFPA 20, API standards, and Aramco engineering specifications.

• Proficiency in Autodesk (AutoCAD, Inventor), Siemens NX, & Teamcenter.

• Experience with SAP for BOM and project tracking.

• Proven ability to manage multiple projects and interface with clients and regulatory bodies.

• Strong ownership, attention to detail, and results-oriented mindset.

What we offer you

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a Service Centre Manager to lead our Ipswich and Southampton Service Centres. This is a pivotal, multi-site leadership role shaping the future of our UK operations, combining strategic oversight, operational excellence, and cultural transformation. Our Southampton and Ipswich sites bring together skilled specialists delivering overhaul, repair, and upgrade services for pumps, turbines, compressors, and other rotating machinery. Working with major global energy companies, utilities, and industrial operators, we’re focused on reliability, innovation, and customer success.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Own the P&L for both the Southampton and Ipswich Service Centres, delivering expected returns while maintaining exceptional safety and customer satisfaction.

• Lead and role model strong health and safety behaviours, embedding a positive, proactive safety culture across both locations.

• Develop a future‑ready organisation, ensuring capability, workforce planning, and talent management are effectively aligned across the two sites.

• Execute business growth plans, identifying and realising market and product opportunities while effectively managing risk.

• Build, coach, and develop high‑performing management teams at both sites, ensuring consistency in standards, behaviours, and operational practices.

• Monitor, analyse, and report on performance, using key metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement.

• Collaborate closely with Sales and Commercial teams to align operational capacity with customer requirements (SIOP).

• Embed compliance and operational excellence, ensuring both sites consistently follow best practices.

• Communicate strategy, progress, and results clearly, both within and across the wider regional operations organisation.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Proven experience leading people in an operational environment, ideally across multiple sites in an Industrial Engineering environment

• Experience in business management, P&L ownership, and aftermarket or service-based environments.

• Strong understanding of health, safety, and environmental requirements.

• An annual bonus based on a combination of company performance and your individual contribution

jobs.title: Air Compressor Maintenance Technician

titleByLocale.it: Tecnologia di manutenzione del compressore d'aria

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Air Compressor Maintenance Technician is responsible for the installation, inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of air compressors and related systems. This role ensures equipment operates safely, reliably, and efficiently while meeting company, customer, and regulatory standards. Responsibilities

• Install, maintain, inspect, and repair industrial air compressors and auxiliary equipment

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance to minimize downtime

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic issues and recommend repairs

• Conduct routine inspections and performance testing of compressor systems

• Replace worn or defective parts, including motors, valves, seals, belts, and filters

• Read and interpret technical manuals, schematics, and work orders

• Ensure compliance with safety policies, procedures, and industry regulations

• Document maintenance activities, inspections, and repairs accurately

• Support equipment upgrades, modifications, and system improvements

• Coordinate with operations, engineering, and management teams as needed

• Always maintain a clean and safe work environment

• Assist other trades and perform additional duties or work assignments as directed by the management team
Qualifications:
The i d eal ca nd i d ate will p o sse s s t h e f o l l o win g :

• High school diploma or GED required, technical certification or trade school preferred

• 3+ years of experience maintaining or repairing industrial air compressors or rotating equipment

• Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills

• Experience with reciprocating, centrifugal, or rotary screw compressors preferred

• Ability to read technical drawings and service manuals

• Familiarity with safety standards and lockout/tagout procedures

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team

• HVAC or refrigeration experience is a plus

• Must provide own personal tools

• Required to supply personal hand tools appropriate for the role

• Worked on following equipment, Quincy, Kaeser, Sullair.

Physical & Work Requirements

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs

• Ability to stand, bend, kneel, and work in industrial environments

• Willingness to work overtime, weekends, or on-call as required

• Ability to work in shop and field environments

Preferred Skills

• Experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, or Power Generation industries

• Knowledge of vibration monitoring, alignment, and lubrication practices

• Strong attention to detail and safety awareness

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Madrid, Spain.

This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable, whilst contributing to the success of a newly established office in central Madrid.

If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organisation, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Madrid office, supporting our European companies. You will work together with an external shared service center who is responsible for master data, invoice processing and payments. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors. Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Independently manage the daily business in accounts payable, in collaboration with the country’s Finance team and the external Shared Service Center

• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers

• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.

• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.

• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFR.

• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.

• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields

• 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable

• Very good written and verbal communication skills

• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)

• Fluent English skills

• Any other European language is a plus

• Analytical and problema solving skills

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.

• Other fringe benefits

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: OTC Billing Accountant (French / Italian)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The OTC Billing Accountant supports end‑to‑end Order‑to‑Cash activities with a strong focus on collections, billing, cash forecasting, and credit management. The role works closely with Legal Entities, Sales, Project Management, and Finance stakeholders to optimize cash flow, manage credit risk, and drive process standardization across the Group.

Key Responsibilities

Billing & Invoicing

• Prepare and issue accurate customer invoices based on contracts, service agreements, and purchase orders.

• Review and reconcile billing data, ensuring timely invoice dispatch in compliance with customer and regulatory requirements (e.g. B2B e‑invoicing).

• Collaborate with Sales, Project Management, Customer Service, and Collections teams to resolve billing queries.

• Support intercompany billing, month‑end and year‑end close activities, including billing‑related journal entries and reconciliations.

• Ensure compliance with OTC controls, accounting policies, and regulatory requirements. Supporting internal and external audits.

Collections & Cash forecasting

• Perform structured follow‑ups with customers (phone/email) to ensure timely payments in line with contractual terms. Driving overdue reduction across assigned Legal Entities through proactive management of customer collections.

• Identify, analyze, and resolve payment‑impacting disputes, coordinating with PMs, Sales, and Local Finance to ensure timely resolution.

• Monitor AR performance, maintain accurate records, and perform AR, revenue, and ageing analysis.

• Participate in stakeholder meetings, propose corrective actions, and escalate AR‑related risks when required.

• Support cash forecasting by providing reliable AR data and trends, payment expectations and accurate information in systems

Credit Management

• Perform customer credit risk assessments using external credit tools and reports and recommend and monitor customer credit limits in line with internal policies.

• Monitor credit exposure, ensure timely reporting, and escalating risks as needed. Close collaboration with Sales and Local Finance to support effective credit decisions.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Solid financial background with hands‑on experience in Order‑to‑Cash processes, such as Billing, Cash Collections, and/or Credit Management. Experience in a Finance or Shared Services environment is a strong advantage.

• Experience within manufacturing, industrial, or project‑based environments is preferred.

• Robust knowledge and experience in billing processes is a plus.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken). Knowledge of French or Italian is a big plus.

• Strong understanding of the end‑to‑end Order‑to‑Cash cycle, including accounting principles, revenue recognition, and billing processes within Global Business Services or Finance Shared Services organizations.

• Highly proactive and ownership‑driven mindset: you anticipate issues, take initiative to resolve them, and follow through to completion without losing sight of priorities.

• Excellent analytical, problem‑solving, and decision‑making skills, with a structured, data‑driven and continuous‑improvement (Lean) approach to challenges.

• Strong focus on ownership of results: reliability in execution and delivery on commitments.

• Strong communication and stakeholder‑management skills; success in this role requires continuous interaction with project teams, Sales, and Finance stakeholders, including the ability to influence and align across teams.

• Experience working with ERP systems (e.g. SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, iScala or similar) is highly valued.

• Proficient in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participat

jobs.title: Winder/ Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Falkirk is a strategic investment site, built to be one of the most advanced rotating equipment service centres in the UK.

That investment is real — bigger machines, heavier lifts, and a 2 MW high‑voltage test bed that lets us fully load‑test motors and generators before they go back to site. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Dismantling, rewinding, rebuilding and testing AC and DC motors, including traction motors

• LV motor rewinds and full electro‑mechanical overhauls

• Strip, clean and prepare stators and armatures for rewinding

• Manufacture and fit coils to original design — random wound and formed coils

• Dip, bake and varnish windings using dip tanks or VPI where required

• Carry out static electrical tests and record results

• Basic mechanical fitting on associated equipment like pumps and gearboxes

What we’re looking for

• Time‑served Winder, Fitter or Electrical Machine Repair background

• Solid experience stripping, rewinding, assembling and testing AC/DC motors

• Comfortable in a mechanical / electrical workshop environment

• Can read drawings, follow procedures, and work methodically

• Takes pride in quality and doing the job right first time

• Formal qualifications help — hands‑on experience matters more.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
