jobs.title: Clean Line Operatives
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer GT Aero, we specialize in the repair, overhaul, and field service of industrial, marine, and power gas turbines. With over two decades of expertise, our team delivers tailored solutions to clients worldwide, ensuring reliability, performance, and rapid turnaround. From spare parts and consultancy to full turbine refurbishment, we’re the trusted partner for critical rotating equipment.

This role is based at our Netherley facility near Stonehaven in Aberdeenshire, a key hub for our turbine operations and customer support.

As a Process / Clean Line Operative, you’ll be responsible for preparing and cleaning turbine components to the highest standards, supporting the delivery of world-class engineering services. Job Responsibilities

• Clean and process turbine components using chemical tanks, grit blasting, vapour blasting, and hand cleaning.

• Operate specialist equipment such as ball burnishing machines.

• Maintain high standards of quality and safety in all tasks.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives within the workshop.

• Follow all health, safety, and environmental procedures.

Job Qualifications

• A flexible, team-oriented approach with the ability to work independently.

• Ability to follow technical instructions and safe working practices.

• Previous experience in a cleanline or workshop environment is preferred, but full training will be provided.

What we offer you

• A competitive hourly rate

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 9-day fortnight working pattern (every other Friday off)

• 33 days of annual leave

• Access to retail and entertainment discounts — including Costco membership

• Discounted personal car leasing for employees, family, and friends

• Confidential support via our Employee Assistance Programme

• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Gas Turbine Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer GT Aero, we specialize in the repair, overhaul, and field service of industrial, marine, and power gas turbines. With over two decades of expertise, our team delivers tailored solutions to clients worldwide, ensuring reliability, performance, and rapid turnaround. From spare parts and consultancy to full turbine refurbishment, we’re the trusted partner for critical rotating equipment.

This role is based at our Netherley facility near Stonehaven in Aberdeenshire, a key hub for our turbine operations and customer support.

Your Role:

As a Fitter, you’ll be responsible for the hands-on repair and overhaul of gas turbines, power turbines, and associated equipment. You’ll work as part of a skilled workshop team, ensuring high standards of engineering, safety, and documentation throughout the build process. Job Responsibilities

• Strip, inspect, sub-assemble, and rebuild turbine components.

• Accurately record critical measurements and report non-conformances.

• Maintain clean and organised workstations, ensuring tooling and chemicals are stored correctly.

• Complete all build documentation and submit for review.

• Support apprentice training and contribute to a culture of safety and quality.

• Input working hours into company systems and assist with non-conformance reporting

Job Qualifications

• Previous experience in a similar workshop or engineering role.

• Knowledge of gas turbine repair and refurbishment (advantageous).

• Experience in fabrication, repair, or construction environments.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Good communication and organisational skills.

• A team-oriented, adaptable approach.

What we offer you

• A competitive salary

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 9-day fortnight working pattern (every other Friday off)

• Annual performance-based bonus

• Private medical insurance

• 33 days of annual leave

• Access to retail and entertainment discounts — including Costco membership

jobs.title: Spares & Repairs Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer GT Aero, we are a recognised global leader in the maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) of aero‑derivative gas turbines. Our Netherley, Aberdeenshire facility is a centre of excellence, supporting customers worldwide with innovative, responsive and reliable solutions that keep critical equipment running. With continued investment and growth across the business, this is an exciting opportunity to join a high‑performing team and play a key role in supporting our spares and repairs operations.

We are looking for a Spares & Repairs Coordinator to support the effective handling of customer requests for spare parts and component repairs. In this role, you will work closely with customers, suppliers and internal teams to ensure enquiries are processed efficiently, quotations are prepared accurately, and orders are progressed smoothly from initial enquiry through to completion. You will be a vital part of the end‑to‑end process, helping deliver the high standards of service that Sulzer is known for globally. What you’ll be doing:

• Act as a first point of contact for customer spares and repairs enquiries, responding promptly and professionally

• Support the review of customer requirements with internal teams and external suppliers to confirm feasibility, lead times and costs

• Prepare accurate quotations for spares and repairs and issue them to customers in line with internal processes

• Coordinate orders from receipt through to completion, liaising with internal departments, suppliers and customers throughout

• Provide regular updates to customers, ensuring orders and repair activities are tracked and delivered on time

• Maintain accurate records within ERP and CRM systems, supporting reporting on order status, lead times and performance

• Assist with sales and tender activities where required, including preparing supporting information for spares and repairs opportunities

What you bring:

• Experience in a spares, repairs, aftermarket, coordination or customer support role within an engineering or industrial environment

• Experience using ERP and CRM systems (Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Salesforce experience is desirable)

• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively

• Good communication skills, confident working with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders

• Commercial awareness with an understanding of quotations, pricing and cost control

• A proactive, detail‑focused and solutions‑driven approach, with the ability to perform well in a fast‑paced environment

What we offer you

Joining Sulzer GT Aero means becoming part of a business with a strong reputation in the gas turbine sector, a clear growth strategy and a collaborative working culture. In return, we offer:

• Competitive base salary with participation in the company‑wide bonus programme

• 33 days’ annual leave (inclusive of bank holidays)

• Free on‑site parking

• Access to discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment and lifestyle services

• Confidential support through our Employee Assistance Programme

• Ongoing learning and development opportunities through on‑the‑job training and Sulzer Learning Pathways

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Expert is responsible for leading the design, development, and optimization of mechanical systems and components. This role provides expert-level technical leadership in mechanical engineering, ensuring that products meet performance, reliability, and cost targets. The expert collaborates across departments to drive innovation and resolve complex engineering challenges.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. 设置该岗位的目的:

This position is part of the Engineering department.
As a Structural Engineer, you will participate in Sulzer projects at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support etc.).
Structural Engineer reports to Engineering Manager.

主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Design and 3D modeling of main metal structures of skids.

• Calculation of main metal structures of skids

• Development of the drawings and other design documents within discipline

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Participate in the development of technical specifications for design, technical requirements for supply, etc.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Checking and approval documentation from subcontractors.

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline.

Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Civil Structure Engineering

• 8 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

Language

jobs.title: Master Planner
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Planner is responsible for scheduling and coordinating production activities to ensure timely delivery of products. This role works closely with procurement, manufacturing, and logistics to align production plans with demand forecasts and resource availability.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key Responsivities:

• Develop and maintain master production schedules based on sales targets, customer orders, and forecast demand.

• Analyze manufacturing capacity, workload, and resource utilization(labor, equipment) to identify constraints and bottlenecks.

• Collaborate with production, engineering and procurement teams to resolve scheduling conflicts and implement corrective actions.

• Monitor master schedule progress and adjust plans proactively to achieve sales target.

• Maintain accurate planning data, documentation, and generate regular performance reports(e.g., schedule adherence, capacity utilization).

• Continuously improve scheduling processes to increase efficiency, reduce lead times, and support lean manufacturing initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications:
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least of 3-4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.
Strong analytical and organizational skills. Experience with ERP/MRP systems. Knowledge of master planning and scheduling. Effective communication and collaboration abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities.

What we offer you

target bonus: 16.67% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Service Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Jr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery under close supervision. This entry-level role supports senior mechanics in diagnosing issues, performing basic repairs, and ensuring equipment is safe and operational.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration. Key Responsibilities:
- Diagnose, repair, and maintain ignition systems including control panels, coils, pickups, and wiring harnesses.
- Install, calibrate, and troubleshoot instrumentation such as pressure, temperature, and speed sensors.
- Perform functional testing and system validation to ensure proper engine performance and compliance with specifications.
- Interpret wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and technical manuals to support troubleshooting and installation activities.
- Conduct preventive maintenance and inspections on engines, compressors, and related equipment.
- Assist with engine startups, shutdowns, and commissioning activities.
- Identify root causes of system failures and implement corrective actions.
- Maintain accurate service records, calibration reports, and documentation.
- Ensure adherence to safety standards, company policies, and industry regulations.
- Collaborate with operations, engineering, and maintenance teams to optimize equipment reliability.

Required Qualifications:
- High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification or associate degree in instrumentation, electrical, or mechanical discipline preferred.
- Strong understanding of mechanical systems, including engines and rotating equipment.
- Working knowledge of electrical systems (AC/DC), sensors, and control circuits.
- Ability to read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
- Proficiency with diagnostic tools, multimeters, and calibration equipment.
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
- Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to job sites as required.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with natural gas engines and compressor packages.
- Familiarity with control systems (PLC/SCADA) and engine management systems.
- OEM training or certifications related to ignition or instrumentation systems.
- Knowledge of hazardous area classifications and safe work practices.

Physical Requirements:
- Ability to work in industrial environments, including exposure to noise, heat, and outdoor conditions.
- Capable of lifting up to 50 lbs and performing physically demanding tasks.
- Ability to climb ladders, work at heights, and in confined spaces.

Work Environment:
- Field-based role with travel to customer sites, including remote locations.
- May require on-call availability and extended work hours during outages or critical operations.

Key Competencies:
- Mechanical aptitude with cross-functional electrical/instrumentation skills
- Attention to detail and safety awareness
- Strong communication and teamwork
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Journey Level Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision. ​

• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates machines.

• Read and interpret procedures, work orders, and technical drawings to meet specifications.

• Apply knowledge of metals and alloys, including stainless and carbon steels.

• Improves set ups and methods for higher quality and improved cost.

• Operate overhead crane and forklifts safely as directed by Supervisor. Perform other duties as necessary.

• Maintain regular and reliable attendance.

• Maintains a safe, neat, and orderly workstation

• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required

• Communicate effectively to ensure smooth workflow transitions between team members.

• Support and assist coworkers, including training and collaboration.

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide safety program which includes following all safety policies and procedures

• Supports and cooperates in Sulzer Nuclear Quality Program

• Performs other duties as assigned

• Works overtime as requested

• Operates forklifts, overhead cranes, man lifts, and scissor lifts

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training.

• Minimum of five (5) years of experience in machining.

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspection.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.

• Basic math skills.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Ingenieur Qualite Projets
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Votre mission principale sera de vous assurer du respect des exigences qualité & sûreté nucléaire tout au long de la réalisation de la commande client (de la prise de commandes jusqu’à la livraison).

Activités significatives :

Chiffrage de l’appel d’offre / commandes
- Participer au chiffrage des heures qualité dans l’établissement de l’offre client.
- Analyser les spécifications clients et leur impact sur le déroulement de l’affaire.
- Etablir les documents qualité requis au moment de l’appel d’offres.
- Réaliser une analyse de risque de non-qualité de l’appel d’offres.

Une fois l’affaire prise en commande, au moment du lancement en fabrication
- Vérification et prise en compte des spécifications qualité.
- Elaboration et préparation de toute la documentation qualité (QCP, DSI, PQP, liste AIP).
- Réalisation du programme de surveillance fournisseur.

Pendant le déroulement de l’affaire
- Mise en œuvre du programme de surveillance fournisseur.
- Gestion de la surveillance client (réalisation des convocations, participation aux inspections, …).
- Validation des documents qualité fournisseurs.
- Vérification des documents qualité interne.
- Suivre et valider le traitement des Non Conformités.
- Participation aux analyses des causes profondes et proposition d’action d’amélioration.

Après la livraison client
- Elaborer les documents de fin d’affaires (RFF, RFR, RFI, inclus DCI).
- Suivre les réclamations clients et garanties.

Compétences requises :

Compétences métier – technique

• Connaissances générales en ingénierie des matériaux (différents aciers, forge, fonderie)

• Connaissances de l’environnement industriel et métallurgie (mécanique de précision, petites et moyennes séries).

• Compétences en CND (Contrôle Non Destructif)

• Compétences en procédés de fabrication de la métallurgie.

• Connaissance de la métrologie (documentation en fonction des normes, notions de mesure) vérification des PV de métrologies

• IWE classique (soudure)

• Connaissance des techniques d’audit et d’inspection

• Anglais courant

Compétences spécifiques au nucléaire

• Maîtrise du code RCCM

• Connaissances de la norme ISO 19443 (relative à la sûreté nucléaire)

• Compétences en sûreté nucléaire (HN3)

• Connaissances des méthodes de détection de fraude et de contrefaçon

What we offer you

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)

• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT

• et bien d'autres...

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Manager_South China
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Supervisor is responsible for overseeing a team of junior sales staff, ensuring daily sales operations run smoothly, and supporting the achievement of sales targets. This role provides coaching, monitors performance, and ensures compliance with company policies. Key Responsibilities

• Develop pump services sales in south of China and achieve the sales target.

• Supervise daily activities of the sales team.

• Assign tasks and monitor progress toward goals.

• Ensure adherence to sales processes and policies.

• Handle customer issues and escalate when necessary.

• Track and report team performance.

• Support implementation of sales initiatives.

Qualifications

• Typically a University degree and 5+ years of sales experience in pumps industry are minimally required.

• Good knowledge on pump technology and experience with pump service sales is preferred.

• Experience in sales or customer service supervision.

• Strong communication and leadership skills.

• Familiarity with CRM systems and sales reporting.

• Problem-solving and organizational abilities.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Tendering Lead is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting detailed analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This includes preparing technical sales briefings, evaluating customer specifications, and ensuring proposals meet quality standards.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key
• Responsibilities
Analyze customer requirements and prepare accurate technical proposals.
Estimate costs, resources, and timelines for customized product solutions.
Conduct technical briefings and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate with engineering and sales teams to ensure proposal feasibility.
Ensure compliance with company standards and customer expectations.
Support troubleshooting and initial training during implementation phases.

• Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 3–4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

Strong technical knowledge of industrial products and systems.
Experience in tendering, proposal development, and cost estimation.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Familiarity with CRM and ERP systems.

jobs.title: APT Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Application Engineering Lead is responsible for providing technical advice and support to sales teams, conducting technical analysis of product configurations, and ensuring customer-specific solutions meet technical and commercial requirements. This role includes preparing and delivering technical briefings, estimating costs and resources, and supporting implementation.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Prepare technical and commercial quotations; attend technical presentation and clarification meeting; technical appendix negotiation; attend commercial bidding and order negotiation, contract preparation / negotiation and risk control
• 2. Monitor / update project status in system regularly
• 3. Market Analysis and business promotion when needed
• 4. Internal handover meeting preparation
• 5. Assistant to attend column start up, plant test run and trouble shooting
• 6. Follow ISO procedure and Office 5s maintenance
• 7. Other tasks assigned by APT Manager/Team leader
• REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE
1. Minimum 1-3 years’ work experience as chemical engineer / plant engineer / process engineer in refinery, coal chemicals, environmental, petrochemicals, fine & specialty chemicals plant, with plant operation and DCS control practices will be more appreciated, or 1-3 years’ work experience as process engineer in engineering company in above mentioned market
• 2. Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering, Master's degree is preferred
• 3. Fluent in both oral & written English and Mandarin
• 4. Fluent use MS office such as WORD /EXECL /PowerPoint
• 5. Fluent use simulation software such as Pro-II or Aspen would be additional benefit
• 6. Customer oriented, Teamwork in mind, Strong committed to achieve results
• 7. Positive attitude, Open-minded, Good communication skills
• 8. Ready to work under pressure. Available for frequent traveling
• 9. Awareness to work in an international environment

What we offer you

jobs.title: Lead Piping Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Supervisor is responsible for supervising a team of mechanical engineers and support staff engaged in the design, development, and testing of mechanical systems and components. This role ensures that engineering projects are executed efficiently, meet technical and quality standards, and align with organizational goals. The supervisor also plays a key role in mentoring junior engineers, managing project timelines, and fostering innovation in mechanical design and manufacturing processes.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. 设置该岗位的目的:
Purpose of the Job:

As a Principal Piping Engineer, you will participate in Sulzer projects at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support etc.).
Principal Piping Engineer reports to the Chief Piping Engineer and/or Engineering Manager.
主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Take lead in overall piping design of skid

• Act as overall mechanical engineering IC in skid projects

• Train and guide piping engineers

• Design, 3D modeling and review of main metal structures of skids and modules

• Piping stress analysis

• Development of the drawings and other design documents within discipline

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Interface management

• Participate in the development of technical specifications for design, technical requirements for supply, etc.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Checking and approval documentation from subcontractors.

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline

• Participation in the project progress report development.

职位要求：
Qualifications:
Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Mechanical Engineering

• 10 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)

• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.

• Extensive experience in skid and modular design

• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction.

Language

• Fluent in Mandarin and English

Others

• Ability to work under tight deadlines with multiple tasks.

• Ability to work in multiple projects.

• Ability to travel on business trips including lengthy business trips to site during construction and commissioning.

What we offer you

target bonus：18.33% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Specialist is responsible for researching, designing, and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies advanced engineering knowledge to support the development and testing of mechanical and electromechanical systems.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. 设置该岗位的目的:
Purpose of the Job:

As a Senior E&I Engineer, you will participate at the Sulzer projects execution at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support and et.) within discipline and responsible.
Senior E&I Engineer reports to the Chief E&I Engineer and/or Engineering Manager.

主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Execute detail engineering of instrument design for process plant modular skids, including wiring line diagrams, instruments, panel and PLC control specifications.

• Prepare technical specifications for inquiry, issuing requisition for instruments, related items and subcontracting work.

• Preparation and design of Piping and Instrumentation Diagram, in conjunction with Process Engineers

• Preparation of process plant operating control philosophy, including alarm and interlocking trip matrix in conjunction with Process Engineers

• Develop SIS, SIF and SIL

• Participate in HAZOP for process plant

• Review and approve subcontractor engineering documents, including instrument calculation, selection and PLC programming subcontractor.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Technical support for costing of skid projects.

• Support receiving inspection of project E&I items.

• Technical support for workshop skid assembly.

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Interface management between disciplines

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline

• Participation in the project progress report development.

职位要求：
Qualifications:
Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Electrical/ Instrumentation Engineering

• 10 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)

• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.

• Good knowledge of skid and modular design

• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction.

Language

• Fluent in Mandarin and English

• Ability to work in multiple projects.

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer

titleByLocale.it: Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Ingegnere
titleByLocale.en: Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Chaîne d'approvisionnement Management & Purchasing Ingénieur

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Procurement Supervisor is responsible for supervising procurement professionals and ensuring the effective sourcing and acquisition of goods and services. This includes managing supplier relationships and ensuring compliance with procurement policies.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. The Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer is responsible for driving strategic sourcing while applying procurement engineering expertise in Supply Chain Management. The role focuses on identifying and securing cost‑optimized products and services required for Process Solutions’ own production and project execution.

Depending on workload, this position will be assigned to functions in the Strategic Sourcing, Vendor Management and Advanced Procurement function. The role works closely with all cross‑functional teams across the organization, supporting their sourcing needs to ensure timely, cost‑effective, and quality‑compliant delivery aligned with project and business objectives.

A background in EPC environments is an advantage, along with experience in site procurement, construction, or working within an engineering‑driven setting. Exposure to international procurement is also a plus.

设置该岗位的目的:

The Senior SCM & Purchasing Engineer is responsible for driving strategic sourcing while applying procurement engineering expertise in Supply Chain Management. The role focuses on identifying and securing cost‑optimized products and services required for Process Solutions’ own production and project execution.

主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Identify and develop qualified best-fit suppliers for various demands of engineered equipment, materials, subcontracting need for Sulzer packages

• Conduct market research, TCO analysis (within Sulzer Scope coverage), and supply chain risk assessments.

• Support sourcing initiatives on product line development and source for the most cost‑effective sources.

• Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of industry trends, technologies, and supplier capabilities, lesson learns to support team innovation

• Vendor Management

• Evaluate, qualify, and assess suppliers' technical capability, quality standards, and capacity Manage supplier performance, conduct audits, and drive corrective actions where needed. Maintain accurate supplier records (credentials, ISO, Financial, audit records, performance in Sulzer digital dashboard, and other files. Support Quality team in the corrective actions for in case of NCR and tracking of COPQ

• Project Procurement Support (when activated)

• Will be working in Advanced Procurement team while collaborate with Engineering, Quality, Project Management, Workshop to meet project procurement needs and timelines. Provide regular procurement status reports, risk assessments, and mitigation plans. Manage end-to-end procurement cycle including RFQ’s, commercial bid evaluations. Lead negotiations to achieve competitive pricing, favorable terms, while aligned to the total cost of ownership (within Sulzer scope). Issue purchase orders, monitor order progress for buy outs, work with Quality and Project Manag

jobs.title: Senior Piping Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Specialist is responsible for researching, designing, and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies advanced engineering knowledge to support the development and testing of mechanical and electromechanical systems.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. 设置该岗位的目的:
Purpose of the Job:

As a Senior Piping Engineer, you will participate in Sulzer projects at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support etc.).
Senior Piping Engineer reports to the Chief Piping Engineer and/or Engineering Manager.

主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Design and 3D modeling of main metal structures of skids and modules

• Piping stress analysis

• Development of the drawings and other design documents within discipline

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Interface management

• Participate in the development of technical specifications for design, technical requirements for supply, etc.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Checking and approval documentation from subcontractors.

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline

• Participation in the project progress report development.

职位要求：
Qualifications:
Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Mechanical Engineering

• 8 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)

• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.

• Extensive experience in skid and modular design

• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction.

Language

• Fluent in Mandarin and English
Others

• Ability to work under tight deadlines with multiple tasks.

• Ability to work in multiple projects.

• Ability to travel on business trips including lengthy business trips to site during construction and commissioning.

What we offer you

target bonus：18.33% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: ESH Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The ESH Engineer is responsible for supporting basic environmental, safety, and health activities, including inspections, data collection, and compliance monitoring. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Main tasks and responsibilities:
- Implement applicable national workplace safety laws and regulations, standards and specifications, and the company’s safety management system; implement the safety production responsibility system.
- Conduct daily on-site safety inspections and hazard identification and rectification. Focus on high-risk activities such as machinery operations, welding, chemical use, dust-related work, working at height, hot work, temporary electrical work, and heavy lifting/handling.
- Supervise workers correct wearing and use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and promptly stop the “three violations” (unauthorized command, unsafe/unauthorized operation, and violation of work discipline).
- Organize three-level safety induction training for new employees, pre-job/toolbox safety briefings, special safety training, and emergency drills to enhance safety awareness and emergency response capability.
- Participate in permit-to-work approvals and on-site monitoring for hazardous operations; verify work conditions, control measures, and personnel qualifications to ensure compliant execution.
- Conduct periodic inspection, maintenance, and management of fire-fighting facilities, emergency equipment, and protective supplies to ensure they are in good condition and effective.
- Improve safety signs, warning boards, and safety communication materials, and promote on-site safety culture.
- Participate in the investigation and handling of safety incidents/accidents; perform root-cause analysis, record and report findings, and track implementation of corrective actions.
- Establish and maintain safety records, inspection logs, training files, and hazard rectification closure records to ensure they are standardized and complete.
- Complete other workplace safety management tasks assigned by supervisors.

What we offer you

target bonus：15% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer’s Leeds facility is a global centre of excellence for advanced design and manufacturing, specialising in OEM pump technology and engineered solutions for critical industrial applications. This site brings together cutting-edge engineering capability, digital design, and high-precision manufacturing, supporting sectors such as energy, water, chemicals, and infrastructure.

With significant recent investment, our Leeds operations are evolving rapidly—enhancing our capabilities in advanced machining, digital engineering, testing, and product innovation. This is where new business pumps are brought to life from cradle to grave—from initial concept and design through to manufacture, testing, delivery, and lifecycle support. We are seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of complex, high-value pump projects within our new business portfolio. You will play a critical role in managing the end-to-end project lifecycle, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and manage multiple concurrent projects across the full lifecycle – from bid handover through design, manufacturing, and final delivery

• Act as the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring strong relationships and clear communication

• Drive project planning, scheduling, risk management, and cost control

• Coordinate cross-functional teams including design engineering, production, procurement, and quality

• Ensure compliance with contractual, technical, and regulatory requirements

• Identify and manage risks and opportunities, implementing mitigation strategies

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience as a Project Manager within engineering, manufacturing, or OEM environments

• Strong knowledge of complex mechanical equipment, ideally pumps or rotating equipment

• Demonstrated experience delivering high-value, technically complex projects

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

• Strong commercial awareness, including budget control and contract management

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment

• Project management qualification (e.g. PRINCE2, PMP) desirable

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• Competitive base salary

• Annual bonus, based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance through Aviva

• 33 days’ annual leave

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

Community & Wellbeing

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Project Assistant is responsible for supporting project teams by maintaining schedules, tracking resources, and preparing progress reports. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy in routine tasks and provides coordination support across multiple projects.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Internal Mapping Note - HR TO REMOVE PRIOR TO POSTING!

This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key
• Responsibilities
Maintain and update project schedules and resource plans.
Prepare and distribute project status and progress reports.
Coordinate meetings, documentation, and communication among project stakeholders.
Support project tracking and issue resolution processes.
Assist in maintaining project documentation and compliance records.
Skills &
• Qualifications
Typically requires vocational training (or equivalent experience) and several years of relevant work experience to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

Strong organizational and time management skills.
Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Excel).
Effective communication and coordination abilities.
Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks.
Familiarity with project documentation and reporting standards.

jobs.title: NDT Inspector
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The NDT Inspector is responsible for ensuring that product quality specifications are in compliance with corporate and customer standards. This includes supporting the implementation of QA/QC policies, conducting inspections, and assisting in vendor evaluations.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Key Responsibilities

• Inspect products to ensure compliance with quality specifications and standards.

• Support the implementation of QA/QC policies and procedures.

• Assist in evaluating vendor quality and performance.

• Document inspection results and report deviations.

• Collaborate with QA/QC teams and vendors to enforce quality standards.

• Skills & Qualifications

• May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

• Basic understanding of quality control procedures and tools.

• Attention to detail and accuracy in inspection tasks.

• Ability to follow established procedures and report findings.

• Familiarity with product specifications and documentation.

• Willingness to learn and support quality assurance initiatives.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Deliver annual Order Intake targets, ensuring both revenue and expected margin objectives are met.

• To plan and undertake regular customer visits, maximizing enquiry generation and driving order intake to deliver the growth plan.

• Prepare, submit and follow up all enquiries to customers in a timely and professionally manner.

• Ensure that defined long-term and short-term objectives, strategies and plans are achieved.

• Follow-up regularly on submitted proposals and to update in Sulzer Customer Relationship Management system.

• Co-ordinate projects with Head Office, Regional Offices and Agents, as applicable.

• Provide regular reporting on market, projects, market analysis and sales forecasts.

• Ensure that all business activities conform to local laws and regulations and are following company policies and procedures.

• Any other duties that are assigned by superiors.

Competencies and behaviour required

• Frequent travel to domestic customers

• Fluent in written & spoken English in addition to local language

• Excellent interpersonal skills, initiative and proactive.

• Good communicator and good leadership skills.

• · Good negotiation, planning, coordination & monitoring skills.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Bachelor degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from reputable university.

• Minimum 5 years process equipment selling in Oil & Gas / Oleochemical Industry.

• Proven track record in achieving YoY (Year on Year) sales growth with strong penetration and success in Indonesia Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals & Oleochemical segment.

• Strong network of established contacts with decision makers / influencers in end user and engineering companies from Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals & Oleochemical market will be advantageous.

• Experience working with international, multi-ethnic and cultural teams.

What we offer you

Career Opportunities
Saving Plan
Medical Benefit

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

titleByLocale.it: Esperto senior di marketing e comunicazione

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Marketing & Communications Sr. Expert is responsible for managing complex communication and marketing projects that support the organization’s strategic goals. This role ensures consistent messaging, brand alignment, and effective engagement with internal and external stakeholders. Key Responsibilities

• Lead the development and execution of marketing and communication strategies.

• Manage brand positioning and ensure consistency across all channels.

• Oversee content creation for campaigns, events, and executive communications.

• Collaborate with business units to align messaging with strategic priorities.

• Analyze campaign performance and recommend improvements.

• Mentor junior team members and ensure quality standards.

• Skills & Qualifications

Qualifications

• Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 8–10 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

• Expertise in corporate communications, branding, and marketing.

• Strong leadership and project management skills.

• Excellent writing, editing, and presentation abilities.

• Experience with digital marketing platforms and analytics tools.

jobs.title: Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Student, Apprentice, or Intern is responsible for supporting administrative or operational tasks while gaining practical experience. This role follows specific instructions and procedures and is designed to provide learning opportunities in a structured environment. SUMMARY:
The Engineering Intern works closely with the engineering department to assist with technical projects, design tasks, manufacturing processes, analysis, and documentation to gain practical, hands-on industry experience in nuclear rotating equipment design, manufacturing, and refurbishment.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTION:

• Provide technical support for projects, including design, testing, and engineering calculations.

• Assist in creating and modifying drawings or models using CAD software.

• Support process improvement efforts.

• Assist in creating technical reports, manuals, and documentation for projects.

• Interface with cross-functional teams (quality, manufacturing) to solve problems.

SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and Environmental Safety & Health (ESH) Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Currently enrolled as a Junior or Senior in an accredited B.S. program in Mechanical Engineering.

• Basic understanding of engineering principles, calculations, and design software.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) and CAD tools.

• Eagerness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.

What we offer you

What we offer:

• 401k with 6% company match

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior QC Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Ensures quality and technical compliance in servicing rotating equipment, including pumps, turbines, and compressors. Ensures adherence to Sulzer OEM, customer, and international standards, while supporting inspections, repair solutions, and quality procedures. Provides technical feedback, prepares inspection reports, and develops and implements required standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct incoming, in-process, and final inspections of rotating equipment and components.

• Prepare and review overhaul reports with technical recommendations.

• Develop work instructions, drawings, and repair methods based on findings.

• Maintain job packs, checklists, inspection records, and SOPs.

• Prepare and execute Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) with stakeholders.

• Provide technical quality support, including WPS/PQR review and material selection.

• Perform dimensional, geometric, and disassembly inspections.

• Manage NCRs, including RCA, CAPA, and lessons learned.

• Coordinate and oversee NDT and specialized testing with third parties.

• Ensure calibration, control, and traceability of inspection equipment.

• Support operations/projects, including progress updates and resolving technical issues.

• Train staff on quality standards and support LEAN and continuous improvement.

• Ensure compliance with EHS, quality procedures, and 5S practices.

• Promote a safe, clean, and positive work environment.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering

• Minimum of 7 years of experience in a similar or related role

• Strong centrifugal pump background required; compressor/turbine experience is an advantage.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, manuals, and technical specifications

• Experience in procedure development and NCR handling

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Safely and efficiently disassemble, thoroughly inspect, and precisely build rotating equipment such as steam turbines, gas turbines, compressors, hot gas expanders, gear boxes and other machinery according to Sulzer’s established guidelines and safety protocols. Assembly Mechanic

Sulzer offers you a wealth of opportunities to drive your career into the direction that you want, depending on your skills and interests. We've been awarded a top employer nationwide for the past 3 years. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step!

We are looking for Assembly Mechanics to join our Core team in La Porte.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Safely and efficiently disassemble, thoroughly inspect, and precisely build rotating equipment such as steam turbines, gas turbines, compressors, hot gas expanders, gear boxes and other machinery according to Sulzer’s established guidelines and safety protocols.

• Conduct thorough visual inspections of disassembled components, identifying wear, damage, or abnormalities that may affect equipment performance.

• Utilize precision measuring instruments, such as micrometers, dial indicators, and bore gauges, to take accurate measurements and assess dimensional integrity of parts.

• Operate overhead cranes, torches, grinders, and forklifts when required.

• Prepare detailed inspection reports documenting findings and measurements.

• Execute unit assembly of repaired or replaced components, following technical specifications and quality standards.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• 3 years of hands-on, shop oriented experience turbomachinery repair preferred.

• High mechanical aptitude and experience in detailed mechanic industries (turbines, compressors, rotating equipment)

• Willingness to work overtime when necessary.

• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Job Summary

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Repair various kinds of electro-mechanical equipment. PHOENIX, ARIZONA, USA

RESPONSIBILTIES

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.

• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.

• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.

• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.

• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.

• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.

• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.

• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor

QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Basic mechanical aptitude

• Ability to understand, perform and retain various skill related training and operational and safety procedures demonstrated by supervisor.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.

About the role

Use specialized machinery for industrial welding and oversee machines that perform the same job. Maintain and repair all machinery. Assess welded surfaces, structures and components to identify errors. Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes. PHOENIX, ARIZONA, USA

• Maintain proper training certification (GTAW, SMAW, SAW, GTAW Aluminum, etc.)

• Be capable of reading all prints issued to welding department

• Accurately follow welding instructions to provide quality welds within the appropriate approved methods

• Ability to use and operate overhead cranes, torches, grinders and forklifts

• Work closely and communicate clearly with the other departments, Weld personnel, Supervisor and Lead Man

The ideal candidate will possess the following:

• Knowledge and understand of electro machinery repair.

• Must have the required tools to perform their expected tasks.

• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments.

• Must be able to work overtime when necessary.

• Must have 3 years or more of proven welding experience.

jobs.title: Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead Machine Operator is responsible for overseeing the operation of machinery and equipment on the production floor, ensuring optimal performance and adherence to safety and quality standards. This role provides guidance to other machine operators and supports troubleshooting and maintenance activities.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. The following job description and duties are not meant to be all encompassing of the assigned duties. Due to business demands, job duties are variable by nature and subject to revisions, additions or deletions as may be determined and directed by Management or Supervision.
SUMMARY:
Sets up and operates machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
· Performs layouts, sets up, and operates conventional machine tools as required
· Reads and interprets all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing
· Designs setups and methods where none exist
· Instructs other shop personnel in proper machining techniques
· Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs
QUALIFICATIONS:
· Completion of a machinist apprentice program or hands on training
.G code programming is a plus
· Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections
· Demonstrated ability to effectively set up all, or at least most, of the following machines: I.D./O.D. Grinder, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Knee Mill, Radial Drill, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, and Planer Mill
· Ability to perform with a minimum of direct supervision
· Working knowledge of tool geometry and application
· Working knowledge of effects of feeds and speeds
·At least 4 years experience in machine shops on the above equipment
· Willingness to work in a team environment
· Ability to work overtime as required
PHYSICAL DEMANDS
· While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.
· Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Coordenador de Contratos PL
HR Representative
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The HR Sr. Officer is responsible for delivering HR services and supporting day-to-day HR operations. This role assists in recruitment, onboarding, and employee support, ensuring compliance with policies and procedures.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The HR Representative provides hands-on operational and administrative support to the HRBP team, ensuring efficient execution of core HR processes. This role focuses on reducing transactional workload, improving data accuracy, and supporting payroll and HR systems processes so HRBPs can focus on strategic business initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as day to day HR Support for assigned employee base

• Act as the primary support resource for HRBPs, assisting with day-to-day operational tasks

• Prepare and execute HR transactions in Workday and other systems (e.g., job changes, compensation updates, transfers)

• Draft communications and documentation to support business and HR initiatives

• Ensure timely follow-up on HR action items and requests

• Serve as a liaison between HRBPs and Payroll to support accurate and timely processing

• Validate data changes between HRIS (e.g., Workday) and payroll systems (e.g., ADP) to ensure alignment

• Reduce manual rework by leveraging reporting and system tools to capture employee changes

• Identify discrepancies and escalate issues proactively for resolution

• Support efforts to streamline payroll-related processes and minimize duplicate tracking

• Run and analyze standard reports (e.g., change reports, headcount, audit reports)

• Monitor data integrity across HR systems and address inconsistencies

• Support audits and compliance checks related to employee data and payroll

• Respond to employee and manager inquiries related to HR processes, pay, benefits, and data

• Provide guidance on system use (e.g., Workday self-service)

• Escalate complex or sensitive issues to HR Manager as needed
Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field

• Minimum 3 years of HR, payroll, or HR operations experience

• Hands-on experience with HRIS systems (Workday preferred) and payroll systems (ADP or similar)

• Strong attention to detail and data accuracy skills
Key Competencies

• Operational excellence and process-oriented mindset

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to manage high-volume, detail-driven work

• Clear and professional communication skills

• Collaboration and customer service orientation
Preferred Experience

• Exposure to payroll processes, audits, and data reconciliation

• Experience driving process improvements or system adoption

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In dieser Schlüsselrolle verantworten Sie den Vertrieb technisch anspruchsvoller Lösungen im deutschen Markt. Sie betreuen bestehende Kunden, identifizieren neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und begleiten Projekte von der ersten Kundenansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss. Ihre Aufgaben:

• Verantwortung für den Vertrieb technisch anspruchsvoller Lösungen im deutschen Markt

• Betreuung und Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen sowie aktive Neukundengewinnung

• Steuerung des gesamten Vertriebsprozesses von der Erstansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss

• Aufbau und Pflege einer belastbaren Sales-Pipeline inklusive Forecasting und CRM-Management

• Technische und kaufmännische Beratung von Kunden sowie Übersetzung von Anforderungen in passgenaue Lösungen

• Durchführung von Kundenbesuchen, Präsentationen und Produkt- bzw. Lösungsdemonstrationen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, Service-, Projektmanagement- und Produktteams

• Unterstützung bei Angebotskalkulationen, technischen Konzepten und Ausschreibungen

• Analyse von Markt‑, Wettbewerbs- und Technologietrends sowie Einbringen von Marktfeedback

• Mitwirkung an Vertriebsplanung, Zieldefinition und strategischen Vertriebsthemen

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (z. B. Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen) oder kaufmännischer Hintergrund mit starker technischer Expertise

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, idealerweise in Energie, Schwerindustrie, Oil & Gas oder Power Generation

• Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis und Erfahrung im Umgang mit technischen Spezifikationen

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations‑ und Verhandlungsstärke sowie hohe Kundenorientierung

• Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und starke Abschlussorientierung

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

• Hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb des Vertriebsgebiets sowie gelegentlich international

What we offer you

• Mitarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld mit enger Zusammenarbeit mit Technik und Engineering

• Attraktives Gesamtpaket mit fixem Gehalt und leistungsbezogenen Bonusanteilen

• Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung und zum Ausbau der eigenen Vertriebsexpertise

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Very good German knowledge and good English skills
