jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As an HR Specialist, you will be involved in employee lifecycle administration, HR compliance, recruitment, and broader HR initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity for an HR professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is eager to contribute to a culture of excellence and engagement.

Key Responsibilities

• Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases, ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.

• Support HR projects and initiatives, such as performance management cycles, training activities, and employee engagement programs.

• Ensure full compliance with French labor legislation and internal HR standards.

• Assist with end-to-end recruitment and onboarding, including posting job ads, screening CVs, coordinating interviews, and preparing new hire documentation.

• Respond to employee queries related to HR policies, procedures, and benefits.

• Prepare HR reports and analyze workforce data to identify trends and propose improvements.

• Assist with payroll preparation and related administrative processes.

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Minimum of 2 years’ experience in an HR generalist or specialist role, ideally within an industrial or manufacturing environment.

• Strong understanding of Moroccan labor law and HR best practices.

• Proficiency in HRIS systems (e.g., Workday) and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal abilities.

• High level of professionalism and the ability to manage confidential information with discretion.

• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

• Fluency in French and English is required.

What we offer you

• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.

• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits: EID allowance (“prime mouton”), Meal allowance , Retirement contribution

• Healthcare coverage

• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry.

• Potential to increase the contract to full time

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for designing and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies engineering knowledge to support the planning, testing, and implementation of mechanical and electromechanical systems.The individual with this position will have to split their time in-between the engineering team objectives, field service, field service reports and shop engineering support. This engineering position will entail a dual role with hands-on-responsibilities along with other engineering tasks. It is expected that the individual will need training as part of on-boarding process and Sulzer will accommodate. Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical support and assistance on customer requests - on phone and on site.

• Carry out unplanned on-site services and troubleshooting on electrical installation incl. electrical rotating equipment (motors and generators).

• Prepare and perform planned preventive maintenance checks (PM) on electrical machines incl. AC/DC motors and generators, using applicable tools.

• Receive and study any relevant engineering documents related to a project to formulate project roadmaps.

• Observe, follow and support all Safety Policies, Environmental Policies and ISO Procedures

• Manages and oversees tasks as assigned by O.L.s.

• Responsible for developing innovative processes and procedures using the latest technologies to support business growth.

• Attend weekly production meetings.

• Help develop field service procedures for various fault case scenarios.

• Maintain accurate and up to date notes of the projects FSE is involved and furnish reports as required immediately after the conclusion of the project or as requested by the customer.

• Communicate with the O.L.s, and field service team members, as necessary regarding the progress of a project.

• Immediately follow up on customer requests by doing the need-full to resolve the issue in the most efficient way possible.

• Be part of the quick response team, to provide service/updates to the customers as soon as possible.

• Stay in constant communication with O.L. to be able to assist in shop projects as required .

• To learn repair procedures which may be task specific from the Senior Colleagues and implement and improve on it.

• To communicate to the team as required regarding customer specific directives on milestones to be achieved in a course of the project.

• Must be enthusiastic to cross the boundaries of current technical expertise to learn more.

• Role will involve travel to customer sites for diagnosis and repair.

Qualifications:

• 4 years' experience in the following field of electrical engineering.

• Electric motor, generators repairs and design.

• Transformer repair and design

• Switch gear design and diagnostics

• Power Semiconductors

• Proficient in basic power theory,

• Know how in the following topics

• Operations of induction motors

• Operations of synchronous motors

• Transformer principle

• Operation of semiconductors.

• Winding Insulation Tests

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro L'ingegnere elettrico è responsabile della progettazione e dello sviluppo di sistemi e componenti meccanici. Questo ruolo applica conoscenze ingegneristiche per supportare la pianificazione, il test e l'implementazione di sistemi meccanici ed elettromeccanici. L'individuo con questa posizione dovrà dividere il loro tempo tra gli obiettivi del team di ingegneria, il servizio sul campo, i rapporti di servizio sul campo e il supporto tecnico del negozio. Questa posizione ingegneristica comporterà un duplice ruolo con responsabilità pratiche e altri compiti di ingegneria. Si prevede che l'individuo avrà bisogno di formazione come parte del processo di on-boarding e Sulzer accoglierà. Principali responsabilità
• Fornire assistenza tecnica e assistenza sulle richieste dei clienti - al telefono e sul sito.
• Eseguire i servizi in loco non pianificati e la risoluzione dei problemi sull'installazione elettrica incl. apparecchiature elettriche rotanti (motori e generatori).
• Preparare ed eseguire controlli preventivi previsti (PM) sulle macchine elettriche incl. Motori e generatori AC/DC, utilizzando strumenti applicabili.
• Ricevere e studiare tutti i documenti di ingegneria rilevanti relativi a un progetto per formulare roadmap di progetto.
• Osservare, seguire e sostenere tutte le politiche di sicurezza, le politiche ambientali e le procedure ISO
• Gestisce e supervisiona le attività assegnate da O.L.s.
• Responsabile per lo sviluppo di processi e procedure innovative utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie per sostenere la crescita aziendale.
• Partecipare a riunioni settimanali di produzione.
• Aiutare a sviluppare procedure di servizio sul campo per vari scenari di caso di guasto.
• Mantenere note accurate e aggiornate dei progetti FSE è coinvolto e fornire report come richiesto subito dopo la conclusione del progetto o come richiesto dal cliente.
• Comunicare con gli O.L. e i membri del team di assistenza sul campo, se necessario per quanto riguarda il progresso di un progetto.
• Seguire immediatamente le richieste dei clienti facendo il necessario per risolvere il problema nel modo più efficiente possibile.
• Partecipa al team di risposta rapida, per fornire assistenza/aggiornamento ai clienti il prima possibile.
• Rimanere in costante comunicazione con O.L. per essere in grado di assistere in progetti di negozio come richiesto .
• Per imparare le procedure di riparazione che possono essere attività specifiche dai Colleghi Senior e implementare e migliorare su di esso.
• comunicare al team come richiesto per quanto riguarda le direttive specifiche del cliente sulle pietre miliari da raggiungere in un corso del progetto.
• Deve essere entusiasta di attraversare i confini delle attuali competenze tecniche per saperne di più.
• Role coinvolgerà il viaggio ai siti dei clienti per la diagnosi e la riparazione. Qualifiche:
• 4 anni di esperienza nel campo seguente dell'ingegneria elettrica.
• Motore elettrico, riparazioni di generatori e progettazione.
• riparazione e progettazione del trasformatore
• Progettazione e diagnostica di ingranaggi commutatori
• Semiconduttori di potenza
• Proficiente nella teoria del potere di base,
• Sapere come nei seguenti argomenti
• Operazioni di motori ad induzione
• Operazioni di motori sincroni
• Principio del trasformatore
• Operazione di semiconduttori.
• Test di isolamento dell'avvolgimento Cosa ti offriamo
• 15 giorni di riposo e 12 giorni festivi
• Piano 401k con partita del 6%
• Piano sanitario completo tra cui medico, dentale, visione, vita, disabilità a breve e a lungo termine
• Conto di risparmio sanitario corrispondente
• Programma benessere stimolante
• Programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Stellenbeschreibung Der Elektroingenieur ist für das Entwerfen und Entwickeln mechanischer Systeme und Komponenten verantwortlich. Diese Rolle wendet Ingenieurwissen an, um die Planung, Erprobung und Implementierung mechanischer und elektromechanischer Systeme zu unterstützen. Die Person mit dieser Position muss ihre Zeit zwischen den Zielen des Ingenieurteams, dem Außendienst, den Außendienstberichten und dem Support für die Werkstatt aufteilen. Diese Engineering-Position wird eine Doppelrolle mit praktischen Verantwortlichkeiten zusammen mit anderen Engineering-Aufgaben beinhalten. Es wird erwartet, dass der Einzelne im Rahmen des On-Boarding-Prozesses eine Schulung benötigt und Sulzer wird dies berücksichtigen. Hauptzuständigkeiten
• Bieten Sie technischen Support und Unterstützung bei Kundenanfragen - telefonisch und vor Ort.
• Durchführung ungeplanter Vor-Ort-Services und Fehlerbehebung bei der Elektroinstallation inkl. elektrische Drehvorrichtungen (Motoren und Generatoren).
• Vorbereitung und Durchführung geplanter vorbeugender Wartungskontrollen (PM) an elektrischen Maschinen inkl. Wechselstrom-/Gleichstrommotoren und -generatoren unter Verwendung geeigneter Werkzeuge.
• Erhalten und studieren Sie alle relevanten technischen Dokumente im Zusammenhang mit einem Projekt, um Projekt-Roadmaps zu formulieren.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Southern California Area Sales Manager (ASM) is the primary external representative of Sulzer’s Electro Mechanical Services (EMS) and is financially responsible for the Order Intake, Gross Profit Margin, and Operating Net Cash-Flow. You will engage clients and promote/represent Sulzer’s RES businesses (Pumps and Turbo) to provide full RES Services to Southern California. You will prospect new sales opportunities with clients from first contact to the closure of orders and/or until projects have been completed. You will work closely with other Sulzer teams including Inside Sales, Business Process, Operations, Engineering, Finance, QC, Safety, and HR to secure, ship, and invoice profitable orders. Responsibilities:

• Meet or exceed the Order Intake budget for the assigned area/product line

• Develop, sell and maintain all business responsibilities for the assigned area/product line

• Develop and implement sales strategies consistent with the goals of Sulzer

• Plan, support and monitor sales activity within the area/product line

• Develop and deliver technical and commercially superior proposals to the client

• Support all business activities with the client thru closing and invoicing

• Develop, maintain and report accurate sales forecasts

• Review of RFPs, contracts, POs and terms for all business opportunities

• Control all business expenses as if they were your own

• Be proficient with and maintain Salesforce: opportunities, outage tracking and market condition events, trip call reports and competition updates

• Coordinate, plan, attend and execute promotional trade shows events

• Participate in quarterly sales calls or meetings with the management team

• This position requires and expects frequent travel into the area assigned.

• Support Sulzer strategic initiatives on safety, business, ethics and quality.

• Present a positive, proactive, professional attitude and appearance at all times.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Business is preferred.

• 5+ years of industry knowledge and experience with Electric Motors and Generators.

• Previous experience of proactively influencing or closing business with clients, co-workers and/or commercial peers.

• In-depth knowledge of Motors, generators and learn Sulzer’s complete product line

• Must be able to understand, interpret and discuss technical and commercial documents.

• High personal standards of character. Must have impeccable moral and ethical behavior.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to read, write and discuss micro details and macro situations, as well as the inter-personal skills to interface with personnel from diverse backgrounds at all levels of our clients organization.

• Willing to travel frequently and bring business back as a result.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously as well as the ability to willingly work with demanding deadlines

• Understanding of basic financial statements

• Proficiency at or the ability to quickly learn how to use Salesforce.

• Proficient use of other Microsoft office applications such as WORD, EXCEL, POWER POINT, et al, to support selling activities

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days

• Car Allowance and company credit card

• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• 401k with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs. Based on company performance and individual performance.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer

jobs.title: Strategic Initiatives - Senior Executive
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Quality Specialist is responsible for managing quality-related projects and processes with limited supervision. This includes coaching junior professionals, conducting investigations, and ensuring compliance with quality standards.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Purpose of the job

To design, integrate, and sustain long‑term capability health across Sales and Operations by creating end‑to‑end capability systems that enable consistent performance, adaptability, and future growth.

This role is accountable for architecting (not just executing) frameworks for assessment, development, transition, and continuous improvement—grounded in real operational and commercial work and scalable across the region.

Main tasks and responsibilities
1. Capability Architecture & Design

• Design role‑based capability frameworks across Sales and Operations, including:
• Core capabilities

• Proficiency levels

• Observable behaviors and outcomes

• Ensure frameworks support progression and knowledge transfer over time.
2. Assessment & Diagnostic Frameworks

• Design practical, credible assessment approaches that reflect real job performance

• Ensure assessment outputs inform development priorities, role readiness, and transitions
3. Learning & Enablement Architecture

• Design learning journeys and enablement models that support capability progression, not just content delivery

• Define the right balance of on‑the‑job learning, coaching, and formal training
4. Transition & Progression Design
Design readiness and transition criteria for role changes, increased complexity, and leadership pathways.
5. Sales Excellence & Commercial Capability

• Apply capability design principles to Sales Excellence topics, including:
• Sales capability models aligned to growth vectors

• Enablement of value‑based and solution selling

• Sales manager coaching capability

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• BSc degree in Engineering, Technical Education, HR Development, or related field

• Having Minimum 5-8 years experience in technical training or competency development.

• Experience in implementing competency frameworks and managing trainer networks.

• Experience in consulting, business transformation, strategy

Competencies and Behavior required

• Performance management system operation

• Passion for workforce development and technical excellence.

• Analytical mindset with attention to detail in assessment and reporting.

• Ability to work across cultures and regions with adaptability.

• Familiarity with apprenticeship models and vocational education systems.

• Thinks in end‑to‑end systems, not isolated initiatives

• Comfortable designing frameworks that evolve over time Stakeholder management

What we offer you

.

jobs.title: Tendering Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility:

• Overall responsibility to ensure that initiated projects meet company requirements in terms of selection, pricing, terms and conditions and lead time. Ensure application of Sulzer tools and policies, procedures, codes of conduct and best practice guidelines

• Review inquiry documents/specifications and prepares quality quotations on time for Sulzer Pumps' products using current tendering tools & procedures independently or with guidance

• Analyzing customer requirements, particularly of complex applications and products for relevant market / application

• Independent development of suitable technical solutions with the involvement of specialist departments

• Consulting customers and the sales team on possible pump applications and in preparation of specifications, Configuration of pumps and accessories

• Enquiry and evaluation of subcontractor offers as well as corresponding expediting

• Co-operation with the plants in the Energy & Infrastructure Business Unit factory network

• Analysis and evaluation of commercial as well as technical risks of projects at the bidding stage, corresponding negotiations together with specialist departments as well as development of approaches to minimize risks in the event of an order

• Preparation and realization of presentations of technical offers

• Indirect management & co-ordination with multidisciplinary functions as part of the bid preparation

• Preparation of high-quality technical/commercial offers in line with market requirements

• Review quote received and challenge as necessary internal as well as external stakeholders to ensure a competitive proposal is submitted meeting Sales / market expectation

• Familiar with the risks and hazards within the activities and processes of the role and procedures, practices, and measures in place to mitigate the risks.

• Participation in sales negotiations, corresponding preparation, and follow-up in co-operation with sales department

• Attend clarification meetings with clients as required and provide all necessary support to Sales to ensure the offered solution meets specification/customer requirement while highlighting our competitive advantage

• Leading technical negotiations with subcontractors

• Ensuring a complete and successful order handover to project team

• Regular maintenance of our sales systems and the data contained therein

Work experience : >5 years
Expertise (e.g. professional, technical):

• Successfully completed technical studies (ideally mechanical engineering, industrial engineering or process engineering or equal)

• Structured way of working, ability to break down complex issues together with the bid team

• Experience in at least one of the following disciplines: pump design, international tender or sales, project management or equivalent

• Ideally intercultural competences

• Sound knowledge of pumps or rotating equipment and accessories

What we offer you

Medical insurance for self and family
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Empl

Garantire l'applicazione degli strumenti e delle politiche del Sulzer, delle procedure, dei codici di condotta e delle linee guida sulle migliori pratiche - Rivedere documenti/specifiche di ricerca e preparare preventivi di qualità in tempo utile per i prodotti delle pompe del Sulzer utilizzando strumenti e procedure di gara in corso indipendentemente o con orientamento - Analisi delle esigenze dei clienti, in particolare delle applicazioni complesse e dei prodotti per il mercato/applicazione rilevanti - Sviluppo indipendente di soluzioni tecniche adeguate con il coinvolgimento di reparti specializzati - Consultare i clienti e il team di vendita sulle possibili applicazioni delle pompe e nelle preparazione delle specifiche, Conforto n.288 di pompe e accessori - Richiesta e valutazione delle offerte di subappaltatore nonché corrispondente evasione - Cooperazione con gli impianti della rete di fabbrica Energy & Infrastructure Business Unit - Analisi e valutazione dei rischi commerciali e tecnici dei progetti in fase di offerta, corrispondenti trattative con i servizi specializzati e sviluppo di approcci per minimizzare i rischi in caso di ordine - Preparazione e realizzazione di presentazioni di offerte tecniche - Gestione indiretta e coordinamento con funzioni multidisciplinari nell'ambito della preparazione dell'offerta - Preparazione di offerte tecniche/commerciali di alta qualità in linea con le esigenze del mercato - Rivedere le quotazioni ricevute e sfidare, se necessario, sia gli stakeholder interni che esterni per garantire che una proposta competitiva sia presentata soddisfando le vendite/previsioni del mercato - Familiar con i rischi e i rischi all'interno delle attività e dei processi del ruolo e delle procedure, delle pratiche e delle misure in atto per mitigare i rischi. - Partecipazione a trattative commerciali, preparazione corrispondente e follow-up in collaborazione con il reparto vendite - incontri di chiarimento del campo di competenza con i clienti, se necessario, e fornire tutto il supporto necessario alle vendite per garantire che la soluzione offerta soddisfi le specifiche/il requisito del cliente, evidenziando il nostro vantaggio competitivo - Leading trattative tecniche con subappaltatori - Garantire un trasferimento di ordine completo e riuscito al team di progetto - Manutenzione regolare dei nostri sistemi di vendita e dei dati ivi contenuti. - Studi tecnici completati con successo (ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria industriale o di processo o di livello equivalente) - Modalità di lavoro strutturata, capacità di risolvere problemi complessi insieme al team di offerta - Esperienza in almeno una delle seguenti discipline: progettazione di pompe, gara internazionale o vendita, gestione di progetti o equivalente - Idealmente competenze interculturali - Conoscenza sana di pompe o attrezzature rotanti e accessori Co-Babeamo - Assicurazione medica per auto e famiglia - Struttura di trasporto sponsorizzata dall'azienda durante la settimana Days Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Empl

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for collecting outstanding receivables and maintaining accurate records of collection activities. The role involves interacting with customers, assessing account status, and supporting timely payments. The objective is to maintain cash flow, reduce DSO, resolve disputes, and coordinate with internal teams to address billing or service issues affecting payments.

Key Responsibilities

• Collection Efforts: Contact customers via phone and email to follow up on past-due invoices and secure payments.

• Account Reconciliation: Review accounts to ensure payments are applied correctly and resolve discrepancies.

• Negotiation: Develop payment plans with customers for outstanding debt.

• Reporting: Submit daily/weekly reports on aging accounts and high-risk customers to management.

• Process Improvement: Recommend adjustments to improve AR collection process.

• Documentation: Maintain meticulous records of collection activities and customer correspondence.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor: in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration.

• Previous experience in credit and collections or accounts receivable.

• Strong written/verbal communication, negotiation, and customer service skills.

• Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, SAP, Oracle) and MS Excel.

• Languages: Arabic & English.

What we offer you

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Legal counsel and Compliance Officer based in AU is responsible for delivering legal services that support business operations and strategic initiatives and ensuring the local operation is compliant with the applicable laws as well as Sulzer internal policies. This role ensures compliance with applicable laws, mitigates legal risks, and provides expert legal counsel across a range of corporate matters.
Key Responsibilities

• Manage the legal function for all business units of Sulzer in Australia, ensuring alignment with corporate legal strategy.

• Provide legal advice on commercial, corporate, and regulatory matters.
Oversee the drafting, negotiation, and review of complex contracts and legal documents.

• Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies.
Support the resolution of legal disputes and manage litigation in coordination with external legal counsel.

• Develop and implement legal policies, procedures, and training programs.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to support business initiatives and manage legal risks.

• Monitor legal and regulatory developments and assess their impact on the organization.

• Lead, mentor, and develop external legal service providers.

Skills & Qualifications

• Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and 9+ years of relevant work experience are minimally required.

• Licensed to practice law in Australia

• Strong experience in corporate and commercial law, with a focus on contract law and compliance.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement abilities.

• Ability to manage complex legal issues and provide strategic legal advice.

• High ethical standards and sound legal judgment.

• Experience in a multinational or matrixed organization and industries such as oil and gas, power generation, mining, chemicals and water is preferred.

jobs.title: Repair Engineer I
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Acts as the liaison between the customer, sales, vendors, engineering, and production departments, determines and provides detailed cost summaries and quotations for repair jobs in the service center. Coordinates repair by providing work instructions that include all pertinent information needed to process the repair through the service center meeting ISO requirements. Key Responsibilities

• Under supervision of the Service Center Manager (SCM) or Customer Service Manager completes disassembly, inspection, repair, and assembly work instruction packages that includes work order generation complying with internal procedures, policies, inspection documentation, etc.

• Analyses inspection results and works with internal personnel and resources to disposition and create scope of supply required to repair equipment.

• Under supervision of the SCM or Customer Service Manager plans and generates Repair Proposals including labor hours, purchase requirements, work instructions, and total cost.

• Under supervision of the SCM or Customer Service Manager create and/or review drawings per internal procedures and ISO standards

• Under supervision or of Service Center Manager or Customer Service Manager, procures all required materials, services, and equipment used in repair jobs for the service center. Expedites parts and materials from suppliers to ensure delivery commitments are met.

• As applicable, prepares and coordinates all inbound/outbound shipping related tasks required for the final transportation of repairs or parts to ensure compliance with customer commitments. This would include all shipping, import, and export documentation as required.

• To ensure compliance with customer commitments and overall master schedule communicates regularly with all departments to keep them abreast of coordination activities.

• All work is performed by ISO and OSHAS requirements

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.

• Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Technical Discipline (Engineering preferred) or closely related field or equivalent work related experience required

• Minimum of two years’ experience in closely related job/industry, preferred.

• Experience with Microsoft Office products required. SAP knowledge is preferred

• Ability to proactively organize and meet deadlines. Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) in English.

• Basic understanding of ISO, QMS, ESH and ASME, required.

• Preferred knowledge of API standards, Welding properties and procedures, Pump failure analysis, single, multi, horizontal and vertical pumps

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Communicates with internal and external customers to interpret customer requirements for aftermarket parts and service. Responsible for ensuring customers receive quality and professional service by providing adequate product support to the extent of attaining purchase orders and/or negotiating resolutions with customers as required. Have extensive knowledge on Service programs including; provides quotes (written and or verbal), discuss all programs to include Exchanges, Repairs, Parts, New Cutter Cartridges and proficient in processing the for mentioned programs in Visual ERP system. Principle Duties & Key Responsibilities

• Responsible for preparing parts quotes to meet both the customer’s needs and specific contractual requirements as determined by the purchase order.

• Specify correct part for previously supplied equipment.

• Prepare quotes, advise of pricing and required lead time for parts.

• Estimate cost and prices when actuals are not available, when necessary.

• Document quotes on system quote program and hard copy serial file when applicable.

• Effectively learn all aspects of Visual and Call Center and have a working knowledge to process orders; reference historical information, understand the Material Planning and Lead times.

• Responds to customers, sales managers and manufacturing representatives inquiries regarding status and delivery of orders/proposals.

• Understands and explains service programs and product warranty to end customers.

• Builds relationships to provide repeat business and excellent customer service.

• Performs other duties and special projects as assigned.

Education, Experience, & Skills:
Desirable: Associates Degree in a technical field or related field
Required:

• High School Diploma

• 3+ years working in a Customer Service, help desk or troubleshooting environment

• Excellent oral and written communication skills.

• Ability to use technology and analysis tools (Excel, Outlook, web, databases)

• Highly self-motivated.

• Mechanical background/knowledge highly desirable

• Flexible, reliable, strong work ethic, dependable team player, positive, constructive attitude.

• Outstanding business etiquette skills.

• Versteht und erklärt Serviceprogramme und Produktgarantie für Endkunden.

• Führt andere Aufgaben und spezielle Projekte wie zugewiesen aus. Bildung, Erfahrung und Fähigkeiten: Wünschenswert: Associates Degree in einem technischen Bereich oder verwandten Bereich Vorgeschrieben:
• High School Diplom
• 3+ Jahre Arbeit in einem Kundenservice, Helpdesk oder einer Umgebung zur Fehlerbehebung
• Hervorragende mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
• Fähigkeit zur Nutzung von Technologie- und Analysetools (Excel, Outlook, Web, Datenbanken)
• Sehr selbstmotiviert.
• Mechanischer Hintergrund / Wissen sehr wünschenswert
• Flexible, zuverlässige, starke Arbeitsmoral, zuverlässiger Teamplayer, positive, konstruktive Einstellung.
• Herausragende Business-Etikette Fähigkeiten. Preis: $ 28,00 / h - $ 29,50 / h Was wir Ihnen bieten Was wir Ihnen anbieten: 401K-Plan mit bis zu 6% Company Match. 12 bezahlte Ferien. Bezahlte Auszeit Umfassendes Leistungsprogramm einschließlich Medizin, Zahnarzt, Vision, Leben, kurz- und langfristige Behinderung. Gesundheitssparkonto mit Arbeitgebermatching 4 Wochen bezahlter Elternurlaub Motivierendes Wellnessprogramm Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld. Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Communique avec les clients internes et externes pour interpréter les exigences des clients en matière de pièces et de service après-vente. Il s'agit de veiller à ce que les clients reçoivent un service de qualité et professionnel en leur fournissant un soutien adéquat dans la mesure où ils obtiennent des bons de commande et/ou négocient des résolutions avec les clients au besoin. Avoir une connaissance approfondie des programmes de service, y compris; fournir des citations (écrites ou verbales), discuter de tous les programmes pour inclure les échanges, les réparations, les pièces, les nouvelles cartouches de cutter et maîtriser le traitement des programmes mentionnés dans le système ERP visuel. Fonctions principales et responsabilités clés
• Responsable de la préparation des devis de pièces pour répondre à la fois aux besoins du client et aux exigences contractuelles spécifiques déterminées par le bon de commande.
• Spécifiez la partie correcte pour les équipements fournis antérieurement.
• Préparer des devis, des conseils sur les prix et le délai requis pour les pièces.
• Estimation du coût et des prix lorsque les données réelles ne sont pas disponibles, au besoin.
• Documenter les citations sur le programme de citations système et le fichier série de copie papier, le cas échéant.
• Apprenez efficacement tous les aspects de Visual and Call Center et avez une connaissance de travail pour traiter les commandes; référez des informations historiques, comprendre la planification matérielle et les temps de conduite.
• Répondre aux demandes des clients, des directeurs commerciaux et des représentants de la fabrication concernant l'état et la livraison des commandes/propositions.
• Comprend et explique les programmes de service et la garantie de produit aux clients finaux.
• Bâtir des relations pour fournir des affaires répétées et un excellent service à la clientèle.
• Exécute d'autres tâches et des projets spéciaux selon les affectations. Éducation, expérience et compétences : Désirable : Associé Diplôme dans un domaine technique ou connexe Requis :
• Diplôme d'études secondaires
• 3+ ans de travail dans un service à la clientèle, un service d'assistance ou un environnement de dépannage
• Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite.
• Capacité d'utiliser la technologie et les outils d'analyse (Excel, Outlook, web, bases de données)
• Très motivé.
• Contexte/connaissances mécaniques hautement souhaitables
• Flexible, fiable, forte éthique du travail, un joueur d'équipe fiable, une attitude positive et constructive.
• Compétences exceptionnelles en éthique des affaires. Taux : 28,00 $/h - 29,50 $/h Ce que nous vous offrons Ce que nous vous offrons: Plan 401K avec jusqu'à un match de 6% d'entreprise. 12 Jours fériés payés. Temps d'arrêt payé Programme complet d'avantages sociaux, y compris les soins médicaux, dentaires, la vision, la vie, l'invalidité de courte et de longue durée. Compte d'épargne santé avec adéquation employeur 4 semaines de congé parental rémunéré Programme de bien-être Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Position Summary:
This role supports the engineering, configuration, and validation of High Stator Turbo (HST) Compressors within the Order Related Engineering (ORE) department. Responsibilities include developing sales‑order‑specific mechanical and automation designs, reviewing electromechanical schematics, and creating the bill of materials (BOM) within the ERP system.

The position collaborates with cross‑functional teams (Project Managers, Tendering, Sales, and Manufacturing, to prepare technical submittals) ensure accurate order configuration, and release finalized engineering packages to Production. The role also provides hands‑on mechanical support, including product testing and troubleshooting

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

• Review project scope and specifications and hold hand-off meetings as needed to ensure team alignment

• Prepare and manage submittal packages to ensure timely, accurate customer approvals

• Learn the HST products, serve as the SME, and bring that expertise to the local team

• Assist in designing and building HST infrastructure in the USA

• Support Tendering Activities

• Support ORE Activities as needed

• Train HST team as necessary.

• Support Procurement and MRB, Quality Assurance Team

• Act as liaison between other teams in Finland and China

• Update and maintain sales order workflows within the SAP ERP system

• Review and verify mechanical drawings and BOMs prepared by other ORE team members to ensure accuracy and compliance

• Design motor control electrical schematics by interpreting specifications, quotes, purchase orders, and company scope worksheets.

• Enter parts and create assemblies of motor control designs in the ERP system for procurement and electrical production assembly

• Support the Project Engineer with motor control design documentation for sales order submittals.

• Review sales-order-specific electrical schematics (drawings and BOMs) created by other ORE team members

• Provide electrical review and support to other departments assigned by the ORE Manager

• Support field service technicians during installation and acceptance of products

• Perform additional duties and participate in special projects as necessary

Education & Experience:

Required: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering field (or equivalent practical experience with rotating equipment, industrial controls, or electromechanical systems)

• 3 – 7 years of experience in mechanical, electromechanical, or automation engineering.

• Experience with rotating machinery, compressors, turbomachinery, motors, VFDs, or similar high‑speed equipment preferred.

• Hands‑on experience reading or generating mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, and BOMs.

• Experience with ERP systems (SAP preferred).

• Experience supporting manufacturing, production, or test environments.

• Understanding of industrial automation, motor control, or electromechanical system integration is a plus.

• Ability to collaborate across cross‑functional and international teams.

Skills:
Required: CAD,
SolidWorks,
Siemens TIA,
HMI In-touch
Experience in 3D modelling and drafting
SAP System Experience
Ability to use technology and analysis tools (Excel, Outlook,

Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro L'ingegnere meccanico è responsabile per la ricerca, la pianificazione, la progettazione e lo sviluppo di prodotti e sistemi meccanici. Questo include strumenti, controlli, motori e macchine utilizzate nella produzione, trasmissione e misura di energia. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti precoci che applicano una vasta conoscenza teorica e richiedono la capacità di indagare e analizzare i problemi. Le soluzioni sono tipicamente discusse/verificati con un membro più anziano. Posizione Riepilogo: Questo ruolo supporta l'ingegneria, la configurazione e la validazione dei compressori High Stator Turbo (HST) all'interno del reparto Order Related Engineering (ORE). Le responsabilità includono lo sviluppo di progetti meccanici e di automazione specifici per le vendite, la revisione degli schemi elettromeccanici e la creazione della fattura dei materiali (BOM) all'interno del sistema ERP. La posizione collabora con team interfunzionali (Project Managers, Tendering, Sales e Manufacturing, per preparare i moduli tecnici) assicurano una configurazione accurata degli ordini e rilasciano pacchetti di ingegneria finalizzati alla produzione. Il ruolo fornisce anche supporto meccanico pratico, tra cui test di prodotto e risoluzione dei problemi Principali doveri e responsabilità:
• Rivedere la portata e le specifiche del progetto e tenere riunioni di hand-off secondo le necessità per garantire l'allineamento del team
• Preparare e gestire i pacchetti di presentazione per garantire tempestive e accurate approvazioni del cliente
• Imparare i prodotti HST, servire come PMI, e portare questa esperienza al team locale
• Assistere nella progettazione e costruzione di infrastrutture HST negli Stati Uniti
• Attività di supporto
• Support ORE Attività come necessario
• Allena la squadra HST come necessario.
• Support Procurement e MRB, Quality Assurance Team
• Agire come collegamento tra le altre squadre in Finlandia e Cina
• Aggiornare e mantenere i flussi di lavoro degli ordini di vendita all'interno del sistema SAP ERP
• Verifica e verifica disegni meccanici e BOM preparati da altri membri del team ORE per garantire precisione e conformità
• Progettazione di schemi elettrici di controllo motore interpretando specifiche, preventivi, ordini di acquisto e fogli di lavoro di portata aziendale.
• Inserire parti e creare assemblaggi di progetti di controllo motore nel sistema ERP per l'approvvigionamento e l'assemblaggio di produzione elettrica
• Supporta l'Ingegnere del Progetto con la documentazione di progettazione del controllo del motore per la presentazione dell'ordine di vendita.
• Revisione degli schemi elettrici specifici per le vendite-ordine (disegni e BOM) creati da altri membri del team ORE
• Fornire revisione elettrica e supporto ad altri dipartimenti assegnati dal ORE Manager
• I tecnici del servizio sul campo di supporto durante l'installazione e l'accettazione dei prodotti
• Eseguire ulteriori compiti e partecipare a progetti speciali, se necessario Istruzione e esperienza: Obbligatorio: Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, Ingegneria Elettrica, Meccatronica, o un relativo campo di ingegneria (o equivalente esperienza pratica con attrezzature rotanti, controlli industriali, o sistemi elettromeccanici)
• 3 – 7 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria meccanica, elettromeccanica o dell'automazione.
• Esperienza con macchine rotanti, compressori, turbomacchine, motori, VFD o simili attrezzature ad alta velocità preferite.
• Lettura a mano o generazione di disegni meccanici, schemi elettrici e BOM.
• Esperienza con sistemi ERP (preferito da SAP).
• Esperienza che supporta ambienti di produzione, produzione o test.
• La comprensione dell'automazione industriale, del controllo del motore o dell'integrazione del sistema elettromeccanico è un plus.

Über die Rolle Stellenbeschreibung Der Maschinenbauer ist verantwortlich für die Erforschung, Planung, Konstruktion und Entwicklung mechanischer Produkte und Systeme. Dazu gehören Instrumente, Steuerungen, Motoren und Maschinen, die bei der Energieerzeugung, -übertragung und -messung eingesetzt werden. Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an Berufseinsteiger, die ein breites theoretisches Wissen anwenden und die Fähigkeit benötigen, Probleme zu untersuchen und zu analysieren. Lösungen werden in der Regel mit einem älteren Mitglied diskutiert / verifiziert. Positionsübersicht: Diese Rolle unterstützt die Entwicklung, Konfiguration und Validierung von High Stator Turbo (HST) Kompressoren innerhalb der Order Related Engineering (ORE) Abteilung. Zu den Aufgaben gehören die Entwicklung verkaufsauftragsspezifischer mechanischer und automatisierter Designs, die Überprüfung elektromechanischer Schaltpläne und die Erstellung der Stückliste (BOM) innerhalb des ERP-Systems. Die Position arbeitet mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams (Projektmanager, Ausschreibungen, Vertrieb und Fertigung, um technische Einreichungen vorzubereiten) zusammen, um eine genaue Auftragskonfiguration zu gewährleisten und abgeschlossene Engineering-Pakete in die Produktion zu bringen. Die Rolle bietet auch praktische mechanische Unterstützung, einschließlich Produkttests und Fehlersuche Hauptpflichten und Zuständigkeiten:
• Überprüfen Sie den Projektumfang und die Spezifikationen und halten Sie bei Bedarf Übergabesitzungen ab, um die Teamausrichtung sicherzustellen

• Entwerfen Sie elektrische Schaltpläne zur Motorsteuerung, indem Sie Spezifikationen, Angebote, Bestellungen und Arbeitsblätter zum Unternehmensumfang interpretieren.
• Teile eingeben und Baugruppen von Motorsteuerungsdesigns im ERP-System für die Beschaffung und die elektrische Produktionsmontage erstellen
• Unterstützen Sie den Projektingenieur mit der Motorsteuerungs-Designdokumentation für Verkaufsaufträge.
• Überprüfen Sie verkaufsauftragsspezifische elektrische Schaltpläne (Zeichnungen und Stücklisten), die von anderen ORE-Teammitgliedern erstellt wurden
• Elektronische Überprüfung und Unterstützung für andere vom ORE-Manager zugewiesene Abteilungen
• Unterstützung von Außendiensttechnikern bei der Installation und Abnahme von Produkten

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi L'ingénieur mécanique est responsable de la recherche, de la planification, de la conception et du développement de produits et de systèmes mécaniques. Cela comprend les instruments, les commandes, les moteurs et les machines utilisés dans la production, la transmission et la mesure de l'énergie. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels en début de carrière qui appliquent de vastes connaissances théoriques et qui ont besoin de la capacité d'étudier et d'analyser les problèmes. Les solutions sont généralement discutées/vérifiées avec un membre plus âgé. Sommaire du poste : Ce rôle soutient l'ingénierie, la configuration et la validation des compresseurs à turbo haute position (TVH) au sein du département d'ingénierie liée à la commande (ORE). Les responsabilités comprennent l'élaboration de conceptions mécaniques et d'automatisation propres aux commandes de vente, l'examen des schémas électromécaniques et la création de la facture de matériaux (BOM) au sein du système ERP. Le poste collabore avec des équipes interfonctionnelles (gestionnaires de projets, soumissionnaires, ventes et fabrication) pour préparer des présentations techniques. Le rôle fournit également un support mécanique pratique, y compris des tests de produit et le dépannage Principales fonctions et responsabilités :
• Examiner la portée et les spécifications du projet et tenir des réunions de remise au besoin pour assurer l'alignement de l'équipe
• Préparer et gérer les trousses de soumission afin d'assurer l'approbation rapide et exacte des clients
• Apprenez les produits TVH, servez de PME et apportez cette expertise à l'équipe locale
• Aide à la conception et à la construction d'infrastructures TVH aux États-Unis
• Appui aux activités d'appel d'offres
• Soutien aux activités ORE au besoin
• Former l'équipe TVH au besoin.
• Soutien à l'approvisionnement et à la CRM, Équipe d'assurance de la qualité
• Agir comme liaison entre d'autres équipes en Finlande et en Chine
• Mettre à jour et maintenir les flux de commandes dans le système SAP ERP
• Examiner et vérifier les dessins mécaniques et les BOM préparés par d'autres membres de l'équipe ORE pour assurer l'exactitude et la conformité
• Concevoir des schémas électriques de commande de moteur en interprétant les spécifications, les devis, les bons de commande et les feuilles de travail de l'entreprise.
• Entrez des pièces et créez des assemblages de conception de commande moteur dans le système ERP pour l'acquisition et l'assemblage électrique
• Soutenir l'ingénieur de projet avec la documentation de conception de contrôle moteur pour les commandes de vente soumis.
• Examiner les schémas électriques spécifiques aux commandes (dessins et BOM) créés par d'autres membres de l'équipe ORE
• Fournir un examen et un soutien électriques aux autres ministères désignés par le gestionnaire de l'ORE
• Techniciens de soutien pendant l'installation et l'acceptation des produits
• Exécuter des tâches supplémentaires et participer à des projets spéciaux au besoin Éducation et expérience : Obligatoire: Baccalauréat en génie mécanique, génie électrique, mécatronique, ou un domaine d'ingénierie connexe (ou une expérience pratique équivalente avec des équipements rotatifs, des commandes industrielles, ou des systèmes électromécaniques)

jobs.title: Manual Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a Manual Machinist you will be responsible for setting up and operating machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore parts to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. You will interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and perform precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. You will measure components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Key Responsibilities

• Performing layouts, setting up and operating conventional machine tools as required

• Reading and interpreting all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designing setup methods where none exist

• Instructing other shop personnel on proper machining techniques

• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

Qualifications / Requirements

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Ability to set up machine tools: ID / OD Grinders, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, Radial Drill, Planer Mill

• Four years of experience in machine shop operations

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Openness to working overtime as required

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sr. Tendering Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Tendering Engineer to act as a high-level technical lead and strategic partner to management. You will be the central pivot point for the bidding process, balancing technical accuracy with commercial strategy while facilitating complex global communication between regional and international stakeholders. This role requires a candidate capable of driving strategic business decisions while mentoring junior staff and managing day-to-day technical tenders.

Key Responsibilities

• Prepare quotations for major projects in close coordination with sales personnel, regional managers, distributors, representatives, and alliance managers .

• Assist management with major project tender signoffs as required by the company’s Delegation of Authority (DoA) framework .

• Propose innovative solutions to clients based on your extensive technical expertise and seniority to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction .

• Supervise the activities of Application Engineers I and II, providing guidance to ensure team alignment, productivity, and professional growth .

• Act as the critical bridge between Sales, internal operations, project management, and factories located outside the PU NAM region .

• Actively support the achievement of regional sales plan objectives through technical proposal excellence .

• Analyze customer specifications, define scope, evaluate "buy-out" components (e.g., seals, couplings, actuators), and manage post-submission technical/commercial clarifications .

• Maintain and supervise data accuracy in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce/RFT) to ensure reliable sales forecasts and workload reporting .

Required Qualifications & Skills

• Education: Bachelor’s degree (Licenciatura) in Mechanical, Industrial, Chemical, or related Engineering .

• Experience: * Mandatory: Minimum of 5 years of experience as an Application Specialist specifically within the pump industry .

• Desirable: 2 years of experience in group supervision or leadership activities.

• Language Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in English (reading, speaking, and writing) is required .

• Technical Competencies (Advanced Level Required): * Expertise in hydraulics, centrifugal pumps, and their accessories

• Software Proficiency: * Advanced: Microsoft Office, pump selection and costing software, and CRM (SalesForce or similar) .

• Basic: SAP .

• Christmas bonus over law

• Development plan

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro Il Rappresentante delle vendite interno (ISR) ha ampie responsabilità legate al servizio clienti, alle vendite e al coordinamento dei progetti. Come professionisti del business la loro funzione principale è quella di costruire relazioni chiave con i loro coetanei ISR, Area Sales Manager, Operazioni e clienti. Essenzialmente, sono il centro centrale tra tutti i dipartimenti con l'organizzazione. Essi sono responsabili dell'esecuzione dei processi aziendali tra quei gruppi in modo efficiente, coerente e con una comunicazione chiara L'ISR è un ruolo chiave per l'organizzazione che permette l'interazione con tutti gli aspetti del business ed è una grande posizione per chiunque abbia esperienza o qualcuno con l'atteggiamento positivo disposto ad imparare. Questa posizione estende l'opportunità di imparare la nostra attività all'interno delle industrie Oil & Gas, Petrochimica e Power Generation. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) has broad responsibilities related to customer service, sales, and project coordination. As business professionals their primary function is to build key relationships with their ISR peers, Area Sales Managers, Operations and customers. Essentially, they are the central hub between all departments with the organization. They are responsible for executing the business processes between those groups efficiently, consistently and with clear communication The ISR is a key role for the organization that allows interaction with all aspects of the business and is a great position for anyone with experience or someone with the positive attitude willing to learn. This position extends the opportunity to learn our business within the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical and Power Generation industries. Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Stellenbeschreibung Der Inside Sales Representative (ISR) hat eine breite Verantwortung in Bezug auf Kundenservice, Vertrieb und Projektkoordination. Als Geschäftsleute besteht ihre Hauptaufgabe darin, wichtige Beziehungen zu ihren ISR-Kollegen, Area Sales Managern, Operations und Kunden aufzubauen. Im Wesentlichen sind sie der zentrale Knotenpunkt zwischen allen Abteilungen mit der Organisation. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, die Geschäftsprozesse zwischen diesen Gruppen effizient, konsistent und mit klarer Kommunikation durchzuführen. Die ISR ist eine Schlüsselrolle für die Organisation, die die Interaktion mit allen Aspekten des Unternehmens ermöglicht und eine großartige Position für jeden mit Erfahrung oder jemand mit der positiven Einstellung, die bereit ist zu lernen. Diese Position erweitert die Möglichkeit, unser Geschäft in der Öl- und Gas-, Petrochemie- und Stromerzeugungsindustrie kennenzulernen. Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi L'Inside Sales Representative (ISR) assume de vastes responsabilités liées au service à la clientèle, aux ventes et à la coordination des projets. En tant que professionnels des affaires, leur fonction principale est d'établir des relations clés avec leurs pairs ISR, les directeurs régionaux des ventes, les opérations et les clients. Essentiellement, ils constituent le centre central entre tous les ministères de l'organisation. Ils sont responsables de l'exécution efficace, cohérente et claire des processus d'affaires entre ces groupes. L'ISR est un rôle clé pour l'organisation qui permet l'interaction avec tous les aspects de l'entreprise et est une excellente position pour toute personne ayant de l'expérience ou quelqu'un avec l'attitude positive prêt à apprendre. Cette position offre l'occasion d'apprendre notre métier dans les industries du pétrole et du gaz, de la pétrochimie et de la production d'électricité. jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead the execution of complex, long‑term customer contracts (e.g., LTSA / framework agreements) and high‑risk projects. You’ll be the key link between our customers and internal teams—bringing people together, keeping delivery on track, and building strong, long‑term partnerships. jobs.title: Sales Manager, Water and Wastewater

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile vendite, acqua e acque reflue
titleByLocale.fr: Directeur des ventes, Eau et eaux usées

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Water & Industry Business Unit and be part of a global team delivering high-impact pumping and rotating equipment solutions. Purpose of the Role
We are seeking an experienced Sales Manager, Water and Wastewater to lead sales activities across Greece, Cyprus, and Israel for our Water and Industrial Business Uni . The role focuses on developing long-term customer relationships, identifying and converting commercial opportunities, and delivering tailored pumping and rotating equipment solutions within the water industry.
You will represent Sulzer in front of key customers, manage complex technical and commercial engagements, and consistently achieve agreed sales targets.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing customers across the assigned territories

• Develop and manage a robust sales pipeline and key account strategy

• Visit customers regularly, lead project discussions, and deliver technical presentations on the Sulzer Water portfolio

• Prepare technical and commercial quotations with support from tendering teams

• Negotiate contracts and support project order wins

• Work closely with engineering, procurement, manufacturing, project management, and global Sulzer WIBU offices

• Coordinate with local agents in Greece, Cyprus, and Israel

• Prepare structured handover documentation to Project Management and support delivery through to contractual completion

Requirements:

• Strong technical and commercial acumen within the water industry

• B.E / B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering

• 10+ years’ experience in the water industry , including 7+ years living and working in Greece

• Proven experience in technical sales, proposals, or tendering functions

• Strong ability to read engineering drawings, specifications, and tender documents

• Sulzer product knowledge is a strong advantage

• CRM experience (Salesforce preferred)

What we offer you

• Chance to make a meaningful impact by driving growth across the Sales organisation within our Water & Industrial business, with sustainability at the heart of our strategy.

• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.

• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry in a global environment

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Il ruolo si concentra sullo sviluppo di relazioni con i clienti a lungo termine, l'identificazione e la conversione di opportunità commerciali, e la fornitura di soluzioni di pompaggio e rotazione su misura all'interno del settore idrico. Potrai rappresentare Sulzer di fronte a clienti chiave, gestire complessi impegni tecnici e commerciali, e raggiungere costantemente obiettivi di vendita concordati. Principali responsabilità
• Costruire e mantenere forti relazioni con clienti nuovi e esistenti in tutti i territori assegnati
• Sviluppare e gestire una robusta pipeline di vendita e una strategia di account chiave
• Visitare i clienti regolarmente, condurre discussioni di progetto e fornire presentazioni tecniche sul portafoglio di Sulzer Water
• Preparare quotazioni tecniche e commerciali con il supporto dei gruppi di gara
• Negoziare contratti e sostenere l'ordine del progetto vince
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con l'ingegneria, l'approvvigionamento, la produzione, la gestione dei progetti e gli uffici globali di Sulzer WIBU
• Coordinamento con gli agenti locali in Grecia, Cipro e Israele
• Preparare la documentazione di consegna strutturata a Project Management e la consegna di supporto attraverso il completamento contrattuale Requisiti:
• Forte acume tecnico e commerciale nell'industria dell'acqua
• B.E / B.Tech / Diploma in ingegneria meccanica
• 10+ anni di esperienza nel settore idrico, tra cui 7+ anni di vita e di lavoro in Grecia
• Esperienza dimostrata nelle vendite tecniche, nelle proposte o nelle funzioni di gara
• Forte capacità di leggere disegni di ingegneria, specifiche e documenti teneri
• La conoscenza del prodotto di Sulzer è un vantaggio forte
• Esperienza CRM (preferito Salesforce) Cosa ti offriamo
• Possibilità di avere un impatto significativo guidando la crescita attraverso l'organizzazione Vendite all'interno del nostro business Water & Industrial, con la sostenibilità al centro della nostra strategia.
• Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e di supporto con un focus sull'innovazione e l'eccellenza.
• Opportunità emozionanti per la crescita e il progresso professionale in un'industria dinamica e in evoluzione in un ambiente globale Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Treten Sie unserer Business Unit Water & Industry bei und werden Sie Teil eines globalen Teams, das wirkungsvolle Pumpen- und Rotationslösungen liefert. Zweck der Rolle Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Sales Manager, Wasser und Abwasser, um die Vertriebsaktivitäten in Griechenland, Zypern und Israel für unsere Water and Industrial Business Uni zu leiten. Die Rolle konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen, die Identifizierung und Umwandlung kommerzieller Möglichkeiten und die Bereitstellung maßgeschneiderter Pumpen- und Rotationslösungen in der Wasserindustrie. • Entwicklung und Verwaltung einer robusten Vertriebspipeline und Key-Account-Strategie
• Besuchen Sie Kunden regelmäßig, führen Sie Projektdiskussionen und halten Sie technische Präsentationen zum Sulzer Water Portfolio
• Bereiten Sie technische und kommerzielle Angebote mit Unterstützung von Ausschreibungsteams vor
• Verträge aushandeln und Projektauftragsgewinne unterstützen
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Beschaffung, Fertigung, Projektmanagement und globalen Sulzer WIBU-Büros
• Koordination mit lokalen Agenten in Griechenland, Zypern und Israel

• Starker technischer und kommerzieller Scharfsinn in der Wasserindustrie
• B.E / B.Tech / Diplom in Maschinenbau
• 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Wasserindustrie, darunter 7+ Jahre Leben und Arbeiten in Griechenland
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in technischen Verkaufs-, Angebots- oder Ausschreibungsfunktionen
• Starke Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen, Spezifikationen und Ausschreibungsunterlagen zu lesen
• Sulzer Produktwissen ist ein großer Vorteil

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Service i Sulzer er et spennende og interessant fagfelt, og har ofte et høyt tempo. Det å bidra til at folk har rent vann og fungerende infrastruktur for vann- og avløp er et av de viktigste samfunnsoppdragene som finnes! Vi liker kort avstand mellom verksted og ledelse, hvor ideer blir hørt og hvor muligheter for både faglig og personlig utvikling blir gitt.
Sulzer søker nå etter en fagsterk og kundeorientert serviceleder. Du kommer til å være lokalisert ved vårt verksted på hovedkontoret i Asker, og også ha personalansvar for teknikerne på flere lokasjoner. Har du dokumenterte erfaringer med å skape, lede, og utvikle effektive team, håper vi at nettopp du ønsker å være med på denne reisen med oss!

Stillingen inneholder blant annet:

• Du vil være en del av et team med 2 serviceledere, som tilsammen har personalansvar for alle teknikerne.

• Du vil være ansvarlig for salg av servicetjenester, driften av og effektiv bruk av ressursene, både menneskelige og materielle. Sulzer har stort fokus på kontinuerlig forbedring, utvikling, og vekst.

• Vi ønsker at du er en rollemodell, at du viser engasjement og felles retning.

• Sørge for at de ansatte får et tett og effektivt samarbeid, slik at de blir inspirert til å oppnå felles suksess.

• Sikre at teknikerne har riktig kompetanse for å utføre avdelingens arbeid, gjennom kompetanseutvikling og ansettelser, i samråd med serviceleder i Norge.

• I og med at våre serviceteknikere jobber med tungt maskineri og med arbeid som kan være risikopreget, er det svært viktig at leder har stort fokus på å drifte på en sikker og helsefremmende måte, og sikrer HMS og kvalitet i alle ledd.

• Dette er en operativ rolle, som består av både ledelse og salg, samt administrative oppgaver som bidrar til å holde hjulene i gang.

Hovedoppgaver
Arbeidsoppgavene inkluderer, men er ikke begrenset til:

• HMS ansvar for teknikerne og verkstedene.

• Personalansvar for teknikerne

• Kundekontakt og befaringer

• Salgsrelaterte oppgaver på serviceområdet

• Ansvar for servicebiler/flåtestyring lokalt

• Det er behov for en del reising i stillingen, for å vise tilstedeværelse på flere lokasjoner.

Rapporterer til: Serviceleder Norge

Ønsket erfaring og formell utdanning

• Gjerne utdanning på BSc- nivå, eller teknisk utdannelse

• Operativ ledelseserfaring, gjerne fra bransje med serviceteknikere i felt eller lignende

• Erfaring innen vedlikehold av prosessutstyr eller annet mekanisk utstyr

• Det er en fordel å kjenne til vann- og avløpsbransjen.

• Kompetanse innen HMS for arbeid i felt

• Kompetanse eller interesse for tilstøtende fagdisipliner; mekaniske, elektro, automasjon og bygg & anlegg

• Gode kommunikasjonsevner på både norsk og engelsk

• Førerkort klasse B, fordel med BE (henger)

• Gode kunnskaper innen IT

Personlige styrker

• Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner

• Komfortabel med elektroniske verktøy og systemer

• Gode mellommenneskelige egenskaper, og evne til å skape og lede et team

• Kundeorientert

• Teknisk nysgjerrighet

What we offer you

Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg?
Sulzer er en stor og stabil arbeidsgiver, og samtidig har vi et lokalt miljø som er liten og dynamisk.
Sulzer er kjent for produkter med høy kvalitet, har en solid ordrereserve, egne fabrikker, og er en ledende aktør i en bærekraftig og livsnødvendig industri.

Ansatte hos oss har stor påvirkningskraft på egen hverdag og bedriftens retning. Sulzer tilbyr et hyggelig miljø med høy yrkesstolthet og faglig tyngde. Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, og fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og ikke minst gode muligheter for videreutvikling internt og eksternt
