jobs.title: Motor Control Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Assembler is responsible for putting together component parts or products according to blueprints or schematics. This role ensures that assembled items meet quality standards and supports the production line by maintaining efficiency and accuracy.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Position Summary:
Under indirect supervision and following JWCE’s Standard Operating Procedures, reads electric schematics and interprets wiring diagrams to assemble, wire, troubleshoot, and complete low voltage, hydraulic package and final quality testing of electrical motor control panels and enclosures.
Principle Duties and Responsibilities:

• Performs essential wiring of control panels used in monitoring and controlling electric motors & hydraulic power packs.

• Performs final quality assurance of all series controls in accordance with company practices, and UL, NEMA, NEC and CSA requirements.

• Matches complex picking lists and motor control diagrams and review, correct and document discrepancies.

• Identifies problems and resolves issues to ensure system functions properly.

• Performs high pot testing of motor control.

• Assists QA technicians with basic inspection and testing of all model control panels.

• Maintains organized work station and area.

• Adheres to safety standards of facility.

• Performs other duties and special projects as assigned.

• Must be able to lift up to 35lbs.

• Must be able to stand for extended periods of time.
Experience, Education & Skills:
Required: High School Degree
Desirable: 2-year Vocational Certificate in HVAC, Electrical, or Electronics is a plus.

• 2+ years’ experience in a UL Motor Control Panel Shop or Hands-on in a class room setting.

• Knowledgeable using test meters to perform point-to-point continuity checks.

• Possess a thorough understanding of control theory and control concepts.

• Feels comfortable working with medium voltage (up to 120 VAC)

• Ability to read schematics and interpret wiring diagrams.

• Able to use basic electrical hand tools. (cutting, crimping, and stripping)

• Attention to detail.

• Highly self-motivated.

Pay Rate: $23/hr - 23.50/hr
We are equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.

What we offer you

What we offer you:
401K plan with up to a 6% company match.
12 Paid Holidays.
Paid Time Off
Comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, vision, life, short- and long-term disability.
Health savings account with employer matching
4 weeks of paid parental leave
Motivating wellness program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro L'Assembler è responsabile di mettere insieme parti dei componenti o prodotti in base a progetti o schemi. Questo ruolo assicura che gli oggetti assemblati soddisfino gli standard di qualità e supportano la linea di produzione mantenendo efficienza e precisione. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Assembler is responsible for putting together component parts or products according to blueprints or schematics. This role ensures that assembled items meet quality standards and supports the production line by maintaining efficiency and accuracy.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Position Summary:
Under indirect supervision and following JWCE’s Standard Operating Procedures, reads electric schematics and interprets wiring diagrams to assemble, wire, troubleshoot, and complete low voltage, hydraulic package and final quality testing of electrical motor control panels and enclosures.
Principle Duties and Responsibilities:

• Performs essential wiring of control panels used in monitoring and controlling electric motors & hydraulic power packs.

• Performs final quality assurance of all series controls in accordance with company practices, and UL, NEMA, NEC and CSA requirements.

• Matches complex picking lists and motor control diagrams and review, correct and document discrepancies.

• Identifies problems and resolves issues to ensure system functions properly.

• Performs high pot testing of motor control.

• Assists QA technicians with basic inspection and testing of all model control panels.

• Maintains organized work station and area.

• Adheres to safety standards of facility.

• Performs other duties and special projects as assigned.

• Must be able to lift up to 35lbs.

• Must be able to stand for extended periods of time.
Experience, Education & Skills:
Required: High School Degree
Desirable: 2-year Vocational Certificate in HVAC, Electrical, or Electronics is a plus.

• 2+ years’ experience in a UL Motor Control Panel Shop or Hands-on in a class room setting.

• Knowledgeable using test meters to perform point-to-point continuity checks.

• Possess a thorough understanding of control theory and control concepts.

• Feels comfortable working with medium voltage (up to 120 VAC)

• Ability to read schematics and interpret wiring diagrams.

• Able to use basic electrical hand tools. (cutting, crimping, and stripping)

• Attention to detail.

• Highly self-motivated.

Pay Rate: $23/hr - 23.50/hr
We are equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.

What we offer you:
401K plan with up to a 6% company match.
12 Paid Holidays.
Paid Time Off

4 weeks of paid parental leave
Motivating wellness program

Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Le Sr. Production Worker / Technician est chargé d'assembler, de tester et d'inspecter les produits manufacturés pour s'assurer qu'ils répondent aux normes de qualité et de sécurité. Ce rôle fonctionne de façon indépendante sur des tâches complexes, soutient le dépannage et peut guider les techniciens subalternes. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné au personnel de soutien expérimenté qui travaille généralement de façon autonome et qui n'a besoin que d'une supervision plus étroite dans des situations non courantes. Sommaire du poste : Sous supervision indirecte et suivant les procédures d'exploitation standard de JWCE, lit les schémas électriques et interprète les schémas de câblage pour assembler, filer, dépanner, et complet basse tension, paquet hydraulique et essais de qualité finale des panneaux et boîtiers de commande du moteur électrique. Principales fonctions et responsabilités :
• Effectue le câblage essentiel des panneaux de commande utilisés pour la surveillance et le contrôle des moteurs électriques et des groupes hydrauliques.
• Assure la qualité finale de tous les contrôles de série conformément aux pratiques de l'entreprise et aux exigences de l'UL, de la NEMA, de la NEC et de l'ASC.
• Correspond aux listes de sélection complexes et aux diagrammes de contrôle moteur et examine, corrige et documente les écarts.
• Identifier les problèmes et résoudre les problèmes pour assurer le bon fonctionnement du système.
• Effectue des essais de haute puissance de contrôle moteur.
• Aide les techniciens de l'AQ pour l'inspection et l'essai de base de tous les modèles de panneaux de commande.
• Maintenir un poste de travail et une zone organisés.
• Respect des normes de sécurité des installations.
• Exécute d'autres tâches et des projets spéciaux selon les affectations.
• Il doit pouvoir soulever jusqu'à 35 livres.
• Doit être en mesure de supporter de longues périodes de temps. Expérience, éducation et compétences : Requis : Diplôme d'études secondaires Désirable : Certificat professionnel de 2 ans en CVC, électrique ou électronique est un plus.
• 2+ ans d'expérience dans un UL Motor Control Panel Shop ou Hands-on dans une salle de classe.
• Connaissance de l'utilisation de compteurs d'essai pour effectuer des contrôles de continuité point à point.
• Posséder une compréhension approfondie de la théorie du contrôle et des concepts de contrôle.
• Se sent à l'aise de travailler avec une tension moyenne (jusqu'à 120 VAC)
• Capacité de lire les schémas et d'interpréter les diagrammes de câblage.
• Capable d'utiliser des outils électriques de base. (découpe, sertissage et décapage)
• Attention aux détails.
• Très motivé. Taux de rémunération : 23 $/h - 23,50 $/h Nous sommes un employeur à égalité de chances et d'action positive. Ce que nous vous offrons Ce que nous vous offrons: Plan de 401K avec jusqu'à un match de 6 %. 12 Vacances payées. Temps d'arrêt payé Programme complet d'avantages sociaux, y compris les soins médicaux, dentaires, la vision, la vie, l'invalidité de courte et de longue durée. Compte d'épargne santé avec adéquation employeur 4 semaines de congé parental payé Programme de bien-être motivant Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Project Scheduler
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Our newly refurbished Leeds facility our Advanced Pump Design and Manufacturing Centre of Excellence, where highly engineered, bespoke pumping solutions are designed, built and delivered for some of the world’s most demanding applications. Our pumps operate in environments where failure isn’t an option — from energy, oil & gas, chemicals, water, nuclear and heavy industry, serving global customers who expect absolute precision, reliability and performance.

We’re looking for an experienced Project Scheduler to take ownership of planning and scheduling across large, complex engineering projects — the kind with long lead times, multiple workstreams and a lot of moving parts. You’ll be at the heart of the project lifecycle, building and maintaining detailed schedules that align engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing and delivery. This is a role for someone who enjoys turning complexity into clarity.

What you’ll be doing

• Developing, maintaining and controlling end‑to‑end project schedules using MS Project

• Working closely with Project Managers, Engineering, Supply Chain and Manufacturing to ensure plans are realistic, integrated and achievable

• Managing schedule risk, critical paths and dependencies across complex, multi‑discipline projects

• Using SAP to track progress, materials, production milestones and performance

• Providing clear schedule reporting, forecasts and insights to support decision‑making

• Driving continuous improvement in planning standards, tools and processes

What we’re looking for

• Proven experience as a Project Scheduler / Planner within large, complex engineering or manufacturing projects

• Strong, hands‑on experience with MS Project

• Working knowledge of SAP within a project or manufacturing environment

• Comfortable managing projects with many interdependencies, long lead items and competing priorities

• Confident communicator who can challenge constructively and influence stakeholders

• A structured, detail‑driven mindset with the ability to see the bigger picture

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Il nostro nuovo impianto Leeds rinnovato il nostro Advanced Pump Design and Manufacturing Centre of Excellence, dove le soluzioni di pompaggio su misura sono progettate, costruite e consegnate per alcune delle applicazioni più esigenti del mondo. Le nostre pompe operano in ambienti in cui il fallimento non è un'opzione — da energia, petrolio e gas, prodotti chimici, acqua, nucleare e industria pesante, servendo clienti globali che si aspettano una precisione assoluta, affidabilità e prestazioni. Stiamo cercando un programmatore di progetto esperto per prendere la proprietà di pianificazione e pianificazione attraverso grandi e complessi progetti di ingegneria — il tipo con lunghi tempi di piombo, più flussi di lavoro e un sacco di parti in movimento. Sarete al centro del ciclo di vita del progetto, la costruzione e il mantenimento di programmi dettagliati che allineano l'ingegneria, l'approvvigionamento, la produzione, il test e la consegna. Questo è un ruolo per qualcuno che ama trasformare la complessità in chiarezza. Cosa farai
• Sviluppare, mantenere e controllare i programmi di progetto end-to-end utilizzando MS Project
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con Project Manager, Engineering, Supply Chain e Manufacturing per garantire che i piani siano realistici, integrati e realizzabili
• Gestione del rischio di pianificazione, percorsi critici e dipendenze attraverso progetti complessi e multidisciplinari
• Utilizzando SAP per monitorare i progressi, i materiali, le tappe di produzione e le prestazioni
• Fornire reportage, previsioni e approfondimenti chiari per supportare il processo decisionale
• Miglioramento continuo delle norme, degli strumenti e dei processi di pianificazione Cosa stiamo cercando
• Esperienza comprovata come programmatore di progetto / Planner all'interno di grandi, complessi progetti di ingegneria o di produzione
• Esperienza forte e pratica con MS Project
• Conoscenze di lavoro di SAP all'interno di un progetto o ambiente di produzione
• Confortevoli progetti di gestione con molte interdipendenze, oggetti di piombo lunghi e priorità concorrenti
• Confidente comunicatore che può sfidare costruttivamente e influenzare gli stakeholder
• Una mentalità strutturata e dettagliata con la capacità di vedere l'immagine più grande Cosa ti offriamo Vantaggi del nucleo
• Uno stipendio competitivo
• Un sistema di bonus a livello aziendale
• Medicash Health Cash Plan (copertura delle spese sanitarie quotidiane come i servizi dentali, ottici e GP)
• 33 giorni di vacanza
• Contributo pensionistico
• Programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti
• Sconti su shopping, intrattenimento e stile di vita
• Opzione di abbonamento Costco
• Noleggio auto personali scontati per te, famiglia e amici

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Unsere neu renovierte Leeds-Anlage ist unser Advanced Pump Design and Manufacturing Centre of Excellence, in dem hochentwickelte, maßgeschneiderte Pumpenlösungen für einige der weltweit anspruchsvollsten Anwendungen entwickelt, gebaut und geliefert werden. Unsere Pumpen arbeiten in Umgebungen, in denen ein Ausfall keine Option ist - von Energie, Öl und Gas, Chemikalien, Wasser, Kernkraft und Schwerindustrie - und bedienen globale Kunden, die absolute Präzision, Zuverlässigkeit und Leistung erwarten. Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Projektplaner, der die Planung und Planung großer, komplexer Engineering-Projekte übernimmt - die Art mit langen Vorlaufzeiten, mehreren Workstreams und vielen beweglichen Teilen. Sie stehen im Mittelpunkt des Projektlebenszyklus und erstellen und pflegen detaillierte Zeitpläne, die Engineering, Beschaffung, Fertigung, Test und Lieferung aufeinander abstimmen. jobs.title: Production Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Production Manager is responsible for managing day-to-day production of service center activities, ensuring efficiency, quality, and safety in manufacturing or service processes. This role supervises teams, coordinates resources, and supports continuous improvement efforts. Key Responsibilities

• Supervise a team of 8-10 Welders, Machinist, Mechanics, and Shipping/Receiving employees to ensure adherence to project schedules.

• Monitor production or service metrics and implement improvements (5S, Six Sigma).

• Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards (ISO).

• Coordinate with maintenance and logistics to support operations.

• Train and develop team members.

• Support implementation of lean manufacturing practices.

• Report performance and issues to senior management.

Skills & Qualifications

• Bachelor degree preferred (equivalent work experience will be considered)

• 6+ years of experience managing and coordinating one or more expert-level teams.

• Experience in manufacturing or production management.

• Strong leadership and problem-solving skills.

• Familiarity with lean tools and continuous improvement.

• Proficiency in production software and reporting tools.

• Effective communication and team-building abilities.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a non-OEM rotating equipment repair facility located in the Houston area. Sulzer is comprised of several divisions that include the Component Repair Division. Departments within the Component Repair division include Combustion, Stationary, Mechanical, Rotating, Fuel/Flow and Inspection departments. jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer's Los Angeles Service Center (LASC) is hiring a Repair Coordinator to own the execution of pump repair jobs from order entry through final delivery.

This is a central role that bridges Sales, the Shop, Engineering, Quality, and the customer — making sure scope, schedule, documentation, and communication stay aligned on every job in our backlog.

You will manage a portfolio of active repair orders for centrifugal pumps (BB1–BB5, OH, VS) serving power generation, refining, water, and industrial customers across the Western U.S. The role is high-visibility, fast-paced, and well-supported by experienced Sales Reps, Shop Leads, and Engineering.

Key responsibilities

• Own assigned repair jobs end-to-end: order entry, scope confirmation, inspection reporting, repair execution tracking, final documentation, and on-time delivery.

• Build and issue technical proposals (inspection reports, repair quotes, supplementary scope) using the LASC standard template, in coordination with the assigned Sales Representative.

• Coordinate daily with Shop Leads and the Service Center Superintendent on job scheduling, resource allocation, parts availability, and execution priorities.

• Manage customer communication on job status, inspection findings, photos, scope changes, and revised delivery dates; schedule and confirm customer Witness and Hold Points.

• Maintain accurate job data in SAP — order status, milestones, hours, materials, costs, and delivery dates — and support backlog reviews and forecasting.

• Compile and harmonize inspection documentation: BOMs, dimensional reports, photo packages, NDE results, and final repair reports for customer delivery.

• Coordinate with Engineering on technical clarifications, non-standard repairs, and engineered solutions.

• Support Quality (ISO 9001) and EHS (ISO 14001 / 45001) procedures across the jobs you own; participate in nonconformity tracking and corrective actions when applicable.

• Coordinate logistics: inbound equipment receipt, parts procurement follow-up, and outbound shipping to the customer.

Required qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of experience in repair shop coordination, project coordination, customer service in industrial services, or a related operations role.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable interfacing directly with industrial customers (procurement, reliability, and maintenance contacts).

• Working knowledge of mechanical equipment — pumps, compressors, motors, or other rotating equipment.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook); able to read and interpret mechanical drawings and BOMs.

• Strong organizational discipline: able to manage 15–30+ concurrent jobs at different stages without losing track of commitments.

• High school diploma or equivalent; technical or engineering education a strong plus.

Preferred qualifications

• Direct experience with centrifugal pumps or rotating equipment repair.

• Experience using SAP (order management, project systems, or service modules).

• Prior experience in an ISO 9001-certified repair shop or service center.

• Familiarity with API 610 / API 682 and customer specifications common in oil and gas, power, and water markets.

Location: Santa Fe Springs, CA (on-site)

About the role

Sulzer's Los Angeles Service Center (LASC) is hiring a Repair Coordinator to own the execution of pump repair jobs from order entry through final delivery.

This is a central role that bridges Sales, the Shop, Engineering, Quality, and the customer — making sure scope, schedule, documentation, and communication stay aligned on every job in our backlog.

You will manage a portfolio of active repair orders for centrifugal pumps (BB1–BB5, OH, VS) serving power generation, refining, water, and industrial customers across the Western U.S. The role is high-visibility, fast-paced, and well-supported by experienced Sales Reps, Shop Leads, and Engineering.

Key responsibilities

• Own assigned repair jobs end-to-end: order entry, scope confirmation, inspection reporting, repair execution tracking, final documentation, and on-time delivery.

• Build and issue technical proposals (inspection reports, repair quotes, supplementary scope) using the LASC standard template, in coordination with the assigned Sales Representative.

• Coordinate daily with Shop Leads and the Service Center Superintendent on job scheduling, resource allocation, parts availability, and execution priorities.

• Manage customer communication on job status, inspection findings, photos, scope changes, and revised delivery dates; schedule and confirm customer Witness and Hold Points.

• Maintain accurate job data in SAP — order status, milestones, hours, materials, costs, and delivery dates — and support backlog reviews and forecasting.

• Compile and harmonize inspection documentation: BOMs, dimensional reports, photo packages, NDE results, and final repair reports for customer delivery.

• Coordinate with Engineering on technical clarifications, non-standard repairs, and engineered solutions.

• Support Quality (ISO 9001) and EHS (ISO 14001 / 45001) procedures across the jobs you own; participate in nonconformity tracking and corrective actions when applicable.

• Coordinate logistics: inbound equipment receipt, parts procurement follow-up, and outbound shipping to the customer.

Required qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of experience in repair shop coordination, project coordination, customer service in industrial services, or a related operations role.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable interfacing directly with industrial customers (procurement, reliability, and maintenance contacts).

• Working knowledge of mechanical equipment — pumps, compressors, motors, or other rotating equipment.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook); able to read and interpret mechanical drawings and BOMs.

• Strong organizational discipline: able to manage 15–30+ concurrent jobs at different stages without losing track of commitments.

• High school diploma or equivalent; technical or engineering education a strong plus.

Preferred qualifications

• Direct experience with centrifugal pumps or rotating equipment repair.

• Experience using SAP (order management, project systems, or service modules).

• Prior experience in an ISO 9001-certified repair shop or service center.

• Familiarity with API 610 / API 682 and customer specifications common in oil and gas, power, and water markets.

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we’re known globally for engineering excellence – but here in Leeds, we’re especially proud of the people who make it happen. With a team of around 350 highly skilled colleagues on site, we specialise in advanced engineering, precision manufacturing and high quality pump services that support critical sectors across the UK and worldwide. About the Role

We’re looking for a proactive, organised and people focused Administrator who loves variety and isn’t afraid to take the initiative. As the first point of contact for visitors, customers and colleagues, you’ll be a friendly, confident presence who enjoys building rapport and interacting with people at all levels of the business.
This is a hands on, fast paced role for someone who naturally spots what needs doing and gets on with it. You’ll take ownership of tasks, solve problems as they arise and help keep everything running smoothly behind the scenes. Working as part of a supportive Administration team, you’ll collaborate closely with departments across the business, providing practical support, coordination and ideas to help teams work efficiently and effectively.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Working as part of the administrative team to ensure smooth daily operations – providing flexible support to teams across the site when business needs require.

• Greeting visitors and managing all front-of-house activity with professionalism and warmth

• Handling incoming calls, customer queries and complaints, ensuring swift and effective resolution

• Overseeing meeting room management

• Managing business systems (SAP, Concur, Egencia, Softworks) and producing reports

• Coordinating wellbeing initiatives and key site communications

• Administering clock cards, SAP set-ups, post handling, parking permits and visitor logistics

• Supporting emergency procedures and promoting a safe working environment

• Ensuring excellent customer experience at every touchpoint – representing the Administration team’s commitment to collaborative, business-wide service.

What You’ll Bring

• Strong interpersonal and customer service skills

• Great organisational ability and a high level of attention to detail

• Confidence working independently and taking ownership of tasks

• Flexibility, problem-solving mindset and ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment

• Experience in administration or assistant roles

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office packages

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Were proud to support those whove served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoDs Defence Employer Recognition Scheme meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

At Sulzer Leeds, we foster a vibrant work environment where your expertise and dedication are truly valued. Enjoy exciting perks and exclusive benefits, including:

• A lively Sport & Social Club with weekly and monthly prize draws, unforgettable outings, birthday surprises, and more

• 24/7 onsite gym to keep you energised

• Subsidised vending machines

• A canteen serving delicious hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We beli

Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Le comptable est chargé d'appuyer les opérations comptables, y compris la saisie des données, les rapprochements et l'établissement de rapports financiers. Ce rôle assure l'exactitude des documents financiers et appuie la conformité aux normes comptables. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels en début de carrière qui appliquent de vastes connaissances théoriques et qui ont besoin de la capacité d'étudier et d'analyser les problèmes. Les solutions sont généralement discutées/vérifiées avec un membre plus âgé. Le comptable chargé de la facturation de l'Ordonnance à l'encaisse est chargé de superviser le processus de facturation, d'assurer l'exactitude des factures et de gérer le grand livre des comptes débiteurs. Principales responsabilités
• Préparer et délivrer des factures aux clients sur la base de contrats de service et de bons de commande, en assurant l'exactitude des détails de facturation et le respect des conditions contractuelles
• Collaborer étroitement avec le gestionnaire de projet local
• Examiner et rapprocher les données de facturation pour en assurer l'exhaustivité et l'exactitude, en apportant les ajustements ou corrections nécessaires
• Collaborer avec les équipes de vente, de service à la clientèle et de gestion de projet pour recueillir l'information nécessaire à la facturation et résoudre les problèmes liés à la facturation
• Maintenir et mettre à jour les renseignements et les dossiers de facturation des clients dans le système de facturation
• Surveiller les détails des comptes clients pour les non-paiements, les retards de paiement et les autres irrégularités, et suivre au besoin; effectuer les activités de dunning au besoin
• Aider au processus des comptes débiteurs, y compris l'enregistrement des paiements et la mise à jour des registres des clients
• Effectuer une analyse des EI, des revenus et du vieillissement
• Appuyer les processus de clôture de fin de mois et de fin d'exercice, y compris la préparation des entrées de journaux et des rapprochements de comptes liés à la facturation
• Générer et analyser des rapports de facturation, fournir des renseignements et des recommandations pour améliorer le processus de facturation et réduire les erreurs. Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Reporting & Analytics
• Assurer la conformité avec les contrôles internes, les politiques comptables et les exigences réglementaires du CTB en matière de facturation
• Participer à la mise en oeuvre et à l'amélioration des systèmes et procédures de facturation pour accroître l'efficacité et l'exactitude
• Fournir un appui lors des vérifications internes et externes en préparant les documents requis et en répondant aux demandes de renseignements des vérificateurs concernant la facturation Éducation et expérience

• L'expérience dans les secteurs manufacturier ou industriel est privilégiée Facteurs de succès essentiels
• Connaissance approfondie des principes comptables, de la comptabilisation des recettes et du processus de facturation
• Compétence en interprétation des rapports de facturation

• Fortes compétences en communication pour fournir des renseignements clés aux comptables principaux de la facturation, au gestionnaire de la comptabilité du Conseil de l'Europe, à l'équipe de rapports et d'analyses et aux chefs des finances par pays Compétences techniques et linguistiques

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Sales Representative to join our team in Orange, TX or Pasadena, TX . In this role, you will work closely with senior sales leaders to support account management, drive new business development, and ensure a seamless customer experience. This is an excellent opportunity for an aspiring professional to gain hands-on field experience, develop deep industry knowledge, and contribute to the overall success of our sales operations

Responsibilities:

• Support senior sales representatives in managing and growing assigned customer accounts

• Conduct customer visits alongside senior team members to build relationships and gain field experience

• Assist in identifying new business opportunities through prospecting, site visits, and customer engagement

• Support preparation of quotes and proposals, ensuring accuracy and timely follow-up

• Participate in project-related communications, including status updates and coordination with customers, operations, and internal stakeholders

• Maintain and update sales pipeline and customer activities in D365 and Salesforce

• Help coordinate customer visits, facility tours, and test runs (e.g., TDI, inspections)

• Collaborate with inside sales and operations to support order processing, delivery timelines, and customer expectations

• Attend sales meetings, production/WIP meetings, and contribute to action tracking and follow-ups

Ideal Background and Minimum Qualifications:

• 1–2 years of experience in an inside sales or support role, ideally within the industrial or manufacturing sectors.

• You have a working knowledge of electromechanical equipment, including pumps, motors, generators, or industrial repair services.

• A degree is preferred but not required; we value hands-on experience and aptitude.

• You are as comfortable explaining technical solutions over the phone as you are planning to eventually present them in person.

• High School diploma or GED equivalent

Physical and Travel Requirements:

• Ability to travel up to 25% of the time to visit client sites, attend trade events, or shadow field sales representatives.

• Must possess a valid driver’s license and the ability to operate a vehicle to visit customer locations as needed.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Treasury Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In the role (Probation, 6 months), you will be a member of the Group Treasury Team Pune and in charge of various treasury topics. You will work in a global team of treasury professionals with specific responsibilities, and you will assume regular as well as ad-hoc tasks. Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Invoice Management: Operationally support the financing programs with invoice collection, accounts payable oversight, reports to service providers and banks and constant communication to Group Treasury

• Regular balance sanity & checks: Regularly perform sanities on reported Balances and loans from subsidiaries, report findings to Group Treasury

• Bank Account Management: Execute regular bank A/Cs & signatory rights check and perform the bank A/C reconciliation.

• Regular Sanity Checks: Aligning and analyzing the reported figures between different treasury tools.

• FX/Loan Management: Collect, sanitize, correct, and upload transactions from subsidiaries into the treasury management system.

• Knowledge of Intercompany reconciliation & Intercompany netting.

• Ad-hoc tasks, initiatives & database management.

Key Interfaces:

• Group Treasury Team (Switzerland/Spain/USA/Mexico)

• Regional Treasury Managers

• GTR Pune

• Service Providers
Education requirements:

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance/accounting or equivalent experience

• Certification in treasury, corporate finance or AR/AP management would be a plus.

Job experience:

• Minimum experience of 2-7 yrs. in corporate treasury, banking or industrial company. Experience in global work environment is a must.

Knowledge requirements (professional, technical, language):

• Fluency in written and spoken English is a must.

• Excellent command of MS Office especially with MS Excel

• Knowledge of treasury reporting

• Knowledge of BI took Qlik is plus

Insurance benefit
Company transport

jobs.title: Senior FP&A Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Controller Specialist is responsible for executing core financial control activities, including the preparation of financial reports, account reconciliations, and compliance with internal controls. This role supports the accuracy and integrity of financial data and contributes to the organization’s financial planning and reporting processes.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals.
• Key Responsibilities

• Prepare and consolidate the annual budget

• Refresh predictive financial forecasts periodically

• Conduct profitability and performance reporting

• Perform plan analytics and risk management, managing and continuously improving the financial planning and analysis processes

• Provide recommendation to the business based on in depth financial analysis

• Manage collections reporting and analytics, ensuring accurate and timely information to support decision-making

• Provide comprehensive reporting and analytics on procurement activities, contributing to informed purchasing decisions

• Oversee the period end close processes, generating accurate and insightful period end financial reports and analytics to ensure financial integrity

• Handle period end closing, and related analytics, ensuring thorough and precise financial tracking and reporting for projects

• Oversee CAPEX planning, forecasting, investment strategy, period-end close activities and reporting

• Ensure all financial reporting and processes comply with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS)

• Ensure internal controls are in place for the processes performed by this role

• Comply with relevant QESH regulations
Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 5 -7 years of experience in financial planning and analysis or related finance roles

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred
Critical success factors

• Proficiency in financial modelling and forecasting, advanced skills in data analytics and financial software

• Strong understanding of global financial processes and standards

• Strong financial acumen

• Excellent communication skills for delivering key insights to leadership

• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with other stakeholders
Technical & language skills

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Understanding of integrated ERP systems is a plus

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Proficiency in English

What we offer you

Medical insurance for self and family
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days

About the role

Job Summary
The Controller Specialist is responsible for executing core financial control activities, including the preparation of financial reports, account reconciliations, and compliance with internal controls. This role supports the accuracy and integrity of financial data and contributes to the organization’s financial planning and reporting processes.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals.

• Refresh predictive financial forecasts periodically

• Conduct profitability and performance reporting

• Perform plan analytics and risk management, managing and continuously improving the financial planning and analysis processes

• Provide recommendation to the business based on in depth financial analysis

• Manage collections reporting and analytics, ensuring accurate and timely information to support decision-making

• Provide comprehensive reporting and analytics on procurement activities, contributing to informed purchasing decisions

• Oversee the period end close processes, generating accurate and insightful period end financial reports and analytics to ensure financial integrity

• Handle period end closing, and related analytics, ensuring thorough and precise financial tracking and reporting for projects

• Oversee CAPEX planning, forecasting, investment strategy, period-end close activities and reporting

• Ensure all financial reporting and processes comply with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS)

• Ensure internal controls are in place for the processes performed by this role

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 5 -7 years of experience in financial planning and analysis or related finance roles

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred

Technical & language skills

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Sr. Application Engineer develops technical proposals for projects including proposing modifications to the standard design and configures the using design and costing tools. Works independently and develops technical responses to the customer.

Essential Functions:

• Applies in-depth knowledge of job area typically obtained through advanced education and work experience.

• Screens customer's inquiries to ensure they contain all information required to submit a quotation.

• Liaises with sales /customers to obtain any missing information.

• Collects, understands, and interprets customer’s requirements for new and/or operating data from customer’s existing systems.

• Development of the technical proposal/quotation, including equipment description and specifications, and reviews and negotiates necessary technical revisions with the customer.

• Responds to questions and inquiries from the customer regarding technical problems and issues that arise and provides related technical support or assistance, in a timely manner.

• Upon customer order, reviews/approves the scope of supply and creates job file per Sulzer specifications.

• Understands and provides solutions to large and/or complex problems

• Requires independent judgement, initiative and sound decision making

Secondary Functions:

• Meets with customers on-site, as required, to review specifications and requirements, present and discuss the company’s proposal, and participate in project initiation as needed.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering

• 3+ years' experience in design of biological wastewater treatment systems

• 2+ years’ experience in technical sales work with an understanding of how to interpret customer’s technical requirements

• Basic understanding of unit operations and wastewater analysis

• Conceptual system aptitude

• Excellent communication skills

• Self-motivated and takes initiatives

• Strong planning and organizational skills

• Open to learning

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The FP&A Specialist is responsible for supporting financial planning and analysis activities, including budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting. This role applies advanced knowledge to deliver financial insights that support strategic and operational decisions.

This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower-level professionals. Job Responsibilities

• Support the preparation of annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long-term plans.

• Perform variance analysis between actual and budgeted/forecasted results, identifying causes and their implications.

• Collaborate in the preparation of periodic financial reports for local and corporate management.

• Assist in the development and maintenance of financial models to support various business initiatives.

• Participate in process improvement projects within the finance department.

• Collect and analyze financial data from various sources to identify trends and opportunities.

• Maintain the integrity and accuracy of financial data used in analyses.

• Support the preparation of financial presentations for different audiences.

Job Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

• 2–4 years of previous experience in a similar FP&A, financial analysis, or accounting role.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, complex formulas, financial modeling).

• Knowledge of ERP systems (SAP preferred) and Business Intelligence (BI) tools.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex financial data.

• Attention to detail and high level of precision in work.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a dynamic environment.

jobs.title: Field Service Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Field) Service Sr. Coordinator is responsible for coordinating field service activities including installation, configuration, calibration, and repair of technical products and systems at customer locations. This role supports service delivery and may guide other professional-level staff in non-routine situations.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations.
The Field Service Supervisor plays a key role in ensuring that all services are executed with quality, efficiency, and safety. This role acts as a bridge between the customer and the national technical team, working closely with the Operations Director, the Operations Backoffice and the Workshop Coordinator. The supervisor is responsible for the end‑to‑end management of all field activities (maintenance, incidents, breakdowns, commissioning, and supervision).

Key Responsibilities

• Technical team coordination: Assign daily tasks to field technicians based on priorities and workload, ensuring efficient execution.

• Materials and resources control: Ensure that technicians have the necessary tools, materials, and documentation to complete tasks quickly and effectively.

• Work order monitoring: Follow up on work orders, validate the technical closure, and ensure that all required information is included (photos, reports, readings, etc.).

• Direct customer communication: Plan and coordinate field activities with the customer, ensuring that work can be carried out safely and within the agreed timelines.

• Maintenance contract planning and tracking: Verify that all related documentation is up to date and that maintenance activities are carried out in accordance with contractual requirements.

• Continuous improvement: Propose operational and procedural improvements based on field reality, and analyze the causes of rework and recurring incidents.

What you need to succeed
Experience & Technical Background

• Proven experience in field service supervision or coordination within an industrial environment (e.g. civil construction, hydraulic installations, industrial maintenance).

• Strong technical knowledge and diagnostic skills , with the ability to support and guide field technicians.

• Experience working with field service management tools , work orders, and technical reporting.

• Hands‑on exposure to on‑site customer environments , managing incidents, breakdowns, and maintenance activities.

Skills & Competencies

• Ability to work autonomously while coordinating and prioritizing activities of a distributed field team.

• Strong communication and customer‑oriented mindset , with proven experience dealing directly with customers on site.

• Structured and proactive approach, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.

• Problem‑solving mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

Languages & Mobility

• High level of English (able to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders and customers).

• Availability to travel across Iberia as required by field activities.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• Company car as a tool of trade

• Other fringe benefits

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro Il Coordinatore (Field) Service Sr. è responsabile del coordinamento delle attività di servizio sul campo, tra cui installazione, configurazione, calibrazione e riparazione di prodotti e sistemi tecnici nelle sedi dei clienti. Questo ruolo supporta la fornitura di servizi e può guidare altri personale di livello professionale in situazioni non routine. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a personale di livello professionale che lavora autonomamente e può coordinare le attività di altri personale di livello professionale, soprattutto in situazioni non di routine. Il Field Service Supervisor svolge un ruolo chiave nel garantire che tutti i servizi siano eseguiti con qualità, efficienza e sicurezza. Questo ruolo funge da ponte tra il cliente e il team tecnico nazionale, lavorando a stretto contatto con il Direttore Operativo, il Backoffice Operativo e il Coordinatore Workshop. Il supervisore è responsabile della gestione end-to-end di tutte le attività sul campo (manutenzione, incidenti, guasti, messa in servizio e supervisione). Principali responsabilità
• Coordinamento tecnico del team: Assegnare compiti quotidiani ai tecnici di campo basati su priorità e carico di lavoro, garantendo un'esecuzione efficiente.
• Controllo dei materiali e delle risorse: Assicurarsi che i tecnici abbiano gli strumenti necessari, i materiali e la documentazione per completare i compiti in modo rapido ed efficace.
• Monitoraggio dell'ordine di lavoro: Seguire gli ordini di lavoro, convalidare la chiusura tecnica e garantire che tutte le informazioni richieste siano incluse (foto, report, letture, ecc.).
• Comunicazione diretta del cliente: pianificare e coordinare le attività sul campo con il cliente, assicurando che il lavoro possa essere effettuato in modo sicuro e entro i termini concordati.
• Pianificazione e tracciamento del contratto di manutenzione: verifica che tutta la documentazione relativa è aggiornata e che le attività di manutenzione sono svolte in conformità con i requisiti contrattuali.
• Miglioramento continuo: Proporre miglioramenti operativi e procedurali basati sulla realtà del campo, e analizzare le cause di rilavoro e incidenti ricorrenti. Cosa devi avere successo Esperienza & Sfondo tecnico
• Esperienza comprovata nella supervisione del servizio sul campo o nel coordinamento in un ambiente industriale (ad esempio costruzione civile, impianti idraulici, manutenzione industriale).
• Forte conoscenza tecnica e competenze diagnostiche, con la capacità di supportare e guidare i tecnici del campo.
• Esperienza di lavoro con strumenti di gestione dei servizi di campo , ordini di lavoro e reporting tecnico.
• Esposizione manuale agli ambienti dei clienti in loco, gestione di incidenti, guasti e attività di manutenzione. Competenze e competenze
• Capacità di lavorare autonomamente mentre coordina e privilegia le attività di un team di campo distribuito.
• Forte comunicazione e mentalità orientata al cliente , con esperienza comprovata che si occupa direttamente con i clienti in loco.
• Approccio strutturato e proattivo, con la capacità di gestire più compiti e priorità contemporaneamente.
• Mindset problem-solving e orientamento continuo miglioramento. Lingue e mobilità
• Alto livello di inglese (in grado di comunicare efficacemente con gli stakeholder interni e i clienti).
• Disponibilità per viaggiare attraverso Iberia come richiesto dalle attività sul campo. Cosa ti offriamo
• Un contratto permanente.
• Uno stipendio competitivo e la partecipazione al sistema di remunerazione variabile basato su obiettivi personali e finanziari.
• Biglietti del ristorante
• Fai parte di un team esperto e internazionale.
• Una buona atmosfera ambiente di lavoro.
• Auto aziendale come strumento di commercio
• Altri vantaggi Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Stellenbeschreibung Der (Feld-)Service Sr. Coordinator ist verantwortlich für die Koordination der Außendienstaktivitäten einschließlich Installation, Konfiguration, Kalibrierung und Reparatur von technischen Produkten und Systemen an Kundenstandorten. Diese Rolle unterstützt die Servicebereitstellung und kann andere professionelle Mitarbeiter in nicht routinemäßigen Situationen führen. Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an professionelle Mitarbeiter, die autonom arbeiten und die Aktivitäten anderer professioneller Mitarbeiter koordinieren können, insbesondere in nicht routinemäßigen Situationen. Der Field Service Supervisor spielt eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Sicherstellung, dass alle Dienste mit Qualität, Effizienz und Sicherheit ausgeführt werden. Diese Rolle bildet eine Brücke zwischen dem Kunden und dem nationalen technischen Team und arbeitet eng mit dem Operations Director, dem Operations Backoffice und dem Workshop-Koordinator zusammen. Der Betreuer ist verantwortlich für das Ende-zu-Ende-Management aller Vor-Ort-Aktivitäten (Wartung, Vorfälle, Pannen, Inbetriebnahme und Aufsicht). Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
• Koordination des technischen Teams: Weisen Sie den Außendiensttechnikern tägliche Aufgaben zu, die auf Prioritäten und Arbeitsbelastung basieren, um eine effiziente Ausführung zu gewährleisten.
• Material- und Ressourcenkontrolle: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Techniker über die notwendigen Werkzeuge, Materialien und Dokumentationen verfügen, um Aufgaben schnell und effektiv abzuschließen.
• Auftragsüberwachung: Weiterverfolgung von Arbeitsaufträgen, Validierung des technischen Abschlusses und Sicherstellung, dass alle erforderlichen Informationen (Fotos, Berichte, Lesungen usw.) enthalten sind.
• Direkte Kundenkommunikation: Planen und koordinieren Sie die Aktivitäten vor Ort mit dem Kunden, um sicherzustellen, dass die Arbeiten sicher und innerhalb der vereinbarten Fristen durchgeführt werden können.
• Planung und Nachverfolgung von Wartungsverträgen: Vergewissern Sie sich, dass alle damit verbundenen Dokumentationen auf dem neuesten Stand sind und dass Wartungsarbeiten gemäß den vertraglichen Anforderungen durchgeführt werden.
• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Vorschlag für operative und prozedurale Verbesserungen basierend auf der Realität im Feld und Analyse der Ursachen von Nacharbeiten und wiederkehrenden Vorfällen. Was Sie brauchen, um erfolgreich zu sein Erfahrung & technischer Hintergrund
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Außendienstüberwachung oder -koordination in einem industriellen Umfeld (z. B. Bau im Tiefbau, hydraulische Anlagen, industrielle Wartung).
• Starke technische Kenntnisse und diagnostische Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, Außendiensttechniker zu unterstützen und zu führen.
• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Field Service Management Tools, Arbeitsaufträgen und technischem Reporting.
• Hands-on-Exposition gegenüber Kundenumgebungen vor Ort, Management von Vorfällen, Pannen und Wartungsaktivitäten. Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen
• Fähigkeit, autonom zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig die Aktivitäten eines verteilten Feldteams zu koordinieren und zu priorisieren.
• Starke Kommunikation und kundenorientierte Denkweise, mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung im direkten Umgang mit Kunden vor Ort.
• Strukturierter und proaktiver Ansatz mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben und Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu verwalten.
• Problemlösungsdenken und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsorientierung. Sprachen & Mobilität
• Hohes Englischniveau (in der Lage, effektiv mit internen Stakeholdern und Kunden zu kommunizieren).

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Le coordonnateur des services (sur le terrain) est chargé de coordonner les activités des services sur le terrain, y compris l'installation, la configuration, l'étalonnage et la réparation des produits et systèmes techniques dans les lieux d'affectation des clients. Ce rôle appuie la prestation de services et peut guider d'autres professionnels dans des situations non courantes. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné au personnel de niveau professionnel qui travaille de manière autonome et peut coordonner les activités d'autres personnels de niveau professionnel, en particulier dans des situations non courantes. Le superviseur du Service mobile joue un rôle essentiel en veillant à ce que tous les services soient exécutés avec qualité, efficacité et sécurité. Ce rôle sert de pont entre le client et l'équipe technique nationale, travaillant en étroite collaboration avec le directeur des opérations, le backoffice des opérations et le coordonnateur de l'atelier. Le superviseur est responsable de la gestion de bout en bout de toutes les activités sur le terrain (entretien, incidents, pannes, mise en service et supervision). Principales responsabilités
• Coordination de l'équipe technique: Assigner des tâches quotidiennes aux techniciens de terrain en fonction des priorités et de la charge de travail, en assurant une exécution efficace.
• Contrôle du matériel et des ressources : S'assurer que les techniciens disposent des outils, du matériel et de la documentation nécessaires pour accomplir les tâches rapidement et efficacement.
• Suivi des ordres de travail: Suivi des ordres de travail, validation de la fermeture technique et garantie que toutes les informations requises sont incluses (photos, rapports, lectures, etc.).
• Communication directe avec le client: Planifiez et coordonnez les activités sur le terrain avec le client, en veillant à ce que le travail puisse être effectué en toute sécurité et dans les délais convenus.
• Planification et suivi des contrats d'entretien : Vérifier que tous les documents connexes sont à jour et que les activités d'entretien sont menées conformément aux exigences contractuelles.
• Amélioration continue : Proposer des améliorations opérationnelles et procédurales basées sur la réalité sur le terrain, et analyser les causes des retravaillés et des incidents récurrents. Ce dont vous avez besoin pour réussir Expérience et contexte technique
• Expérience éprouvée en matière de supervision ou de coordination des services sur le terrain dans un environnement industriel (p. ex. construction civile, installations hydrauliques, entretien industriel).
• De solides connaissances techniques et des compétences diagnostiques, avec la capacité de soutenir et de guider les techniciens de terrain.
• Expérience de travail avec les outils de gestion des services sur le terrain, les ordres de travail et les rapports techniques.
• Exposition directe aux environnements clients sur place, gestion des incidents, des pannes et des activités de maintenance. Compétences
• Capacité de travailler de manière autonome tout en coordonnant et en priorisant les activités d'une équipe de terrain distribuée.
• Une communication forte et une mentalité axée sur le client, avec une expérience éprouvée traitant directement avec les clients sur place.
• Approche structurée et proactive, capable de gérer simultanément plusieurs tâches et priorités.
• L'état d'esprit de résolution de problèmes et l'orientation de l'amélioration continue. Langues et mobilité
• Niveau élevé d'anglais (capacité de communiquer efficacement avec les intervenants internes et les clients).
• Disponibilité pour voyager à travers Iberia comme l'exigent les activités sur le terrain. Ce que nous vous offrons
• Un contrat permanent.
• Un salaire compétitif ainsi que la participation au système de rémunération variable fondé sur des objectifs personnels et financiers.
• Billets de restaurant

jobs.title: Field Service Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Field Service Manager to oversee the installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment across multiple client sites. The ideal candidate will possess solid technical expertise and strong leadership abilities, managing a team of field technicians, optimizing service processes, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. This position requires frequent site visits, coordination with engineering and operations teams, and the ability to address complex technical and operational challenges efficiently.
Key Responsibilities

• Oversee profit and loss (P&L) responsibilities for the EMS field service operations, including budget management, cost control, and financial reporting.

• Collaborate with engineering, project management, and sales teams to support client projects and technical proposals.

• Serve as the primary technical escalation point for complex field service issues

• Lead, mentor, and manage a team of field service technicians specializing in electrical and mechanical equipment.

• Plan, assign, and optimize work orders, routes, and schedules to maximize efficiency and meet service deadlines.

• Coordinate installation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of electrical and mechanical systems.

• Ensure compliance with safety regulations, company policies, and industry standards (OSHA, NEC, NFPA, etc.).

• Maintain accurate records of service activities, parts usage, and site documentation.

• Analyze performance metrics, including first-time fix rates, system uptime, and response times, and implement process improvements.

• Develop and maintain strong client relationships to ensure service satisfaction and promote additional service opportunities.

• Conduct site audits, field inspections, and on-the-job training for technicians.

• Develop and manage operational budgets, review cost efficiency, and ensure profitability of service operations.

Required Qualifications & Skills

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical field preferred. Equivalent experience in field services may be considered.

• Minimum of 5 to 7 years experience in field service management or equivalent technical supervision role supporting electrical and/or mechanical equipment.

• Strong technical knowledge of electrical systems, mechanical systems, PLCs, motor controls, power distribution, and industrial equipment.

• Proven experience in team leadership, performance management, and personnel development.

• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills under pressure.

• Proficient in field service management software, CRM systems, and route optimization tools .

• Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to interact effectively with clients, team members, and management.

• Valid driver’s license with willingness to travel extensively to client sites.

• Familiarity with industry certifications (NICET, CET, Journeyman/Master Electrician, PMP / CSM certification a plus).

• Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage operations across multiple sites.

Preferred Skills

• Experience in project management , equipment commissioning, and technical training.

• Knowledge of regulatory compliance for industrial electrical and mechanical systems.

• Esperienza dimostrata nella leadership del team, nella gestione delle prestazioni e nello sviluppo del personale.

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Wir suchen einen erfahrenen und hochmotivierten Field Service Manager, der die Installation, Wartung und Reparatur von elektrischen und mechanischen Geräten an mehreren Kundenstandorten überwacht. Der ideale Kandidat verfügt über solides technisches Fachwissen und starke Führungsqualitäten, verwaltet ein Team von Außendiensttechnikern, optimiert Serviceprozesse und gewährleistet eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit. Diese Position erfordert häufige Besuche vor Ort, die Koordination mit Ingenieur- und Betriebsteams und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische und operative Herausforderungen effizient zu bewältigen. Hauptzuständigkeiten
• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Verantwortlichkeiten für Gewinn und Verlust (P & L) für die EMS-Außendienstoperationen, einschließlich Budgetmanagement, Kostenkontrolle und Finanzberichterstattung.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Engineering, Projektmanagement und Vertriebsteams zusammen, um Kundenprojekte und technische Vorschläge zu unterstützen.
• Als primärer technischer Eskalationspunkt für komplexe Außendienstfragen dienen
• Führen, beraten und verwalten Sie ein Team von Außendiensttechnikern, die sich auf elektrische und mechanische Geräte spezialisiert haben.
• Planen, zuweisen und optimieren Sie Arbeitsaufträge, Routen und Zeitpläne, um die Effizienz zu maximieren und die Servicetermine einzuhalten.
• Koordinieren Sie die Installation, vorbeugende Wartung, Fehlerbehebung und Reparatur von elektrischen und mechanischen Systemen.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften, Unternehmensrichtlinien und Industriestandards (OSHA, NEC, NFPA usw.).
• Führen Sie genaue Aufzeichnungen über Serviceaktivitäten, Teileverbrauch und Standortdokumentation.
• Analysieren Sie Leistungsmetriken, einschließlich Erstkorrekturraten, Systemuptime und Reaktionszeiten, und implementieren Sie Prozessverbesserungen.
• Aufbau und Pflege starker Kundenbeziehungen, um die Servicezufriedenheit zu gewährleisten und zusätzliche Servicemöglichkeiten zu fördern.
• Durchführung von Audits vor Ort, Feldinspektionen und Schulungen am Arbeitsplatz für Techniker.
• Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Betriebsbudgets, Überprüfung der Kosteneffizienz und Gewährleistung der Rentabilität des Servicebetriebs. Erforderliche Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Industrial Engineering oder verwandten technischen Bereich bevorzugt. Gleichwertige Erfahrungen im Bereich der Außendienste können berücksichtigt werden.
• Mindestens 5 bis 7 Jahre Erfahrung im Außendienstmanagement oder einer gleichwertigen technischen Aufsichtsfunktion zur Unterstützung elektrischer und/oder mechanischer Geräte.
• Starkes technisches Wissen über elektrische Systeme, mechanische Systeme, SPS, Motorsteuerungen, Stromverteilung und Industrieanlagen.
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Teamführung, Performance Management und Personalentwicklung.
• Hervorragende Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten unter Druck.
• Proficient in Field Service Management Software, CRM-Systeme und Routenoptimierung Tools.
• Starke verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten; Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Kunden, Teammitgliedern und Management zu interagieren.
• Gültiger Führerschein mit der Bereitschaft, ausgiebig zu Kundenstandorten zu reisen.
• Vertrautheit mit Branchenzertifizierungen (NICET, CET, Journeyman/Master Electrician, PMP/CSM-Zertifizierung ein Plus).
• Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten, Aufgaben zu priorisieren und Operationen an mehreren Standorten zu verwalten. Bevorzugte Fähigkeiten
• Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, der Inbetriebnahme von Geräten und der technischen Ausbildung.
• Kenntnis der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften für industrielle elektrische und mechanische Systeme.
• Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Budgets, Service-KPIs und operativen Performance-Analysen.
• Praktische Erfahrung mit prädiktiven Wartungstechnologien, IoT-fähig

• Baccalauréat en génie électrique, génie mécanique, génie industriel ou domaine technique connexe préféré. Une expérience équivalente en matière de services sur le terrain peut être envisagée.
• Au moins 5 à 7 ans d'expérience dans la gestion des services sur le terrain ou un rôle équivalent de supervision technique pour l'équipement électrique et/ou mécanique.
• Forte connaissance technique des systèmes électriques, des systèmes mécaniques, des PLC, des commandes de moteurs, de la distribution d'électricité et des équipements industriels.
• Expérience éprouvée en leadership d'équipe, gestion du rendement et perfectionnement du personnel.
• Excellente capacité de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décisions sous pression.
• Compétence en logiciels de gestion des services sur le terrain, systèmes CRM et outils d'optimisation des itinéraires.
• Fortes compétences en communication verbale et écrite; capacité d'interagir efficacement avec les clients, les membres de l'équipe et la direction.
• Permis de conduire valide avec la volonté de voyager largement sur les sites clients.
• Connaissance des certifications de l'industrie (NICET, CET, Journeyman/Master Electrician, PMP / CSM certification a plus).
• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante, de prioriser les tâches et de gérer les opérations sur plusieurs sites. Compétences privilégiées
• Expérience en gestion de projet, mise en service d'équipement et formation technique.
• Connaissance de la conformité réglementaire des systèmes électriques et mécaniques industriels.
• Expérience de la gestion des budgets, des ICR de service et de l'analyse du rendement opérationnel.

jobs.title: Lean/Industrial Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Lean/Industrial Manufacturing Engineer to lead process optimization, waste reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires expertise in Lean Manufacturing principles, Industrial Engineering methods, and operational analytics to drive measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, and throughput across our service offerings.

The ideal candidate will possess strong technical skills, a strategic mindset, and the ability to collaborate across teams to implement solutions that support our business objectives.
Key Responsibilities

• Analyze current manufacturing processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas for improvement.

• Apply Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen, 5S, Value Stream Mapping , and other methodologies to enhance operational performance.

• Design, implement, and optimize production workflows, material flows, and plant layouts to minimize waste and reduce lead times.

• Utilize data-driven approaches for capacity analysis, root cause problem-solving, and performance measurement .

• Facilitate continuous improvement initiatives, Kaizen events, and cross-functional workshops.

• Develop and maintain standard work documentation, operating procedures, and training materials .

• Monitor KPIs and provide actionable reports to management with recommendations for improvement.

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, quality assurance, supply chain, and maintenance teams.

• Conduct ergonomic and safety analysis to reduce risks and optimize human-centered processes.

• Support new product launches by designing process flows, labor standards, and material handling layouts.

• Participate in cost evaluation, ROI analysis, and capital project justification for process and productivity improvements.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering , or related field.

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in manufacturing or industrial engineering , with hands-on experience in Lean Manufacturing and process improvement initiatives.

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification preferred.

• Proficiency in industrial engineering tools such as AutoCAD similar software .

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills .

• Ability to train, mentor, and lead cross-functional teams.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Knowledge of manufacturing systems, quality standards, safety protocols, and continuous improvement metrics .

• Experience with ERP systems, Microsoft Office Suite, and statistical analysis tools.

• Knowledge of material planning and warehouse layout optimization.

• Strong leadership capability with a track record of successful Lean initiative deployment.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
