La nostra struttura Leeds è uno dei centri di produzione di pompe di punta di Sulzer, che combina decenni di esperienza ingegneristica con la moderna tecnologia di produzione a seguito di significativi investimenti e ristrutturazione. Siamo alla ricerca di un'esperta struttura di produzione di Leeds, dove potrai svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire che ogni pacchetto di pompe lasci il nostro sito rispettando i più elevati standard di qualità, sicurezza e soddisfazione del cliente. Questo non è un tipico ruolo di ispezione. Potrai lavorare insieme a team che progettano, producono, assemblano e testano alcune delle più grandi e più tecnicamente avanzate pompe del settore. Alcuni dei nostri prodotti pesano fino a 150 tonnellate, richiedendo un coordinamento eccezionale, precisione e eccellenza ingegneristica per portarli dal concetto alla consegna del cliente. descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we don't just manufacture pumps—we engineer and build critical equipment that keeps vital industries moving across the globe. From power generation and water infrastructure to energy, chemicals and industrial processing, our pumps are trusted in some of the world's most demanding applications. Our Leeds facility is one of Sulzer's flagship pump manufacturing centres, combining decades of engineering expertise with modern manufacturing technology following significant investment and refurbishment.

We're looking for an experienced Final Inspection Lead to join our recently refurbished, state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Leeds, where you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring every pump package leaves our site meeting the highest standards of quality, safety and customer satisfaction. This is not a typical inspection role. You'll be working alongside teams who design, manufacture, assemble and test some of the largest and most technically advanced pumps in the industry. Some of our products weigh up to 150 tonnes, requiring exceptional coordination, precision and engineering excellence to take them from concept to customer delivery. What You'll Be Doing

• Leading final inspection activities for complete pump packages and rotating equipment.

• Coordinating the final assembly verification process before customer dispatch.

• Reviewing and approving final manufacturing records and quality documentation.

• Ensuring products comply with ISO 9001 standards and internal quality requirements.

• Verifying that all customer specifications, technical requirements and contractual obligations have been fulfilled.

• Overseeing and signing off complete pump packages and bareshaft assemblies.

• Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Project Management and Quality teams to resolve issues and ensure on-time delivery.

• Supporting customer inspections and witness activities where required.

• Driving a culture of quality, accountability and continuous improvement across the operation.

What We're Looking For

• Experience within heavy engineering, rotating equipment, pumps, turbines, motors or similar manufacturing environments.

• Strong understanding of final inspection, quality assurance and documentation control processes.

• Knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications and manufacturing documentation.

• Experience coordinating inspections involving large, complex engineered products.

• Excellent communication and organisational skills.

• A proactive approach with the confidence to make critical quality decisions.

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company wide bonus scheme

• 33 days’ holiday

• You will be eligible to join the Company’s Medicash health cash plan, which allows you to claim back the cost of everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services.

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Community & Wellbeing

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Sub

jobs.title: Business Development Director
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The jobholder will work closely with Regional Head of Sales, Segment heads, and their own team to drive Strategic and Tactical initiatives (GDP), manage the marketing team, ensure integration and utilization of business optimization tools, and generally support the sales management team. The position will ensure GDP initiatives are organized and executed monthly and facilitate the data collection of the required TTI’s. Regional marketing will prioritize activities that are in alignment with these initiatives.

Business excellence processes and tools (Salesforce, CPQ, etc.) will be supported by driving adoption and execution of the tools monitoring utilization and escalating any roadblocks or lack of adoption issues as well as overseeing new product order entry management. A background in LEAN/VBSS or similar is considered beneficial to identify opportunities to simplify business processes especially from an internal efficiency and/or customer perspective. Targeted location: Within traveling distance of Easley, SC

Main accountabilities and tasks

• Organize and support the GDP initiatives

• Partner with the segment heads to develop, track, and report on the various action plans

• Work with business analyst personnel to automate the collection of TTI data

• Collect and communicate performance data, market insights, and opportunities to assist sales teams and services (collect KPI’s, structure data, visual management, etc.)

• Coordinate Regional marketing managers’ activities

• Combine marketing promotion, analytics, and GDP/initiatives together to coordinate and focus resources

• Oversee management of marketing communication and Marketing Initiatives

• Support channel partners development programs

• Support sales leadership to create and manage the communication flow on the main social internal and external

• Focus on execution and waste removal in business processes, primarily in Sales and Service activities Drive Sales Support department providing data intelligence to sales leaders to facilitate businesses.

• Organize and oversee data mining, accessibility to data in various systems (ERPs)

• Management level dashboard creation and maintenance

• Support Business Intelligence data collection and Analysis.

• Coordinate with other functions that SalesForce CRM, CPQ, SAPConf and other main systems are developed according to business requirements.

• Liaise with Finance and with Strategy (Budgeting Process, by Segment, by Region, by Product)

• Regular Pipeline Review and CRM maintenance

• Trainer for SalesForce

• Rolling Forecast management, both for OI (Order Intake) and Sales

• Partner with sales leaders and corporate business development personnel to track timely execution of key tasks

• Assist with preparation for corporate presentations and reports

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long-Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Il titolare del lavoro lavorerà a stretto contatto con Regional Head of Sales, Segment Head e il proprio team per guidare iniziative strategiche e tattiche (PIL), gestire il team di marketing, garantire l'integrazione e l'utilizzo di strumenti di ottimizzazione aziendale, e generalmente sostenere il team di gestione delle vendite. La posizione assicurerà che le iniziative del PIL siano organizzate e eseguite mensilmente e facilitino la raccolta dei dati del TTI richiesto. Il marketing regionale darà priorità alle attività che sono in linea con queste iniziative. I processi e gli strumenti di eccellenza aziendale (Salesforce, CPQ, ecc.) saranno supportati dalla guida dell'adozione e dell'esecuzione degli strumenti di monitoraggio dell'utilizzo e dall'escalation di eventuali blocchi stradali o problemi di adozione, nonché dalla supervisione della nuova gestione dell'ordine di prodotto. Uno sfondo in LEAN/VBSS o simile è considerato vantaggioso per identificare le opportunità di semplificare i processi aziendali soprattutto da un'efficienza interna e/o dalla prospettiva del cliente. Posizione mirata: A distanza di viaggio di Easley, SC Principali responsabilità e compiti
• Organizzare e sostenere le iniziative del PIL
• Partner con le teste del segmento per sviluppare, tracciare e segnalare i vari piani di azione
• Lavorare con il personale degli analisti aziendali per automatizzare la raccolta dei dati TTI
• Raccogliere e comunicare i dati delle prestazioni, le intuizioni di mercato e le opportunità per assistere i team di vendita e servizi (collegare i dati di KPI, struttura, gestione visiva, ecc.)
• Coordinare le attività dei responsabili del marketing regionale
• Combinare la promozione del marketing, l'analisi e il PIL/iniziativa insieme per coordinare e concentrare le risorse
• Superare la gestione della comunicazione di marketing e iniziative di marketing
• Supporta programmi di sviluppo dei partner
• Sostenere la leadership di vendita per creare e gestire il flusso di comunicazione sul principale interno sociale ed esterno
• Concentrati sull'esecuzione e sulla rimozione dei rifiuti nei processi aziendali, principalmente nelle attività di Vendite e Servizi, Drive Sales Support dipartimento che fornisce informazioni ai leader di vendita per facilitare le aziende.
• Organizzare e supervisionare l'estrazione dati, l'accessibilità ai dati in vari sistemi (ERP)
• Creazione e manutenzione del cruscotto di livello di gestione
• Supporta la raccolta e l'analisi dei dati di Business Intelligence.
• Coordinare con altre funzioni che SalesForce CRM, CPQ, SAPConf e altri sistemi principali sono sviluppati in base alle esigenze aziendali.
• Liaise with Finance e with Strategy (Processo di costruzione, per segmento, per Regione, per prodotto)
• Regolare revisione della Pipeline e manutenzione CRM
• Trainer per SalesForce
• Gestione delle previsioni, sia per OI (Order Intake) che per Vendite
• Partner con i leader di vendita e il personale di sviluppo aziendale per monitorare l'esecuzione tempestiva dei compiti chiave
• Assistere con preparazione per presentazioni e report aziendali Cosa ti offriamo
• Tempo a pagamento competitivo
• 12 Azienda Pagamenti all'anno
• Programma bonus annuale
• Vantaggi medici, dentali e di visione completi
• Società pagata a breve termine e disabilità a lungo termine, Azienda pagato vita assicurazione
• 6% 401K o Roth Company Match con gilet immediato
• Contributi di sicurezza a carico della società a seguito di 1 anno di occupazione
• Rimborso/Assistenza educativa
• Rimborso trimestrale Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

jobs.title: National Sales Manager PPI
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

This role leads and develops Direct and Regional Sales Managers, implements sales strategies, and supports the Pulp and Paper market. This position has direct accountability for all PPI sales activities, both direct and indirect, in the USA. This role will necessitate effective collaboration and coordination with operations, procurement, quality, and other relevant departments. Essential Functions:

• Achieve sales growth targets by developing and executing annual sales plans.

• Lead the RSM’s, monitor individual performance against goals, and provide coaching, mentoring, and training.

• Responsible for ownership and personal management of the direct corporate accounts. Develops trust and solid partnerships with Corporate and OEM accounts. Negotiates and manages agreements with both.

• Engages collaboratively with technical associations and partners with leading technical universities.

• Analyze and identify market trends, and the competition to jointly develop strategic plans for expanding sales of new and existing products.

• Travel, as necessary within the assigned territory.

Other Duties:

• Must possess superior presentation, communication, and negotiation skills.

• Experience with multiple direct reports and a proven history of leading teams.

• Superior analytical, strategic thinking, leadership skills.

• Demonstrated success through focus, good judgment, and decision-making.

• Keen sense of teamwork and business goal alignment.

• Well-developed sense of urgency to deliver results.

• Excellent relationship and people skills.

Supervisory Duties:

• Network of Regional Sales Managers and Application Specialists covering the PPI market.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a similar technical degree preferred. MBA is a plus.

• At least 10-15 years’ regional sales experience.

• At least 5 years people management experience.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sr. (Field) Service Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Sr. (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks. This would involve all type of hydraulic, mechanical, vibration and system problems. A pump field expert with knowledge in pumps, prime movers and auxiliary systems to improve customer MTBR, reduce customer costs and assist with RCFA. Key Responsibilities

• Visit customer sites, consult, and investigate all aspects of technical design including troubleshooting, problem solving, and customer system analysis, and give recommendations. Examples may include: site performance testing existing pump, comparing original OEM (Sulzer or non Sulzer) pump performance to current performance; site vibration testing and providing recommendations to solve identified problems; RCFA analysis of any problems (pumps, seals, couplings, system to help Sulzer customers).

• Write detailed and professional reports based on data obtained from customer site visits that will allow customer and Sulzer Service Center to diagnose, fix, test and solve difficult technical issues to customer/Sulzer satisfaction. Issues could include vibration, pump performance (hydraulic and mechanical), system issues, materials, corrosion/erosion etc. Write detailed and thorough technical report and carry out Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA)

• When not at site or doing site reports, supports AME SC’s with Field Engineering Assistance Requests (FEAR’s) with technical issues as mentioned above.

• Ensures current applicable disciplines are used in all Field Engineering activities (mechanical, hydraulic, metallurgy, instrumentation & control).

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Ten years’ experience in pump, systems interface, and hydraulic applications preferred

• High vibration and pump expertise required

• Excellent communication (both verbal and written) and interpersonal skills

• Very organized with ability to prioritize

• Ability to work under pressure

• Ability to travel to site at a moment’s notice

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Job Summary

The Sr. Strategic Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with key clients across multiple lines of business. This role involves developing long-term account strategies, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring high levels of client satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Regional Sales Manager – Metals & Mining

Position Summary
The Regional Sales Manager is accountable for shaping and executing Sulzer Pumps’ channel strategy for the Metals & Mining market across North America. This role provides commercial leadership to drive profitable growth, deepen engagement with end users, EPCs, and channel partners, expand Sulzer’s installed base, and accelerate aftermarket revenue across the region.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Growth Leadership: Lead regional growth initiatives by developing and executing a Metals & Mining strategy aligned with Sulzer Pumps’ commercial priorities and long-term objectives.
Channel Strategy & Performance: Establish, develop, and oversee channel partners to ensure market coverage, commercial effectiveness, and alignment with Sulzer’s go-to-market strategy.
Installed Base & Aftermarket Expansion: Advance new equipment sales to strengthen the installed base while driving sustainable aftermarket growth in parts, service, repairs, and upgrades.
Executive Customer Engagement: Build and strengthen strategic relationships with mining operators, processing facilities, and engineering firms to identify project opportunities and long-term account potential.
Technical & Commercial Value Selling: Provide consultative support that positions Sulzer solutions around reliability, lifecycle performance, and total cost of ownership.
Market Presence & Pipeline Development: Maintain a strong field presence through customer visits
and joint engagement with channel partners to expand pipeline and convert priority opportunities.
Capability Building: Strengthen partner and customer effectiveness through targeted product, application, and market training that reinforces Sulzer’s competitive position.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with engineering, service, and operations teams to ensure disciplined execution, high customer satisfaction, and successful commercial outcomes.

Critical Success Factors
Deep understanding of pump applications within mining, mineral processing, and metals operations.
Demonstrated ability to deliver growth through both direct and channel-led commercial models.
Strong capability in strategic account development, executive relationship management, and opportunity capture.
Excellent communication, leadership, and execution skills, with the ability to influence across internal and external stakeholders.

Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline preferred.
5–10 years of progressive experience in pump or rotating equipment sales within the Metals & Mining sector.
Demonstrated record of delivering profitable growth, leading channel partner performance, and applying the technical and commercial judgment required to support engineered pump

Travel Requirement
Travel up to 75% across the assigned territory is expected to support customer engagement, channel development, and business growth objectives

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K

jobs.title: Workplace AI Architect
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Define and govern the adoption of AI across Workplace and platform-based solutions, with a strong focus on out-of-the-box capabilities, integrations, and security. Act as the orchestration point across Software Development, Data & Analytics, business users, and platform owners, ensuring consistent routing of AI initiatives. Drive the transition from ad-hoc usage to controlled, scalable adoption through clear governance, measurement, and chargeback, positioning AI as an extension of existing platforms rather than a parallel capability. The role focuses on Workplace AI platforms and embedded capabilities such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI assistants, and collaboration tools.

Main accountabilities and tasks

• AI Roadmap & Out-of-the-Box Ownership: Own the AI roadmap for Workplace and platform-based AI capabilities and the adoption of out-of-the-box solutions; contribute to the cross-functional definition of AI architecture; establish AI as a coherent enterprise capability.

• Platform-First, Preview & Early-Access Ownership: Prioritise out-of-the-box capabilities over new builds; own the evaluation, piloting, and rollout of preview features and vendor early-access programmes; track and govern AI features increasingly embedded in existing enterprise services.

• Governance of Services, Integrations & Agents: Establish a single enterprise entry point and a risk-based approval process, supported by self-service guardrails and clear approval timelines so the front door enables rather than blocks; govern AI services, integrations, APIs, and the lifecycle of AI agents; ensure every AI asset is inventoried, owned, and operated within agreed controls.

• Routing of AI Initiatives Across Delivery Tracks: Define and govern how AI initiatives are routed across delivery tracks - out-of-the-box, preview, and early-access (this role); citizen development (business users, against standards set by this role); custom development and advanced integrations (Software Development); and analytics-driven solutions (Data & Analytics).

• Security, Risk & Compliance (with Infosec): Together with Infosec, define and enforce AI-specific controls under a clear split of accountability for who defines, approves, and enforces; ensure compliance with GDPR and the EU AI Act; govern third-party AI usage and minimise shadow-AI risk.

• AI Lifecycle Management: Govern the full lifecycle covering build, publish, operate, and retire; ensure ownership, inventory, and transparency for every AI solution; enforce environment-based controls across experiment, managed, and production.

• Business Value, Chargeback & Adoption: Define how AI business value is measured; build and operate a chargeback model so consumption is transparent and costs sit with the consuming business; drive adoption and track it against value realisation.

• User Support, Enablement & Training: Act as the primary point of contact for AI adoption; provide patterns, guardrails, and reusable templates so users can build safely; deliver training, documentation, and onboarding paths that build AI literacy across the organisation.

Desired experience and qualifications

• Work experience: 8-10+ years in enterprise IT, architecture, or transformation roles, with experience in governance, platform strategy, or large-scale adoption.

• Expertise: Senior expert / enterprise architect level. Strong understanding of enterprise AI platforms (e.g. Microsoft 365 Copilot) and assistant and agent-based tooling, and of GenAI / agent-based architectures; deep knowledge of platform vs. custom-development trade-offs and licensing models; experience defining operating models and governance standards.

• Governance & regulation: Proven experience defining and rolling out enterprise AI governance

• Unterstützung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen Sales, Service Centern und weiteren internen Schnittstellen

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Office, insbesondere Excel, PowerPoint und Outlook

• Erfahrung mit Salesforce oder einem vergleichbaren CRM‑System

• Kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Bachelorabschluss in einem wirtschaftsnahen bzw. administrativen Bereich

• Sehr gute Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Strukturierte, eigenständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise mit hoher Organisations‑ und Priorisierungsfähigkeit

jobs.title: Service & Installationstekniker
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Service & Installationstekniker till Sulzer Pumps Sweden AB
Vi söker service och installations tekniker till Sulzers växande servicecenter i Veddesta och Malmö. Gillar du att arbeta i en varierande vardag med både arbete i verkstadsmiljö och ute hos kund? Då kan detta vara tjänsten för dig!

Om företaget

Sulzer är ett världsledande företag inom utveckling, tillverkning och service av pumpar, omrörare, luftarutrustning och blåsmaskiner. Våra kunder arbetar inom områden som olja, gas, vattenrening, gruvdrift och pappersindustri. Vi tillhandahåller en utmanande och givande arbetsmiljö där mångfald är värderad som nyckelfaktorn till framgång.

Huvudkontoret ligger i Vadstena och vi har kontor i Malmö, Göteborg, Norrköping och Stockholm. Våra servicecenter finner du i Vadstena, Göteborg,Veddesta,Årsta, Karlstad, Piteå och Arlöv. Läs gärna mer om oss på www.sulzer.com

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Sulzers servicecenter har framför allt kunder verksamma inom vatten- och avloppshantering. Din roll kommer i huvudsak bestå av montage, reparation och service av pumpar och pumpstationer. Arbetet utförs antingen i våra serviceverkstäder i Veddesta, Malmö eller direkt ute hos våra kunder, för att felsöka och åtgärda problem på plats. Som installations tekniker kommer du att jobba med ombyggnationer och nybyggnationer av pumpstationer, etc. Resor med övernattning kan förekomma samt även beredskap.

Administrativa uppgifter som ingår i tjänsten är bland annat handläggning av ordrar, skriva servicerapporter samt hantering av in- och ut leveranser.

Du blir en del av våra team som präglas av god stämning och sammanhållning. Vi ser fram emot att välkomna ytterligare en kollega.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som gillar att skruva, meka och lösa tekniska problem. Vi tror att du har läst ett tekniskt program på gymnasiet eller vidareutbildat dig inom området. Alternativt att du har erfarenhet av praktiskt verkstads- och fältarbete. Har du erfarenhete av svets arbeten och elinstallationer är det bra oxå. Du innehar körkortsbehörighet B och har ett genuint intresse för mekanik och teknik.

Det är meriterande om du har:

• Branschvana

• Erfarenhet av SAP eller liknande affärssystem

• Truckkort

• Certifikat i heta arbeten

• Kunskaper inom el samt styr- och reglerteknik

Som person ser vi att du är engagerad och driven. Du är praktiskt lagd och tycker det är roligt att hitta tekniska lösningar. För dig är det enkelt att prata med både kollegor och kunder samtidigt som du jobbar strukturerat.

På Sulzer finns goda möjligheter till att utvecklas och växa i rollen så tveka inte - det kan vara här som din resa startar!

Ansökningsförfarande

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på 100%, provanställning tillämpas. Vi tillämpar löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. Missa inte chansen och ansök redan idag!

What we offer you

• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)

• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning

• Gratis kaffe och frukt

• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Pumps Sweden AB söker rentaltekniker! Vi söker nu flera engagerad och lösningsorienterad Rentaltekniker till vårt team i Stockholm, Malmö och Göteborg – är det du?

Vi på Sulzer växer och satsar på framtiden, därför söker vi en eller flera engagerade och drivna Rentaltekniker med specialintresse för VA. Vill du arbeta i en varierad roll med Fältservice, Verkstadsreparationer, lagerarbete och teknisk problemlösning? Då kan det här vara jobbet för dig!

I denna rekrytering lägger vi störst vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Vad innebär rollen?

Som Rentaltekniker hos oss kommer du att utföra:

• Service, underhåll och reparation av pumpar och annan processutrustning.

• Felsökning och analys av utrustning både på verkstad och ute hos kund.

• Installation och driftsättning av nya system och produkter.

• Ansvarig för lagret och in och uttransporter.

• Dokumentation och rapportering av utförda arbeten.

• Bidra med tekniskt stöd och rådgivning till våra kunder.

• Bidra & utveckla vårt arbete med hållbara och effektiva VA-lösningar

• Beredskap kan ingå i tjänsten.

Meriterande erfarenheter & kunskaper:

• Har teknisk utbildning inom exempelvis mekanik, el, automation eller motsvarande.

• Har erfarenhet som servicetekniker eller från arbete med liknande maskinutrustning.

• Är serviceinriktad, noggrann och självgående.

• Det är meriterande om du har en elutbildning eller grundläggande elkunskaper.

• Har grundläggande datavana

Personliga egenskaper:

• Driven, strukturerad och gillar ordning & reda

• Gillar att arbeta under eget ansvar

• Vill bidra till gruppens & bolagets utveckling

• Är praktiskt & serviceinriktad lagd

• Gillar problemlösning

• Trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i team

Krav:

• B-körkort

• Truckkort

• Har grundläggande kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Vi erbjuder:

• En spännande och varierad tjänst i ett globalt företag med stark lokal närvaro

• En arbetsplats med framåtanda och fokus på tillväxt & utveckling

• Ett fritt och omväxlande arbete med stor möjlighet att påverka din vardag

• Kompetenta kollegor och en arbetsplats med stark sammanhållning

• Goda möjligheter till utbildning och personlig utveckling

• Kollektivavtal och bra villkor

What we offer you

• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)

• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning

• Gratis kaffe och frukt

• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Stellenbeschreibung Der Sales Engineering Specialist unterstützt den Verkaufsprozess, indem er technisches Fachwissen zur Verfügung stellt und den Kunden hilft zu verstehen, wie Produkte ihre Bedürfnisse erfüllen. Diese Rolle schließt die Lücke zwischen Engineering und Vertrieb und gewährleistet technische Genauigkeit und Kundenzufriedenheit. Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an Fachleute, die fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse eines Stellenbereichs anwenden. Erforderlich, um Projekte / Prozesse unabhängig mit begrenzter Aufsicht zu verwalten. Sulzer Pumps (Canada) Inc. - Flow Equipment, ist eine Division von Sulzer Ltd, und ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen in der Entwicklung und Lieferung von Pumpenlösungen und verwandten Geräten für seine Schlüsselmärkte Öl und Gas, Strom, allgemeine Industrien (Bergbau, Metalle, Lebensmittel, CPI & Düngemittel) und Wasser. • Idealerweise einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften oder fünf (5) plus jahrelange Erfahrung in Pumpen und Hydraulik.
• Relevante Erfahrung und fundierte Kenntnisse im Marketing und Verkauf von industriebezogenen Geräten (Pumpen, Motoren usw.)
• Erfahrung in der Zellstoff- & Papier- und Metallindustrie wäre ideal.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Le spécialiste en génie commercial soutient le processus de vente en fournissant une expertise technique et en aidant les clients à comprendre comment les produits répondent à leurs besoins. Ce rôle comble l'écart entre l'ingénierie et les ventes, assurant la précision technique et la satisfaction des clients. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels qui appliquent des connaissances avancées dans un domaine d'emploi. Requis pour gérer les projets/processus indépendamment avec une supervision limitée. Sulzer Pumps (Canada) Inc. - Flow Equipment, est une division de Sulzer Ltd. et est un chef de file mondial dans le développement et la fourniture de solutions de pompage et d'équipement connexe à ses principaux marchés du pétrole et du gaz, de l'électricité, des industries générales (mines, métaux, aliments, IPC et engrais) et de l'eau. Nous offrons un milieu de travail stimulant et enrichissant où la diversité est considérée comme un facteur clé de réussite. Aperçu de l'emploi : Sous l'autorité du directeur national des ventes, du directeur de compte de l'Ouest canadien, il fait la promotion des ventes et des services (pièces et réparations) des produits de l'unité d'affaires Sulzer Pumps / Water & Industrial Business Unit (pompes, mélangeurs, agitateurs, compresseurs, etc.) et des accessoires destinés aux clients établis et nouveaux dans la zone de responsabilité du gestionnaire de compte. En fournissant des propositions techniques et commerciales en réponse à des demandes de renseignements et en interférant entre les clients et les installations de l'entreprise, notre candidat retenu travaillera principalement indépendamment avec des conseils occasionnels du directeur national des ventes PPI. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable :
• Vente de pompes Sulzer Produits et services de l'industrie (pièces et réparations) à des clients établis.
• Sourcing et développement de nouveaux clients, croissance des activités futures tout en protégeant la base existante; développement de la croissance dans de nouveaux domaines au sein de la base de clients existante.
• Négocier des commandes comprenant tous les détails techniques, commerciaux et juridiques à la satisfaction mutuelle des clients et de la Société.
• Faire appel à des clients potentiels; maintenir des contrats avec des clients en fonction de leurs besoins.
• Sécuriser et renouveler les commandes; organiser les dates de livraison et autres périphériques faisant partie intégrante de la vente.
• Voyagez à l'emplacement du client pour assurer un contact direct et régulier.
• Réunions des clients pendant et en dehors des heures normales d'ouverture sur une base régulière conformément aux budgets des dépenses et aux bonnes pratiques d'affaires. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez :
• Idéalement un baccalauréat en génie, ou cinq (5) plus l'expérience liée aux pompes et l'hydraulique.
• Expérience pertinente et solide connaissance de la commercialisation et de la vente d'équipements industriels (pompes, moteurs, etc.)
• L'expérience des industries des pâtes et papiers et des métaux serait idéale.
• Excellentes compétences écrites, verbales, de négociation et interpersonnelles en anglais sans supervision ni supervision
• Capacité de travailler de manière indépendante et efficace avec une supervision directe minimale
• Personnalité sortante

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
This position is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery under close supervision. This entry-level role supports senior mechanics in diagnosing issues, performing basic repairs, and ensuring equipment is safe and operational.

This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration. Helper Mechanic - Night Shift

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
· Primary Functions:
o Have and maintain ability to use and operate forklifts
o Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures
o Be on the job site and in your assigned work area at the scheduled time
o Must be self-motivated and willing to learn
o Handle departments’ recycling and removing of all trash on a daily basis
o Assure all cables, shackles, straps and chains are put away daily
o Keep work area clean and well organized during all phases of the project
o Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, including all Supervisors, Managers, Leadmen
and hourly personnel
o General cleanup of departments change room / restroom facilities
o Provide assistance to Core departments as required
o Must follow the STS dress code and maintain a professional appearance at all times
o Maintain LEAN objections within the department
o Perform specialized task as required
o Maintain accurate time sheets on a daily basis
o Complete company-required training programs

· Secondary Functions/
• Requirements:
o Steam clean and wash parts in the Wash Bay
o Transport equipment and parts around department and between departments
o Use PPE as identified in risk assessments or other related safety documents
o Do not undertake activities that have not been risk assessed, or where an assessment is not available or
understood
o Report any instances of spillage, uncontrolled exposure or other related safety issues to their line manager
o Ensure the correct use of waste segregation facilities and the efficient use of natural resources and raw materials
o Must be able to work overtime when necessary

What we offer you

Paid parental leave
Parental leave
Health insurance
401(k) matching
Paid time off
Vision insurance
Health savings account
Dental insurance
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
401(k) 6% Match
Paid holidays
Wellness program

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Project Buyer with Supply Chain mindset to Nordic Water Products AB

You are a proactive and self-driven purchasing professional with experience from project-driven manufacturing or industrial environments. You combine strong analytical skills with commercial awareness and technical understanding, enabling you to manage complex sourcing activities and support successful project execution.

You have experience in project purchasing, supplier negotiations, and supply chain management, and are comfortable working closely with project managers, engineering, production, and suppliers. You take ownership, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a role with a high degree of independence.

As a person, you are a collaborative team player who builds strong relationships, drives continuous improvement, and delivers results in a dynamic environment.

To succeed in this role, you have:

• Experience in project purchasing within manufacturing or industrial businesses

• Strong negotiation and supplier management skills

• An analytical and structured approach to problem-solving

• Technical understanding and commercial acumen

• Knowledge of industrial manufacturing processes, sheet metal fabrication and stainless-steel products is meritorious

• A proactive mindset, ability to work independently, and strong teamwork skills

• Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining commercial responsibility, technical challenges, and project-driven work in a dynamic international environment.

Place of employment: Helsingborg

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Daniel Bogren, Head of Procurement at Nordic Water on 070-403 25 26 or daniel.bogren@sulzer.com

Sounds interesting? Send your application via the link below. As the selection process will take place on an ongoing basis, we want your application as soon as possible.

What we offer you

• Wellnes Allowance 3000kr/year (E-passi)

• Collea – Free pension and insurance advice

• Free coffee and fruit

• Occupational health services with regular health check-ups

jobs.title: Manufacturing Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Engineering Technician supports engineers in the design, modification, and improvement of products and processes. This includes testing, maintaining, and installing equipment and systems.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. SUMMARY:
The position is responsible for generating and maintaining manufacturing routers and production orders using engineering drawings, BOMs, technical specifications, and quality requirements. Utilizes knowledge of machining and manufacturing processes to establish the most efficient sequence of operations, supporting productivity, quality, cost-effectiveness, and on-time delivery.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Interpret design drawings and Bill of Material (BOM) technical & quality requirements to develop routings for the manufacturing of parts and assemblies tailored to the machining capabilities of the Sulzer Nuclear Service Center.

• Generates production work order packages for the manufacturing of pump replacement parts and assembly of new equipment pumps in accordance with facility capabilities, procedures, and Quality Assurance program requirements.

• Generates service order packages for the disassembly & inspection, and repair of pumps sent to the SNSC for refurbishment.

• Coordinates with Production Planners and Shop Supervisor to ensure that production and service orders are delivered in time to support shipment of assemblies, parts, and pumps to the customer on-time.

• Assists in development of inspection plans, procedures, and forms in accordance with company standards.

SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and Environmental Safety & Health (ESH) Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None

QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering Technology, or equivalent is preferred.

• Knowledge of manufacturing and machine shop processes related to repair of pumps and manufacturing of pump parts is preferred.

• Strong organizational, interpersonal, and analytical skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills; including diplomacy and negotiation skills.

• Strong PC skills, with proficiency in Microsoft software.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
La Engineering Technician supporta gli ingegneri nella progettazione, nella modifica e nel miglioramento dei prodotti e dei processi. Questo include test, manutenzione e installazione di attrezzature e sistemi.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato al personale di supporto entry-level che segue specifiche istruzioni e procedure, con supervisione prevista per situazioni non dirottate. SUMMARY:
La posizione è responsabile della generazione e del mantenimento di router di produzione e ordini di produzione utilizzando disegni di ingegneria, BOM, specifiche tecniche e requisiti di qualità. Utilizza la conoscenza dei processi di lavorazione e produzione per stabilire la sequenza più efficiente delle operazioni, sostenere la produttività, la qualità, l'efficacia dei costi e la consegna in tempo reale.

FUNZIONI ESSENTIALI:

• Disegni di progettazione e requisiti tecnici e di qualità Bill of Material (BOM) per lo sviluppo di routings per la produzione di parti e assemblaggi su misura per le capacità di lavorazione del Sulzer Nuclear Service Center.

• Genera pacchetti di ordine di lavoro di produzione per la produzione di parti di ricambio della pompa e l'assemblaggio di nuove pompe di attrezzature in conformità con le capacità di struttura, procedure e requisiti del programma di assicurazione della qualità.

• Genera pacchetti di ordine di servizio per lo smontaggio e l'ispezione, e riparazione di pompe inviate al SNSC per la ristrutturazione.

• Coordina con i pianificatori di produzione e il supervisore del negozio per garantire che gli ordini di produzione e di servizio siano consegnati in tempo per supportare la spedizione di assiemi, parti e pompe al cliente in tempo reale.

• Assiste nello sviluppo di piani di ispezione, procedure e forme secondo gli standard aziendali.

RISPOSTE SECONDARI:

• Aderisce a politiche, procedure e standard aziendali e dipartimentali

• Supporta, collabora e partecipa al sistema di gestione LEAN e Environmental Safety & Health (ESH) di livello aziendale che comprende le seguenti politiche e procedure di sicurezza, salute e ambiente. Supporta e collabora nello sforzo aziendale di Gestione della Qualità.

• Esegui altri compiti come assegnato.

RISPOSTE SUPERVISORIA: Nessuno

QUALIFICA:

• diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente richiesto. Laurea in ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria meccanica, o equivalente è preferito.

• La conoscenza dei processi di fabbricazione e di fabbricazione di macchine per la riparazione di pompe e la produzione di parti della pompa è preferita.

• Forte capacità organizzative, interpersonali e analitiche. Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta; tra cui la diplomazia e le competenze di negoziazione.

• Forte capacità PC, con competenza nel software Microsoft.

Cosa ti offriamo

• 15 giorni di tempo libero e 12 giorni festivi

• 401k piano con una partita del 6%

• Piano sanitario completo tra cui medico, dentale, visione, vita, disabilità a breve e a lungo termine

• Conto di risparmio sanitario corrispondente

• Programma benessere stimolante

• Programma di assistenza dei dipendenti

• congedo paterna pagato

• Rimborso palestra

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Ingenieurtechniker unterstützt Ingenieure bei der Gestaltung, Modifikation und Verbesserung von Produkten und Prozessen. Dies umfasst das Testen, Warten und Installieren von Geräten und Systemen.
Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an einsteigerfähige Mitarbeiter, die bestimmte Anweisungen und Verfahren befolgen, wobei die Aufsicht für nicht routinemäßige Situationen vorgesehen ist. ZUSAMMENFASSUNG:
Die Position ist verantwortlich für die Generierung und Wartung von Fertigungsroutern und Produktionsaufträgen unter Verwendung von technischen Zeichnungen, Stücklisten, technischen Spezifikationen und Qualitätsanforderungen. Nutzt das Wissen über Bearbeitungs- und Fertigungsprozesse, um die effizienteste Abfolge von Operationen zu etablieren und die Produktivität, Qualität, Wirtschaftlichkeit und pünktliche Lieferung zu unterstützen.

• Interpretieren Sie Konstruktionszeichnungen und technische und Qualitätsanforderungen an Stücklisten, um Routings für die Herstellung von Teilen und Baugruppen zu entwickeln, die auf die Bearbeitungsfähigkeiten des Sulzer Nuclear Service Center zugeschnitten sind.

• Generiert Produktionsauftragspakete für die Herstellung von Pumpenersatzteilen und die Montage neuer Ausrüstungspumpen gemäß den Anforderungen der Anlagenfähigkeiten, Verfahren und des Qualitätssicherungsprogramms.

• Generiert Serviceauftragspakete für die Demontage & Inspektion und Reparatur von Pumpen, die zur Sanierung an den SNSC geschickt werden.

• Koordiniert sich mit Produktionsplanern und Shop Supervisor, um sicherzustellen, dass Produktions- und Serviceaufträge rechtzeitig geliefert werden, um den Versand von Baugruppen, Teilen und Pumpen zum Kunden rechtzeitig zu unterstützen.

• Hilft bei der Entwicklung von Inspektionsplänen, Verfahren und Formularen in Übereinstimmung mit den Unternehmensstandards.

ZWEITE ZUSTÄNDIGE VERANTWORTUNGEN:

• Befolgt Unternehmens- und Abteilungsrichtlinien, -verfahren und -standards

• Unterstützt, kooperiert und beteiligt sich am unternehmensweiten LEAN und Environmental Safety & Health (ESH) Management System, das die Einhaltung aller Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltrichtlinien und -verfahren umfasst. Unterstützt und kooperiert im unternehmensweiten Qualitätsmanagement.

• Führt andere Aufgaben wie zugewiesen aus.

ÜBERWACHUNGSVERANTWORTUNGEN: Keine

QUALIFIKATIONEN:

• High-School-Diplom oder gleichwertig erforderlich. Bachelor-Abschluss in Maschinenbau, Maschinenbautechnik, oder gleichwertig ist bevorzugt.

• Kenntnisse über Herstellungs- und Maschinenbauprozesse im Zusammenhang mit der Reparatur von Pumpen und der Herstellung von Pumpenteilen werden bevorzugt.

• Starke organisatorische, zwischenmenschliche und analytische Fähigkeiten. Hervorragende verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten; einschließlich Diplomatie und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten.

• Starke PC-Fähigkeiten, mit Kenntnissen in Microsoft-Software.

• 15 Tage bezahlte Freizeit und 12 bezahlte Firmenferien

• 401k Plan mit einem 6% Match

• Umfassender Gesundheitsplan einschließlich medizinischer, zahnärztlicher, Sehkraft, Leben, kurzfristige und langfristige Behinderung

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le technicien en génie aide les ingénieurs dans la conception, la modification et l'amélioration des produits et des procédés. Cela comprend l'essai, l'entretien et l'installation de l'équipement et des systèmes.
Ce profil d'emploi est destiné au personnel de soutien de niveau débutant qui suit des instructions et des procédures spécifiques, la supervision étant assurée pour les situations non courantes. RÉSUMÉ
Le poste est chargé de produire et de maintenir les routeurs de fabrication et les commandes de production à l'aide de dessins techniques, de BOM, de spécifications techniques et d'exigences de qualité. Utiliser la connaissance des procédés d'usinage et de fabrication pour établir la séquence d'opérations la plus efficace, soutenir la productivité, la qualité, la rentabilité et la livraison à temps.

FONCTIONS ESSENTIELLES:

• Interpréter les dessins de conception et les exigences techniques et de qualité du Bill of Material (BOM) pour développer des routages pour la fabrication de pièces et d'assemblages adaptés aux capacités d'usinage du Sulzer Nuclear Service Center.

• Générer des paquets de commande de production pour la fabrication de pièces de rechange de pompe et l'assemblage de pompes d'équipement neuves conformément aux capacités, aux procédures et aux exigences du programme d'assurance de la qualité.

• Génére des commandes de service pour le démontage et l'inspection, et la réparation des pompes envoyées à la SNSC pour rénovation.

• Coordonne avec les planificateurs de production et le superviseur des magasins pour s'assurer que les commandes de production et de service sont livrées à temps pour soutenir l'expédition des assemblages, pièces et pompes au client à temps.

• Aide à l'élaboration de plans, de procédures et de formulaires d'inspection conformément aux normes de l'entreprise.

DEUXIÈME RESPONSABILITÉS:

• Adhérer aux politiques, procédures et normes de l'entreprise et du ministère

• Soutient, coopère avec l'ensemble de l'entreprise et participe à son système de gestion de la sécurité et de la santé environnementales (ESH), qui comprend le suivi de toutes les politiques et procédures en matière de sécurité, de santé et d'environnement. Soutient et coopère aux efforts de gestion de la qualité à l'échelle de l'entreprise.

• Exécute d'autres fonctions selon l'affectation.

RESPONSABILITÉS DE SURVEILLANCE: Néant

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent requis. Baccalauréat en génie mécanique, technologie de génie mécanique ou équivalent est préféré.

• La connaissance des processus de fabrication et d'atelier de machines liés à la réparation des pompes et à la fabrication des pièces de pompes est privilégiée.

• Fortes compétences organisationnelles, interpersonnelles et analytiques. Excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite, y compris en diplomatie et en négociation.

• Fortes compétences PC, avec compétence dans les logiciels Microsoft.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• 15 jours de congé payé et 12 jours fériés payés par l'entreprise

• Plan 401k avec un match de 6%

• Plan de santé global incluant les soins médicaux, dentaires, la vision, la vie, l'invalidité de courte et de longue durée

• Correspondance du compte d'épargne santé

• Programme de bien-être

• Programme d'aide aux employés

• Congé parental payé

• Remboursement des frais de gymnastique

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Customer Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer Ellon, you'll be part of one of our flagship UK service centres and a recognised centre of excellence for rotating equipment services. With more than 100 skilled professionals on site, we deliver world-class repair, maintenance and upgrade solutions for critical equipment across the energy, power generation and industrial sectors.

Specialising in pumps, turbines, compressors and other rotating machinery, our team works alongside some of the world's leading operators to maximise reliability, improve performance and extend equipment life. Whether supporting major turnaround projects, complex overhauls or innovative upgrade programmes, you'll play a key role in delivering engineering solutions that keep critical industries running safely and efficiently. Your main responsibilities:

• As a Customer Support Engineer, you’ll be the vital link between our clients and our operations team.

• You’ll manage projects from order to delivery, ensuring timelines, quality, and commercial targets are met.

• Own client relationships – keep them informed, anticipate needs, and deliver exceptional service.

• Coordinate complex projects – liaise with technical, quality, and production teams to keep everything on track.

• Drive continuous improvement – embrace lean principles and help us stay ahead in safety, quality, and efficiency.

What We’re Looking For:

• Strong technical knowledge of rotating machinery and systems.

• Excellent communication and organisational skills.

• Commercial awareness and experience in a similar role.

• Ideally, an HNC or equivalent in engineering.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Specializzato in pompe, turbine, compressori e altri macchinari rotanti, il nostro team collabora con alcuni dei principali operatori del mondo per massimizzare l'affidabilità, migliorare le prestazioni e prolungare la durata dell'attrezzatura. Sia che supporti grandi progetti di turnaround, revisioni complesse o programmi di aggiornamento innovativi, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella fornitura di soluzioni ingegneristiche che mantengono le industrie critiche in esecuzione in modo sicuro ed efficiente. Le vostre principali responsabilità:

• In qualità di Customer Support Engineer, sarai il collegamento vitale tra i nostri clienti e il nostro team operativo.

• Potrai gestire i progetti da ordine alla consegna, assicurando tempi, qualità e obiettivi commerciali sono soddisfatti.

• Rapporti con i propri clienti – tenerli informati, anticipare le esigenze e fornire un servizio eccezionale.

• Coordinate i progetti complessi – limare con i team tecnici, di qualità e di produzione per mantenere tutto in pista.

• Guidare il miglioramento continuo – abbracciare i principi magre e aiutarci a rimanere avanti in sicurezza, qualità ed efficienza.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Forte conoscenza tecnica di macchine e sistemi rotanti.

• Ottima comunicazione e capacità organizzative.

• La consapevolezza commerciale e l'esperienza in un ruolo simile.

• Idealmente, un HNC o equivalente in ingegneria.

• Accesso agli sconti sullo stile di vita dello shopping più l'opportunità di richiedere l'iscrizione a Costco.

• Auto personale a noleggio per voi la vostra famiglia e gli amici.

• Long Service Awards che celebra il vostro impegno.

• Opportunità di apprendimento continua attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways.

jobs.title: Machinist - CNC
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously.
Key Responsibilities:

• Set up and operate machinery according to instructions.

• Monitor machine performance and make minor adjustments.

• Inspect products for quality and report defects.

• Maintain a clean and safe work area.

• Record production data and report issues.

• Follow safety and operational procedures.

Skills & Qualifications:

• May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 5 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

• Basic mechanical skills (CNC -Machining) and attention to detail.

• Ability to follow instructions and safety guidelines.

• Good hand-eye coordination and physical stamina.

• Willingness to learn and work in a team environment.

• Familiarity with production tools and equipment is a plus.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Gas Compressor Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we specialise in delivering top-tier service to our customers across the oil & gas, power generation, and renewable sectors. With our recent £1 million investment, our Ellon facility is now a Centre of Excellence, providing cutting-edge support for electric motors, pumps, gearboxes, and turbo-compressors. We are looking for a skilled Gas Compressor Technician to join our team.

As a Gas Compressor Technician, you will be working directly on the repair, overhaul, and maintenance of gas compressors. You will play a key role in ensuring that our customers' equipment is serviced to the highest standards, meeting industry specifications and maintaining operational efficiency Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities:

• Disassembling, inspecting, and rebuilding gas compressors and their components

• Diagnosing and repairing mechanical faults in a variety of compressor types

• Precision fitting, machining, and assembly work as required

• Performing dynamic and functional testing on overhauled equipment

• Collaborating with engineering and quality teams to ensure compliance with technical specifications

• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment in line with HSE requirements

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Experience in the overhaul and maintenance of gas compressors or similar rotating equipment

• Proficiency in mechanical fitting, assembly, and fault diagnosis

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals

• Good communication skills and a proactive attitude to teamwork

• Awareness of Health, Safety, and Environmental regulations

What we offer you

• Competitive basic salary.

• 33 days of annual leave.

• Defined pension contribution.

• Confidential support and guidance through our Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to a wide range of discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle.

• Discounted Personal Car Leasing - available for you, your family, and friends.

• Long Service Awards to celebrate your dedication.

• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Free and secure onsite parking, with electric charging facilities.

• We're proud to support those who've served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoDs Defence Employer Recognition Scheme meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Technical Focal Point - Gas Compression
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, innovation and excellence are at the heart of everything we do. Our Ellon Service Centre is one of Sulzer's flagship rotating equipment service facilities, providing world-class repair, maintenance and engineering solutions for critical turbomachinery and gas compression equipment across a wide range of industries.

As the Technical Focal Point for Gas Compression, you will serve as the first point of contact for technical guidance relating to gas compression equipment and workshop procedures. You will work closely with customers, workshop personnel, field service teams and engineering colleagues to deliver technically sound recommendations and exceptional customer support.

This is a highly visible role requiring strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills and a customer-focused approach. Your Responsibilities

• Act as the primary technical focal point for gas compression activities within the service centre.

• Provide technical guidance to workshop teams regarding repair methods, procedures and best practices.

• Support the wider engineering team in determining the optimum approach to work execution.

• Provide troubleshooting expertise for complex repair and operational issues.

• Liaise closely with engineering colleagues and other technical specialists when required.

• Attend customer meetings as the technical representative for gas compression projects.

• Accompany customers during witness testing activities, providing technical advice and support.

• Present technical findings, recommendations and repair solutions to customers.

• Build strong customer relationships through professional technical support and expertise.

• Review workshop findings and provide recommendations for repair solutions.

• Participate in failure investigations within Sulzer service centres and at customer sites.

• Deliver technical advice, coaching and training to internal teams where required.

What You Bring

Qualifications

• HNC, HND or Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience & Technical Knowledge

• Significant experience with gas compression equipment.

• Previous engineering experience within rotating equipment, turbomachinery or related industries.

• Understanding of vibration analysis and machinery diagnostics.

• Experience preparing technical reports and presenting engineering recommendations.

• Knowledge of repair methodologies and failure investigation practices.

Skills & Behaviours

• Strong influencing and persuasion skills.

• Comfortable engaging with customers and presenting technical information.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels.

• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Effective time management skills with flexibility to adapt to changing business demands.

• High attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.

• Competent user of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook.

• Committed to adhering to company standards, procedures and safety requirements.

Travel Requirements
The successful candidate must be willing to travel to customer sites and Sulzer locations as required, both within the UK and occasionally internationally.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual bonus scheme

• Car/Car Allowance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, innovation and excellence are at the heart of everything we do. Our Ellon Service Centre is one of Sulzer's flagship rotating equipment service facilities, providing world-class repair, maintenance and engineering solutions for critical turbomachinery and gas compression equipment across a wide range of industries.

As the Technical Focal Point for Gas Compression, you will serve as the first point of contact for technical guidance relating to gas compression equipment and workshop procedures. You will work closely with customers, workshop personnel, field service teams and engineering colleagues to deliver technically sound recommendations and exceptional customer support.

This is a highly visible role requiring strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills and a customer-focused approach. Your Responsibilities

• Act as the primary technical focal point for gas compression activities within the service centre.

• Provide technical guidance to workshop teams regarding repair methods, procedures and best practices.

• Support the wider engineering team in determining the optimum approach to work execution.

• Provide troubleshooting expertise for complex repair and operational issues.

• Liaise closely with engineering colleagues and other technical specialists when required.

• Attend customer meetings as the technical representative for gas compression projects.

• Accompany customers during witness testing activities, providing technical advice and support.

• Present technical findings, recommendations and repair solutions to customers.

• Build strong customer relationships through professional technical support and expertise.

• Review workshop findings and provide recommendations for repair solutions.

• Participate in failure investigations within Sulzer service centres and at customer sites.

• Deliver technical advice, coaching and training to internal teams where required.

What You Bring

Qualifications

• HNC, HND or Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience & Technical Knowledge

• Significant experience with gas compression equipment.

• Previous engineering experience within rotating equipment, turbomachinery or related industries.

• Understanding of vibration analysis and machinery diagnostics.

• Experience preparing technical reports and presenting engineering recommendations.

• Knowledge of repair methodologies and failure investigation practices.

Skills & Behaviours

• Strong influencing and persuasion skills.

• Comfortable engaging with customers and presenting technical information.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels.

• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Effective time management skills with flexibility to adapt to changing business demands.

• High attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.

• Competent user of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook.

• Committed to adhering to company standards, procedures and safety requirements.

Travel Requirements
The successful candidate must be willing to travel to customer sites and Sulzer locations as required, both within the UK and occasionally internationally.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual bonus scheme

• Car/Car Allowance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco member

jobs.title: Financial Analyst Services
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Finance team within the Division Services as Financial Analyst and support the Division FP&A manager and regional controllers with your financial analysis.
In this role you will:

• Support the Division FP&A and regional controllers by delivering comprehensive, complete, and timely financial information for the purpose of business management and decision making

• Enhance and develop new reports in Tagetik and drive BI tool solutions (QlikSense and Sharepoint) to improve processes and drive automatization

• Perform month-end closing activities incl. proper financial analysis on actuals vs. budget and prior month forecast

• Ensure timely submission of legal entities reporting packages and according to Sulzer standards. Support entities in reporting related issues

• Be the Services division point of contact for reporting matters in Tagetik and provide training to legal entities worldwide

• Perform various ad-hoc reporting requests to ease division financials understanding

• Contribute to the monthly preparation of the MIS presentation

• Monitor and control HQ Cost Centres and CAPEX spending

• Actively support in the Budgeting and Forecasting processes

• Support cash forecasting

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Degree in Business Administration with a specialization in Accounting, Finance or Controlling

• Three years of experience in financial analysis or controlling, preferably in corporate finance

• Good knowledge of Tagetik with experience in report building

• Advanced financial modelling skills (Excel) and strong knowledge of PowerPoint

• Experience with SAP (FI/CO modules) and business application tools

• Analytically strong person with high energy to drive for result

• Strong problem solving and ability to prioritize responsibilities, tasks and processes

• A flexible and adaptive team player with a positive attitude

• Fluency in English

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Offices location: Nuevos Ministerios

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
